blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.
blocks.zh: 视频基础模型在理解和生成视觉序列方面迅速进步,而视频世界模型则寻求捕捉他们所描绘的世界的基本动态. 尽管目标不同,但两者都涉及视频观测与不断变化的世界之间的关系。 这项调查采用世界模型作为审查这些事态发展的统一视角。 我们把被观测到的视频视为对潜在时空世界的片面、失落和时间顺序的投影,我们围绕四个互补行动组织文献:从被观测到的视频中推断出世界属性;从特定或了解的世界条件中合成视频;通过共同的建模机制分享理解和生成;在行动和不断发展的观测下,互动预测和更新世界国家。 这一视角区分了观测或生成序列的时间一致性与基本世界状态的一致性。 在任务、表述、模型、数据集和基准方面,我们追踪重点的转变,从短片层面的识别和观念上的忠诚转向持续状态、可控制的演化、物理和因果有效性,以及基于互动和下游决定的评价,我们总结了随之而来的公开挑战。

blocks.en: 2 Introduction
blocks.zh: 2. 导言

blocks.en: “Vision is the process of discovering from images what is present in the world, and where it is.” David Marr, Vision , 1982 Marr,1982
blocks.zh: “视觉是从图像中发现世界存在的东西及其所在之处的过程。” David Marr,《展望》,1982年 Marr,1982年

blocks.en:
Video occupies a distinctive position among the modalities available to machine intelligence.
Unlike static images that capture individual moments, text that conveys selectively described information, or audio that primarily records acoustic dynamics, video directly captures how visible entities, their relations, and actions evolve across space and time, often together with synchronized audio, speech, and text.
This rich spatiotemporal information makes video essential to a wide range of applications, including communication, entertainment, autonomous driving, robotics, healthcare, and education.
Consequently, video has long been a central subject of computer vision and multimedia research, progressing from spatiotemporal architectures for action recognition Kay et al., 2017 ; Carreira & Zisserman, 2017 ; Feichtenhofer et al., 2019 to self-supervised pretraining for transferable video representations Tong et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024d .
More recently, advances in large language models (LLMs) and large-scale generative modeling have driven a shift from task-specific video models toward general-purpose video foundation models, expanding their capabilities along three complementary directions. For video understanding , Video-LLMs such as Video-LLaVA Lin et al., 2024 enable language-based interaction with visual sequences, while Qwen3-VL Bai et al., 2025 extends multimodal context to 256K tokens to accommodate longer video inputs. For video generation , models such as Sora Brooks et al., 2024 , Wan Wan et al., 2025 , HunyuanVideo Kong et al., 2024 , Movie Gen Polyak et al., 2024 , and Seedance 2.0 Team Seedance et al., 2026 demonstrate increasingly capable synthesis under diverse conditions, with Sora and Loong Wang et al., 2024f further exploring minute-scale generation. Toward the unification of understanding and generation , emerging models Wang et al., 2024b ; Xie et al., 2025a ; Wei et al., 2026 seek to integrate these capabilities through shared token representations, latent spaces, or modeling interfaces, bringing video perception and synthesis into a common foundation-model framework.
blocks.zh:
视频在机器情报部门可用的模式中占有显著地位。
与静态图像捕捉单个瞬间不同的是,有选择性地传递信息的文本,或主要记录声学动态的音频,视频直接捕捉可见实体,其关系,以及动作在空间和时间上如何演化,往往与同步音频,语音,文本一起.
这种丰富的瞬间信息使得视频对广泛的应用至关重要,包括通信、娱乐、自主驾驶、机器人、保健和教育。
因此,视频长期以来一直是计算机视觉和多媒体研究的中心课题,从Sparotemporal架构用于行动识别 Kay等,2017年;Carreira & Zisserman,2017年;Feichtenhofer等,2019年到可转让视频演示的自我监督预训. Tong等, 2022; Wang等, 2024d.
最近,在大语言模型(LLMs)和大规模基因模型化方面的进展促使从任务特定的视频模型向通用视频基础模型转变,沿着三个互补方向扩展了它们的能力. 为了了解视频,视频LLM,如视频LLAVA Lin等,2024 启用了基于语言的与视觉序列的交互,而 Qune3-VL Bai等,2025 将多模式上下文扩展到了256K 令牌,以容纳更长的视频输入. 对于视频生成,例如Sora Brooks等人,2024年,Wan Wan等人,2025年,Hunyuan 视频 Kong等,2024年;Movie Gen Polyak等,2024年;Sedance 2.0 Team Seedance等,2026年在多种条件下展示出日益能动的合成,由Sora和Loong Wang等,2024f进一步探索了分级生成. 争取统一理解与生成,新兴模式王等. 2024b; 谢等, 2025a; ; Wei等人,2026年试图通过共同的象征性表示,潜在的空间,或建模接口来整合这些能力,将视频感知和合成带入共同的基础-模型框架.

blocks.en:
Beyond video understanding and generation, a broader research direction is emerging around modeling how the physical world evolves , rather than merely interpreting or synthesizing its visual observations.
Although language models acquire extensive knowledge through text, their representations are only indirectly grounded in physical experience, motivating the pursuit of world models that can predict how an environment changes over time and support reasoning and planning LeCun, 2022 ; Chen et al., 2026e .
This idea has roots in model-based reinforcement learning, where agents learn predictive dynamics to simulate possible futures and evaluate candidate actions before acting Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2025 .
Video provides a natural and scalable foundation for extending this paradigm beyond task-specific environments: by capturing continuous changes in objects, relations, and actions, large-scale video data offers rich supervision for learning world dynamics without requiring manually annotated labels, although actions and underlying physical states often remain unobserved.
Building on this opportunity, recent research has explored several complementary approaches to video-based world modeling.
Generative models such as Sora Brooks et al., 2024 have motivated the prospect of learning world dynamics through video synthesis, while Genie Bruce et al., 2024 demonstrates how interactive environments can be learned from unlabeled videos.
Action- and condition-aware models such as GAIA-1 Hu et al., 2023 and Cosmos NVIDIA et al., 2025 extend predictive generation toward driving and physical AI, whereas V-JEPA 2 Assran et al., 2025 and Dreamer 4 Hafner et al., 2025a explore predictive representations and imagined trajectories for planning and control.
Together with progress in interactive simulation Yang et al., 2024 , egocentric and robotic learning Grauman et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2024a , and long-horizon prediction Xiao et al., 2025a , these developments are expanding the role of video from a medium for perception and generation toward a foundation for predicting and interacting with dynamic environments.
Figure 1 traces milestones of these lines of work.
blocks.zh:
除了视频的理解和生成之外,围绕物理世界如何演变的模型正在出现更广泛的研究方向,而不仅仅是解释或合成其视觉观测。
虽然语言模型通过文本获得广泛的知识,但其表达方式只是间接地以物理经验为基础,激励人们追求世界模型,这些模型可以预测环境如何随时间而变化,并支持推理和规划LeCun, 2022; Chen等, 2026e.
这个想法根植于基于模型的强化学习中,其中代理者学习了预测动力学来模拟可能的未来并评价候选行动后再出演Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner等, 2025.
视频为将这一范式扩展到任务特定环境之外提供了一个自然而可扩展的基础:通过捕捉物体,关系和行动的持续变化,大型视频数据为学习世界动态提供了丰富的监督,而不需要手动附加说明的标签,不过动作和所基于的物理状态往往仍然无法观察.
利用这一机会,最近的研究探索了以视频为基础的世界建模的几种互补方法。
Sora Brooks等基因模型,2024年激发了通过视频合成来学习世界动态的前景;而Genie Bruce等,2024年展示了如何从无标签视频中学习互动环境.
行动和条件意识模型,如GAIA-1 Hu等,2023年和Cosmos NVIDIA等,2025年,将预测生成扩展到驾驶和物理AI,而V-JEPA 2 Assran等,2025年和Dreamer 4 Hafner等,2025a 则探索预测表述和想象的轨道,用于规划和控制。
与互动模拟的进展相结合 Yang等, 2024年, 自我中心与机器人学习 Grauman等, 2022年; Wu等, 2024年a, 和长视野预测 Xiao等, 2025年a, 这些发展正在扩大视频的作用,
图1列出了这些工作领域的里程碑。

blocks.en:
These two lines of progress are increasingly converging around a common challenge: connecting video observations with the dynamics of the world they depict .
Video world models must infer underlying states from observed sequences before predicting how those states evolve, and often translate predicted states back into visual observations for simulation, evaluation, or planning.
Conversely, video generators are increasingly incorporating action- and state-dependent controls, while unified video models explicitly couple visual understanding with synthesis.
Despite their different objectives, these approaches therefore share a fundamental question: what relationship does a model learn between an observed video and the evolving world that gives rise to it?
blocks.zh:
这两条进展线正日益围绕一个共同的挑战相汇合:将视频观测与所描绘的世界动态联系起来。
视频世界模型必须先从所观测到的序列中推断出基本状态,然后才能预测这些状态是如何演变的,并常常将所预测的状态转化为可视观测,用于模拟,评价或规划.
反之,视频生成器正越来越多地纳入行动控制和国家控制,而统一的视频模型明确将视觉理解与合成结合起来。
因此,这些方法尽管目标不同,但有一个基本问题:一个模型在被观察的视频与产生视频的不断变化的世界之间有什么关系?

blocks.en:
To examine this question systematically, we adopt world modeling as a unifying perspective on video foundation models.
Specifically, we view an observed video V V as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered observation of an underlying latent temporal world W W .
This distinction provides a common basis for organizing four complementary research paradigms: reading , which infers world properties from observed video; writing , which synthesizes video observations from specified or learned world conditions; sharing , which integrates both directions within a unified modeling framework; and interacting , which updates or predicts world states in response to actions and evolving observations.
These paradigms characterize different ways in which models connect video observations to the underlying world, rather than merely categorizing models by their input and output modalities.
This perspective enables a systematic comparison of their objectives, capabilities, and evaluation criteria while preserving the distinctions between visual plausibility, temporal coherence, and consistency of the modeled world.
Section 3 formalizes this framework and clarifies how these properties differ across the four paradigms.
blocks.zh:
为了系统地审查这一问题,我们采用世界模式,作为视频基础模型的统一视角。
具体地说,我们把一个观察到的V V视频看成是片面的、失落的、按时间顺序观察潜在的时间世界WW。
这种区分为组织四种互补的研究范式提供了共同的基础:读取从被观测到的视频中推断出世界属性;写出从特定或被学习到的世界条件中合成视频观测;分享将双向融合到一个统一的建模框架内;和相互作用,对世界国家进行更新或预测以应对行动和不断发展的观测.
这些范式的特征是模型将视频观测与基础世界连接起来的不同方式,而不是仅仅根据其输入和输出模式对模型进行分类.
这种观点有助于系统地比较它们的目标、能力和评价标准,同时保持模拟世界的视觉可信性、时间一致性和一致性之间的区别。
第3节正式确定了这一框架,并澄清了这些特性在四种范式中有何不同。

blocks.en:
Existing relevant surveys have examined related developments from different perspectives, including general world models organized around predictive state representations across modalities Ding et al., 2026 , interactive video world models centered on online prediction and control Liu et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026a , 3D and 4D world modeling grounded in explicit geometric representations Kong et al., 2025 , multimodal language models emphasizing the integration of visual encoders and language reasoning Yin et al., 2024 , long-form video generation focusing on temporal extension and consistency Li et al., 2024 , and audio-visual foundation models spanning complementary modalities Qin et al., 2026a .
While these surveys provide valuable insights into individual research directions, they do not collectively establish a unified account of how video models connect observations to evolving world states across understanding, generation, unification, and interaction. Our survey addresses this gap by taking the relation between video observations and the underlying dynamic world as its central organizing principle , not any single architecture, task, or modality.
blocks.zh:
现有相关调查从不同角度审查了相关动态,包括围绕预测性状态不同模式表述组织的一般世界模型 Ding等,2026年,互动视频世界模型,以在线预测和控制刘等为中心,2026;Luo等,2026a,3D和4D世界模型,以明确的几何表示法为基础 Kong等,2025年;多模式语言模型强调视觉编码器与语言推理相融合;Yin等,2024年;长式视频生成侧重于时间延伸与一致性;Li等,2024年;视听基础模型跨越互补模式;Cin等,2026a.
虽然这些调查提供了对个别研究方向的宝贵见解,但它们并没有集体地建立关于视频模型如何通过理解、生成、统一和互动将观察与不断变化的世界国家联系起来的统一说明。 我们的调查通过将视频观测与根本的活泼世界之间的关系作为其核心组织原则来解决这一差距,而不是任何单一的架构、任务或模式。

blocks.en:
Under this perspective, we systematically examine the four paradigms of reading, writing, sharing, and interacting through a common analytical framework.
For each paradigm, we review the tasks, datasets, and evaluation protocols that define its objectives; the representations and model architectures that support its capabilities; the reasoning and control mechanisms that extend its functionality; and the applications that demonstrate its practical utility.
Beyond reviewing individual paradigms, we identify several cross-cutting questions: how models represent and preserve world states beyond immediate observations, how actions and external conditions influence state evolution, and how predictive capabilities translate into effective reasoning and decision-making.
These questions also motivate a closer examination of evaluation practices, particularly the distinction between conventional metrics of recognition accuracy or perceptual fidelity and emerging criteria concerning state persistence, controllability, physical and causal consistency, and downstream utility.
Within the interacting paradigm, we further distinguish video world models along two complementary dimensions: prediction space , ranging from observation-space to latent-state prediction, and transition interface , ranging from passive prediction to action-conditioned rollout and closed-loop interaction.
This taxonomy separates what a model predicts from how its predictions are conditioned, updated, and used.
blocks.zh:
在这个观点下,我们通过一个共同的分析框架,系统地审查阅读、写作、分享和互动这四个范式。
对于每一个范式,我们审查确定目标的任务、数据集和评价协议;支持其能力的表述和模型架构;扩展其功能的推理和控制机制;以及显示其实际效用的应用程序。
除了审查个别范式外,我们找出几个贯穿各领域的问题:模型如何代表和维护世界国家,超越眼前的观察;行动和外部条件如何影响国家演变;预测能力如何转化为有效的推理和决策。
这些问题还促使人们更仔细地审查评价做法,特别是辨识准确性或知觉忠诚性等常规衡量标准与关于状态持久性、可控制性、物理和因果一致性以及下游效用等新兴标准之间的区别。
在互动范式中,我们进一步按照两个互补维度区分视频世界模型:从观测空间到潜在状态预测的预测空间,以及过渡界面,从被动预测到行动有条件的推出和闭路互动。
这种分类法将模型的预测与它的预测如何有条件,更新,使用区分开来.

blocks.en:
Our review covers publicly available research that contributes relevant architectural, methodological, or evaluation evidence.
We retain foundational studies where necessary to establish conceptual and technical developments, while interpreting recent advances in the context of their specific tasks, training data, and evaluation protocols.
Throughout the survey, we distinguish between the capabilities supported by a model’s design, the supervision provided by its training data, and the empirical evidence demonstrated by its evaluation, avoiding assumptions that strong performance on individual video tasks necessarily implies consistent or generalizable world modeling.
blocks.zh:
我们的审查包括公开提供的研究,这些研究提供了相关的建筑、方法或评价证据。
我们在必要时保留基础研究,以确立概念和技术发展,同时根据其具体任务、培训数据和评价协议解释最近的进展。
在整个调查中,我们区分了模型设计所支持的能力、其培训数据所提供的监督以及其评价所显示的经验证据,避免了个人视频任务的有力表现必然意味着一致或可概括的世界建模的假设。

blocks.en:
Specifically, this survey makes three main contributions: A world-modeling lens. The four-operation framework of reading, writing, sharing, and interacting relates video understanding, video generation, unified video models, and video world models in one account, plus a two-axis classification of world models by prediction space and transition interface. A comprehensive scope with insights. Across tasks, representations, models, systems, datasets, and benchmarks, we compare how the four operations represent state, learn from video, accept control, preserve memory, and are evaluated.
The synthesis distills recurring design patterns and failure modes into explicit insights, and identifies open directions, including long-horizon consistency, physical and causal grounding, measurable synergy between understanding and generation, and standardized evaluation of world properties. Open resources. A public reading list, taxonomy, codes, data, and resources are all categorized and available at project page .
blocks.zh:
具体地说,这项调查有三个主要贡献: 世界模范透镜. 阅读,写作,分享,互动的四行框架将视频理解,视频生成,统一视频模型,视频世界模型在一个账户中相接,再用预测空间和过渡界面对世界模型进行两轴分级. 具有洞察力的全面范围。 在任务、表达、模型、系统、数据集和基准方面,我们比较这四种操作如何代表状态,从视频中学习,接受控制,保存内存,并进行评估。
综合提炼出反复出现的设计模式和失败模式,形成明确的洞察力,并确定了开放方向,包括长相一致性、物理和因果地基、理解和生成之间可衡量的协同作用以及对世界属性的标准化评价。 开放资源. 公共读取列表、分类、代码、数据和资源都分类,可在项目网页查阅。

blocks.en:
The remainder of this survey proceeds as follows.
Section 3 formalizes the video–world relation, the two forms of consistency, and the four operations.
Section 4 assembles the shared background: recurring video scenarios, language-model and generative-modeling foundations, and the definition and taxonomy of video world models.
Sections 5 through 8 then follow the operations from observing a trace to evolving a world state.
Section 5 studies how models read semantic, spatial, temporal, physical, and causal properties from video;
Section 6 examines the representations, generative paradigms, and controls used to write traces;
Section 7 turns to the architectures and training regimes that connect the two directions; and
Section 8 completes the progression with open-loop and online models that evolve video-derived state under actions or conditions.
Figure 2 condenses the resulting landscape: each operation branches into parallel research streams and then into the representative works examined in those chapters.
Section 9 distills the challenges that cut across the four operations into directions for future work, and a brief conclusion closes the survey.
Table 1: Notation used throughout the survey.

blocks.en: 3 The World-Modeling Lens
blocks.zh: 3 世界模范系列

blocks.en:
This section defines the world and its video (Section 3.1 ), two forms of consistency used later for evaluation (Section 3.2 ), and the four operations that organize Sections 5 – 8 (Section 3.3 ).
Table 1 lists the notation.
blocks.zh:
这一节界定了世界及其录像(第3.1节)、后来用于评价的两种一致性形式(第3.2节)以及组织第5至8节的四项行动(第3.3节)。
表1列出了注解。

blocks.en: 3.1 World, Video, and Represented State
blocks.zh: 3.1 世界、录像和代表国家

blocks.en:
We distinguish three objects: the evolving world, the video through which it is observed, and the representations that a model constructs from available information.
The following definitions provide a conceptual abstraction:
blocks.zh:
我们区分出三个目标:不断演变的世界,通过它观察的视频,以及模型从现有信息中构建的表述.
以下定义提供了概念抽象:

Latent temporal worldworld
The latent temporal world is a stochastic process W = ( w t ) t ≥ 1 W=(w_{t})_{t\geq 1} over a state space 𝒲 \mathcal{W} .
Each state w t ∈ 𝒲 w_{t}\in\mathcal{W} encompasses entities, their attributes and relations, and relevant physical and dynamic variables.
Assuming that w t w_{t} contains sufficient information for predicting subsequent evolution, its dynamics can be expressed as w t + 1 ∼ 𝒯 ( ⋅ ∣ w t , a t ) , w_{t+1}\sim\mathcal{T}(\,\cdot\mid w_{t},a_{t}), where a t a_{t} denotes an optional intervention or control input, with uncontrolled evolution recovered when no such input is supplied.

Remark. Definitions – describe a partially observable dynamical system, closely related to the environment model underlying a partially observable Markov decision process.
Such formulations are widely used in model-based reinforcement learning Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2025 , where agents infer predictive states from observations and simulate possible futures under candidate actions.
For general video foundation models, however,
the represented state may be implicit or constructed
from an entire sequence rather than updated online.

blocks.en:
Observation 3.1 (Coherence-consistency) Neither property implies the other.
An object that changes identity after leaving the frame, a room that alters its layout between visits, or an action whose effect later disappears can yield locally smooth frames that no trajectory in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} explains; conversely, a hard cut violates local smoothness while remaining world-consistent.
blocks.zh:
意见3.1(一致性) 任何财产都不意味着其他财产。
一个在离开帧后改变身份的物体,一个在访问之间改变其布局的房间,或者一个其影响后来消失的动作,可以产生出C\mathcal{C}中没有任何轨迹解释的局部平滑帧;反之,硬剪会侵犯局部平滑而保持世界一致性.

blocks.en:
Temporal coherence is a property of the trace; world consistency is a property of the world the trace implies.
A recorded video is world-consistent by construction, because a real trajectory produced it, so the distinction matters for traces that a model writes or predicts.
World-modeling evidence must therefore test world consistency, not only temporal coherence.
As 𝒪 \mathcal{O} and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} are unobserved, Definition is an evaluation target, not a metric; benchmarks in Sections 6.1.2 and 8.4 probe it via revisits, occlusion, and interventions.
blocks.zh:
时间一致性是微量财产;世界一致性是微量所暗示的世界财产。
一个录制的视频通过构建而与世界一致,因为一个真实的轨迹产生了它,所以对于一个模型写作或预测的痕迹来说,区别很重要.
因此,世界示范证据必须检验世界的一致性,而不仅仅是时间的一致性。
由于O \ mathcal{O} 和 C \ mathcal{C} 是不可观察的, 定义是一个评价目标, 不是衡量标准; 第6.1.2和8.4节中的基准通过重访、隔离和干预来探究它。

blocks.en:
The arrows here are conceptual shorthand: writing reaches W W only through c c , and reading and writing are not exact inverses.
Stronger claims about the represented state need stronger evidence; Table 2 gives four levels for each operation, from plausible output to decision utility.
One system can perform several operations: a unified editor reads a source clip before writing its revision, and an interactive world model reads its history, writes each next frame, and updates its state in one backbone.
Figure 1 places milestones of the four lines of work on one timeline, from video encoders Feichtenhofer et al., 2019 ; Arnab et al., 2021 and generators Ho et al., 2022a ; Henschel et al., 2025 to unified models Wang et al., 2024b ; Xie et al., 2025a and action-conditioned simulators Hu et al., 2023 ; Bruce et al., 2024 .

blocks.en: 4 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 4 初步情况

blocks.en: This section covers the background shared by the four operations: video scenarios (Section 4.1 ), video large language models (Section 4.2 ), generative modeling (Section 4.3 ), and the scope and taxonomy of video world models (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 本节介绍这四个业务共享的背景:视频情景(第4.1节)、视频大语言模型(第4.2节)、基因模型(第4.3节)和视频世界模型的范围和分类(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Video Scenarios
blocks.zh: 4.1 视频设想

blocks.en:
Video modeling spans diverse scenarios that differ in temporal extent, observation perspective, modality composition, information availability, interaction, and domain-specific constraints. Rather than forming mutually exclusive categories, these characteristics impose complementary demands on what a model must observe, retain, predict, and control.
Table 3 lists the evidence, modeling demands, and representative resources of each scenario.
blocks.zh:
视频模型涵盖各种情景,在时间范围、观测视角、模式组成、信息可用性、互动和特定领域制约方面各不相同。 这些特征不是形成相互排斥的类别,而是对模型必须观察、保留、预测和控制的内容提出了互补的要求。
表3列出了每个设想方案的证据、建模需求和代表性资源。

blocks.en: Table 3: Video scenarios, their defining evidence conditions, modeling demands, and representative resources.
blocks.zh: 表3:视频情景、其界定的证据条件、建模需求和代表性资源。

blocks.en:
Three labels describe the recorded content: its default form, its modalities, and its viewpoint. Regular short video , the standard setting for representation learning and clip-level understanding, consists of passive third-person clips of seconds to minutes, whose audio is usually ignored.
Its datasets annotate action classes Kay et al., 2017 , actions defined by temporal change Goyal et al., 2017 , or captions Xu et al., 2016 , but do not test memory, online response, or control. Sounding video treats synchronized audio as evidence, with tasks that range from audio-event recognition and source localization to generating events whose sound and appearance must agree Gemmeke et al., 2017 ; Chen et al., 2020 ; Tian et al., 2018 .
Its benchmarks must rule out visual or language shortcuts. Egocentric video is recorded from a wearer’s or agent’s viewpoint, so hands, manipulated objects, gaze, and body-coupled camera motion enter the stream Grauman et al., 2022 ; Damen et al., 2022 ; Grauman et al., 2025 ; Mangalam et al., 2023 .
The task shifts from recognizing actions to tracking object state and intent across long activities with frequent occlusion.
blocks.zh:
三个标签描述了所记录的内容:其默认形式,模式和观点. 常规短视频,代表学习和剪辑水平理解的标准设定,由一秒到一分的被动第三人称短片组成,其音频通常被忽略.
它的数据集注释动作类 Kay等, 2017年, 由时间变化定义的动作 Goyal等, 2017年, 或标题 徐等, 2016. 但不要测试内存, 在线响应, 或控制. 声音视频将同步音频视为证据,任务范围从音频事件识别和源地本地化到生成事件,其声音和外观必须同意Gemmeke等,2017;Chen等,2020;Tian等,2018.
它的基准必须排除视觉或语言的捷径. 从佩戴者或代理的角度录制出爱高中心视频,因此手,被操纵的物体,目光,和相机相机运动进入了溪道Grauman等,2022;Damen等,2022;Grauman等,2025;Mangalam等,2023.
任务从确认行动转向追踪物体状态和意图,贯穿长期活动,经常被隔离。

blocks.en:
Three further labels describe how the model accesses observations and whether it can change them.
In streaming and online video , frames arrive incrementally, so a model must update its state and respond within bounded latency, without access to future frames.
Typical tasks are online question answering and streaming captioning, which may require timestamped or proactive responses Niu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025f .
The same recording can be processed offline in full or presented as a stream. Long-form video spans minutes to hours: the full recording is usually available, but not every frame can be processed at full resolution, and the evidence for a query is sparse and spread across distant segments Zhou et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 .
A model must therefore decide which evidence to keep and link events that lie far apart in time. Interactive video lets a human, policy, or agent supply actions that change what is observed next Arai et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Shang et al., 2026 .
Unlike in a passive stream, the future then depends on the interaction history; interactive world models (Section 4.4 ) target this setting.
blocks.zh:
另有三个标签描述了模型如何访问观测,以及它能否改变观测结果.
在流媒体和网络视频中,帧逐渐到达,所以一个模型必须更新状态并在有限度的时空范围内响应,而不能访问未来的帧.
典型的任务是在线问答和流出字幕,这可能需要有时间标记或主动的回答 Niu等,2025;Yang等,2025f。
同样的录音可以全线处理,也可以作为流来进行. 长式视频持续了几分钟至几小时:通常可以提供全程录音,但并非每个帧都可以完全解析处理,查询的证据很少,分散在遥远的片段. 周等,2025b;王等,2025c;傅等,2025;吴等,2024.
因此,一个模型必须决定哪些证据可以将时间相去甚远的事件保持和联系起来。 互动视频让人类、政策或代理人提供行动, 2024; Ye等, 2026; Sang等, 2026.
与被动流不同的是,未来随后取决于交互历史;交互世界模型(第4.4节)针对这个设置.

blocks.en:
Domain-specific video cuts across all of these labels: driving Caesar et al., 2020 ; Sima et al., 2024 , surgery Twinanda et al., 2017 , sports Giancola et al., 2018 , and instructional video Miech et al., 2019 ; Tang et al., 2019 impose their own event structure, terminology, and costs of error.
These domains test whether general video representations transfer to rare events and specialized outputs.
blocks.zh:
域名特有视频切入了所有这些标签:驾驶凯撒等,2020;西玛等,2024;外科Twinanda等,2017;体育Giancola等,2018;教学视频. Miech等人, 2019; Tang等, 2019 强制规定自己的事件结构,名词和出错成本.
这些领域检验一般的视频表现是否转移到了罕见的事件和专门的出品.

blocks.en: 4.2 Video Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 视频大语言模型

blocks.en:
Connecting video to an LLM. A Video-LLM feeds video into a pretrained large language model (LLM), usually an autoregressive Transformer Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Touvron et al., 2023 trained by next-token prediction (Equation ( 2 )).
The LLM learns to follow instructions through supervised instruction tuning Wei et al., 2022a , which visual instruction tuning extends to images Liu et al., 2023 , and is further aligned with human or model feedback Ouyang et al., 2022 and verifiable rewards Lambert et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 .
Inside a video system, it understands and generates language, answers questions, and sometimes acts as a controller that decomposes tasks, selects tools, and reasons over several steps.
In a common division of labor, a video encoder supplies perceptual features, the LLM interprets or organizes them, and a decoder, generator, or world model produces pixels or state transitions.
To connect video, a video encoder E v E_{v} maps frames or clips x 1 : T x_{1:T} to visual features, and a connector P P converts these features into a language-compatible sequence: z 1 : L = P ( E v ( x 1 : T ) ) . z_{1:L}=P\!\left(E_{v}(x_{1:T})\right). (1) Connectors range from linear projectors Liu et al., 2023 to learned-query resamplers Jaegle et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023 and gated cross-attention Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Section 5.3 compares them and the video-specific training recipes.
blocks.zh:
正在连接视频到一个 LLM 。 A Video-LLM 将视频输入预训大语言模型(LLM),通常为自旋变形器Vaswani等,2017;Touvron等,2023由下位预测(方程式(2-))所训练.
LLM通过监听指令来学习遵循指令 校对:Soup 刘等,2023年;与人或模型反馈欧阳等,2022年和可核实的奖励兰伯特等,2025年;郭等,2025年.
在一个视频系统中,它理解并生成语言,回答问题,有时还起到一个控制器的作用来分解任务,选择工具,以及数个步骤中的原因.
在共同的分工中,视频编码器提供感知功能,LLM解释或组织它们,而解码器,生成器,或世界模型产生像素或状态过渡.
要连接到视频,一个视频编码器E v E_{v}地图框或剪辑 x 1 : T x_{ 1: T}到视觉特性,一个连接器 P 将这些特性转换为语言相容的序列:z 1: L = P (E v (x 1: T)). s_{1:L}=P\!\左 (E_{v}(x_{1:T})\右). (1)连接器从线性投影仪Liu等人,2023到有学问-query再模拟器. Jaegle等人,2021年;Li等人,2023年;Gated Cross-attention Alayrac等人,2022年;第5.3节将它们和视频专用培训食谱作比较.

blocks.en:
Video tokens and context. In the Video-LLM literature, a video token usually denotes one of the continuous embeddings in z 1 : L z_{1:L} passed to the LLM.
Autoregressive video generators often use the same term for discrete codebook indices, a different representation (Section 6 ).
Frame sampling, temporal pooling, and the connector set the number L L of embeddings kept from a video.
A larger L L preserves finer spatial and temporal evidence but costs more context, memory, and attention; stronger compression is cheaper but can remove brief events, small objects, or long-range relations.
Because the context window is fixed and also holds the instructions, earlier dialogue, and the output, long-video models must split the remaining budget between temporal coverage and visual detail.
blocks.zh:
视频标志和上下文. 在Video-LLM文献中,一个视频符号通常表示在z 1中被连续嵌入的其中一个: Lz_{1:L}被传递到LLM.
自动回转式视频生成器经常在离散的编码本索引中使用同名词,一种不同的表示(第6节.
帧采样,时间集合,连接器设置了从视频中保存的嵌入子的编号L.
较大的LL保留了更细的空间和时间证据,但需要更多的上下文,内存和注意力;更强的压缩成本更低廉,但可以去除短暂的事件,小物体,或长距离的关系.
由于上下文窗口是固定的,同时也持有指令,更早的对话,以及输出,长视频模型必须把剩余的预算从时间覆盖和视觉细节中分出.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generative Modeling Foundations
blocks.zh: 4.3 基因建模基金会

blocks.en:
Conditional generation. Whereas the LLM mainly produces language, generative models produce the visual output of a video system.
Writing samples a trace x ^ 1 : T ∼ p θ ( x 1 : T ∣ c ) \hat{x}_{1:T}\sim p_{\theta}(x_{1:T}\mid c) (Definition ).
Video generators usually work in the latent space of a variational autoencoder (VAE) Kingma & Welling, 2014 , whose decoder may be trained with an adversarial loss Goodfellow et al., 2020 : an encoder maps the video to a latent z z , the generator models p θ ​ ( z ∣ c ) p_{\theta}(z\mid c) , and the decoder maps a sampled latent back to frames.
We write z z for whichever target is modeled, whether continuous latents, discrete video tokens, or, for pixel-space models, the frames themselves.
In general, a condition may specify content, such as a prompt or a reference image, or control how the state evolves, such as actions, trajectories, or camera paths.
The same modality can play different roles: an image may specify appearance, provide the initial observation, or serve as a spatial reference.
Action-conditioned and interactive world models (Section 4.4 ) require the second kind.

有条件的一代. 而LLM主要产生语言,基因模型则产生视频系统的视觉输出.
将样本写入出处 x ^ 1 : T ∼ p (x 1 : T ∣ c )\hat{x}_{ 1: T}\sim p_{\theta} (x_{ 1: T}\mid c) (定义 ).
视频生成器通常在变相自编码器(VAE)Kingma & Welling,2014年的潜在空间工作,其解码器可能通过对抗性损失Goodfellow等人的训练来工作,2020年:一个解码器将视频映射到潜伏的z z,生成器型号p θ (z ∣ c) p_{\theta}(z\mid c),解码器将一个被取样后潜回到帧.
无论是连续潜伏物,离散的视频信号物,还是像素空间模型的相框本身,我们都会为任何被建模的目标写出z z.
一般来说,一个条件可以指定内容,比如一个即时或参考图像,或者控制状态如何演变,比如动作,轨迹,或者相机路径等.
同样的模式可以发挥不同的作用:图像可以指定外观,提供初始观测,或者作为空间参考.
有行动条件和互动的世界模式(第4.4节)需要第二种模式。

blocks.en:
Autoregressive and masked modeling. When the target is a sequence of ordered units z 1 : N z_{1:N} , an autoregressive model factorizes the conditional distribution as p θ ( z 1 : N ∣ c ) = ∏ i = 1 N p θ ( z i ∣ z < i , c ) p_{\theta}(z_{1:N}\mid c)=\prod_{i=1}^{N}p_{\theta}(z_{i}\mid z_{<i},c) (2) and generates the units in order, each sampled unit joining the context for later predictions.
The units may be discrete codes or continuous latent blocks, ordered by time alone or by a space–time serialization, and Transformer decoders are the common implementation Vaswani et al., 2017 .
Masked modeling instead hides a subset of units and predicts them in parallel from the visible context and the condition.
For discrete targets, with sampled masked positions M M and visible units z M ¯ z_{\bar{M}} , a common objective is the token cross-entropy ℒ mask = 𝔼 ( z , c ) , M [ − ∑ i ∈ M log p θ ( z i ∣ z M ¯ , c ) ] . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mask}}=\mathbb{E}_{(z,c),M}\!\left[-\sum_{i\in M}\log p_{\theta}(z_{i}\mid z_{\bar{M}},c)\right]. (3) MaskGIT Chang et al., 2022 turns these predictions into samples through iterative filling and refinement.
Continuous pixel or feature targets instead use a reconstruction loss such as squared error He et al., 2022 .

blocks.en: 4.4 Taxonomy of Video World Models
blocks.zh: 4.4 视频世界模型分类学

blocks.en:
A video world model performs the interacting operation of Definition with a video-centered state.
Unlike a general video generator, which aims at plausible content, it learns how that state evolves.
We exclude models whose primary persistent state is an explicit 3D structure, such as a neural field, 3D Gaussians, or an occupancy grid, as well as purely symbolic or text-based world models; models that keep 3D structure only as auxiliary memory for a video-centered state remain in scope (Section 8.2.2 ).
World models from model-based reinforcement learning are included only when their state is learned from video.
blocks.zh:
一个视频世界模型用以视频为中心的状态进行"定义"的互动操作.
与一般的视频生成器不同,它旨在提供可信的内容,它学习这种状态是如何演变的.
我们排除了那些主要持续状态是明显的3D结构的模型,如神经外域,3D高斯人,或占用网格,以及纯粹的象征性或以文字为基础的世界模型;那些只保留3D结构作为以视频为中心的状态的辅助内存的模型仍然在范围(第8.2.2节).
只有在从视频中学习到其状态时,才包括来自模型强化学习的世界模型。

blocks.en:
We classify video world models along two independent axes.
On the first axis, the prediction space , observation-space models predict future frames, video tokens, or generative latents decoded to video, as GAIA Hu et al., 2023 ; Russell et al., 2025 and EVA Chi et al., 2024 do.
Although VAE latents are not pixels, predicting them for decoding to video still counts as observation-space prediction. Latent-state models instead predict future video-derived features that need not be decoded to video: V-JEPA Bardes et al., 2024 and V-JEPA 2 Assran et al., 2025 learn such features by masked feature prediction, which serves as pretraining for latent transition models (Section 8 ), and DINO-WM Zhou et al., 2025a and V-JEPA 2-AC add action-conditioned transitions for planning.
The second axis, the transition interface , describes how controls reach the model. Passive models predict from observations alone, while action-conditioned models receive a control sequence fixed before rollout, such as the ego trajectories of Vista Gao et al., 2024a or the robot actions of IRASim Zhu et al., 2025 . Interactive models accept new controls during rollout, so each input can change what follows, as in GameNGen Valevski et al., 2025 , Genie 2 Parker-Holder et al., 2024 , and related playable simulators Alonso et al., 2024 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025g ; He et al., 2025a .
Section 8 reviews each cell of the resulting 2 × 3 2\times 3 grid (Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh:
我们沿着两个独立轴线对视频世界模型进行分类.
在一轴上,预测空间、观测-空间模型预测未来帧、视频信号或基因潜伏物解码为视频,如GAIA Hu等,2023;Russell等,2025和EVA Chi等, 2024 do. (中文(简体) ).
虽然VAE潜伏物不是像素,但预测它们解码到视频时仍算作观测-空间预测. 未来视频衍生的功能不需要解码为视频: V-JEPA Bardes等人,2024年和V-JEPA 2 Assran等人,2025年,通过蒙面特征预测来学习这些特征,这是潜在过渡模型的先行训练(第8节),DINO-WM Zhou等人,2025a和V-JEPA 2-AC为规划增加了行动条件过渡。
第二个轴,即过渡接口,描述了控制如何到达模型. 被动模型仅从观测中预测出,而动作条件模型则在推出前得到固定的控制序列,例如Vista Gao等的自负轨迹,2024a或IRASim Zhu等的机器人动作,2025. 互动模型在推出时接受新控制,因此每个输入都可以改变以下内容,如GameNgen Valevski等,2025年,Genie 2 Parker-Holder等,2024年,以及相關可玩仿真器 阿隆索等人, 2024; Bruce等, 2024; Zhang等, 2025g; He等, 2025a.
第8节审查了结果的2×3 2\times 3网格的每个单元格(图10)。

blocks.en: 5 Video Comprehension: Reading the World
blocks.zh: 5 视频解析: 阅读世界

blocks.en: Reading means inferring world content, structure, dynamics, physics, and causality from partial video traces.
blocks.zh: 阅读指从部分视频痕迹中推断出世界内容,结构,动态,物理,和因果关系.

blocks.en:
Video comprehension performs the reading operation V → W V\rightarrow W of Section 3 : given a trace V V , the model estimates properties of the latent world W W that produced it.
From a limited viewpoint and interval, it must recover which entities and events are present, where they are, how they change, which constraints govern that change, and what may have caused it.
Occlusion, camera motion, editing, sparse sampling, and missing modalities leave much of this state unobserved, and the viewing scenarios of Section 4.1 change how much evidence must be selected and remembered.
Sections 5.1 – 5.5 cover tasks and benchmarks, encoders, Video-LLMs, agents, and applications in turn.
Tang et al. Tang et al., 2026a survey Video-LLMs in more detail; here we organize the evaluation of reading by the world properties it tests (Section 5.1 ) and review Video-LLMs as one stage of the reading pipeline.
blocks.zh:
视频理解进行第3节的读取操作V → W V\rightarrow W:给一个微量V V,模型估计产生它的潜在世界W W的属性.
从有限的观点和时间间隔来看,它必须恢复哪些实体和事件存在,它们在哪里,它们是如何变化的,哪些制约制约着这种变化,以及造成这种变化的原因。
隐蔽性、相机运动、编辑、少量采样和缺失模式使这种状态大都无法观察,第4.1节的取景情况改变了必须选择和记住多少证据。
第5.1至5.5节涵盖任务和基准、编码器、视频-LLMS、代理机和应用程序。
唐等编. Tang等,2026a调查 Video-LLMs 更详细;在这里,我们组织评估它测试的世界属性(第5.1节)的读取,并审查Video-LLMs 作为读取管道的一个阶段.

blocks.en: 5.1 Tasks, Data, and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 任务、数据和评价

blocks.en:
We organize video-understanding tasks by the main dimension of world state they require: semantic (entities, actions, events), spatial (location, identity, layout, viewpoint), temporal (order, duration, boundaries, long-range dependencies), physical (contact, gravity, containment, material behavior), and causal (effects, interventions, counterfactuals).
The dimensions interact, as when tracking combines identity with temporal continuity, so Table 4 places each benchmark under the dimension it mainly tests, even when the text introduces it elsewhere.
Output format is a separate axis: a label, span, mask, or sentence can probe any dimension, and what a benchmark measures depends on the evidence needed to produce its output.
blocks.zh:
我们按它们需要的世界状态的主要方面组织视频理解任务:语义(实体,行动,事件),空间(位置,身份,布局,观点),时间(顺序,持续时间,边界,长距离依赖),物理(接触,重力,约束,物质行为)和因果关系(影响,干预,反事实).
维度相互作用,如在跟踪将身份与时间连续性相结合时,所以表4将每个基准置于它主要测试的维度之下,即使文本引入了别处.
输出格式是一个单独的轴:一个标签,跨度,遮罩,或句子可以探测出任何维度,什么基准度量取决于输出所需的证据.

blocks.en: Table 4: Video-understanding benchmarks organized by the primary world-state property tested. A benchmark may probe more than one dimension.
blocks.zh: 表4:经测试的主要世界财产组织的视频理解基准。 一个基准可能探测一个以上的维度。

blocks.en:
Aggregate accuracy does not show that a model used the intended evidence, since many questions can be answered from the text, a single frame, or static appearance.
Text-only, single-frame, shuffled-order, and restricted-context baselines expose these shortcuts, and TempCore Ok & Lee, 2025 and Video-Index Song et al., 2026 use them to filter existing benchmarks down to vision-dependent, order-sensitive subsets.
Minimal pairs of near-identical videos with different answers block appearance-only solutions (TimeBlind Li et al., 2026 , MVP Krojer et al., 2025 ).
blocks.zh:
聚合精度并不能表明一个模型使用了所想出的证据,因为很多问题可以从文字中解答,单个框架,或者静态外观.
仅以文字为主,单帧,洗牌为主,并有限制的文字基线会暴露出这些快捷键,而TempCore Ok & Lee, 2025 and Video-Index Song等,2026年使用这些快捷键将已存在的基准过滤到依赖视觉,对顺序敏感的子集.
最小对有不同答案的相近同声视频阻断了只出现解决方案(TimeBlind Li等,2026年;MVP克罗杰等,2025年.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Semantic Understanding
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 语义理解

blocks.en:
Semantic understanding identifies the entities, actions, events, and relations that make a video meaningful.
Action recognition is the most established semantic task: UCF101 Soomro et al., 2012 and HMDB51 Kuehne et al., 2011 test closed-set recognition in trimmed clips, Kinetics Kay et al., 2017 scales up the number and diversity of classes, and Something-Something Goyal et al., 2017 makes labels depend on how objects change under manipulation.
Language moves the output beyond fixed categories through retrieval (MSR-VTT Xu et al., 2016 ), captioning (VATEX Wang et al., 2019 , YouCook2 Zhou et al., 2018 ), and video question answering (VideoQA: ActivityNet-QA Yu et al., 2019 , TVQA Lei et al., 2018 , TGIF-QA Jang et al., 2017 ).
blocks.zh:
语义理解可以识别出让视频有意义的实体,行动,事件和关系.
动作识别是最固定的语义任务:UCF101 Soomro等,2012年和HMDB51 Kuehne等,2011年 三相剪辑中的测试闭塞识别,Kinetics Kay等,2017年 提升了类数和多样性,Something-Something Goyal等,2017年 使取名取决于物体在被操纵下的变化.
语言通过检索(MSR-VTT Xu等,2016年),标题(VATEX Wang等,2019年;YouCook2)将输出移出固定类别之外. 周等,2018年),并视频问答(视频QA:活动网-QA). Yu等,2019年,TVQA Lei等人,2018年,TGIF-QA Jang等人,2017年.

blocks.en:
Recent Video-LLM benchmarks mix semantic questions with temporal, spatial, and knowledge-intensive items (Video-MME and Video-MME-v2 Fu et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 , MMVU Zhao et al., 2025a , Video-MMMU Hu et al., 2026c ; Luo et al., 2026 ).
Hallucination benchmarks test whether the reported content is supported by the video at all: VideoHallucer Wang et al., 2024g ; Luo et al., 2026c uses adversarially paired questions, EventHallusion Zhang et al., 2024 probes events suggested by language priors, and ARGUS Rawal et al., 2025 scores hallucination and omission in free-form captions.
blocks.zh:
近期的Video-LLM基准将语义问题与时间、空间和知识密集型项目相混合(Video-MME和Video-MME-v2 Fu等,2025;Fu等,2026;MMVU) 赵等,2025a,视频-MMU 胡等,2026c;罗等,2026.
迷幻基准测试所报道的内容是否得到了视频的支持: 视频Hallucer Wang等人, 2024g;Luo等人, 2026c 使用对等对等的问题, EventHallusion Zhang等人, 2024 探查语言前辈建议的事件, ARGUS Rawal等人, 2025 评分 自由格式标题中的幻觉和遗漏.

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Spatial Understanding
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 空间理解

blocks.en:
Spatial understanding asks where entities are, how their extent changes, and whether their identity persists as viewpoint and visibility vary.
Spatiotemporal grounding links a referring expression to a region tube over an interval (VidSTG Zhang et al., 2020 ).
Video object segmentation tracks pixel masks (DAVIS Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 , YouTube-VOS Xu et al., 2018 ), referring variants select the target by language or motion (Ref-YouTube-VOS Seo et al., 2020 , MeViS Ding et al., 2023 ; addressed by ReferFormer Wu et al., 2022 ), and MOTChallenge Milan et al., 2016 and LaSOT Fan et al., 2019 test identity across occlusion and reappearance.
Memory-based and promptable trackers such as XMem Cheng & Schwing, 2022 , AOT Yang et al., 2021 , DEVA Cheng et al., 2023 , and SAM 2 Ravi et al., 2025 keep earlier evidence as the target changes appearance or disappears.
blocks.zh:
空间理解询问实体在哪里,其程度如何变化,其特性是否因观点和能见度而持续存在。
Spatiotemporal rounding将一个参考表达式连接到一个相隔的区管上(VidSTG Zhang等,2020.).
视频对象分割轨道像素口罩(DAVIS Pont-Tuset等,2017.,YouTube-VOS) ),参考变体按语言或运动选择目标(Ref-YouTube-VOS Seo等,2020年;MeViS). Ding等, 2023;由Reformer Wu等, 2022年)和MOTChallenge Milan等, 2016年;LaSOT Fan等, 2019年测试身份跨越隔离和再现.
基于记忆的快速跟踪器,如XMem Cheng & Schwing, 2022, AOT Yang等人,2021年,DEVA Cheng等,2023年;而SAM 2 Ravi等,2025年,随着目标改变外观或消失,保留了更早的证据.

blocks.en:
Spatial reasoning benchmarks go beyond masks and tracks: VSI-Bench Yang et al., 2025b and MMSI-Video-Bench Lin et al., 2025a test relative position, viewpoint, and layout, STI-Bench Li et al., 2025j asks for quantitative pose and motion, and DSI-Bench Zhang et al., 2025i separates observer motion from object motion.
A newer group tests state that is out of view: SCP-Bench Zhao et al., 2026b infers unseen past or future layouts, Beyond3D Ma et al., 2026 asks where relocated objects now are, and OVO-S-Bench Li et al., 2026i answers from the video prefix seen so far.
These tasks test the object permanence and revisit consistency that world models must maintain (Section 8.2.2 ).
blocks.zh:
空间推理基准超越口罩和轨迹:VSI-Bench Yang等,2025b和MMSI-Video-Bench Lin等,2025a测试相对位置,观点和布局,STI-Bench Li等,2025j要求量化姿势和运动,DSI-Bench Zhang等,2025i将观察者运动与物体运动分开.
较新的群试状态出局: SCP-Bench Zhao等, 2026b推断未知的过去或未来的布局, Beyond3D Ma et al., 2026问现在迁移的物体在哪里,而OVO-S-Bench Li et al., 2026i从迄今看到的视频前缀中解答.
这些任务考验物体的持久性并重新审视世界模型必须保持的一致性(第8.2.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.1.3 Temporal Understanding
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 时间理解

blocks.en:
Temporal understanding recovers when an event occurs, how long it lasts, and how evidence at different moments is ordered or connected.
Temporal action detection locates predefined actions in untrimmed video (THUMOS Idrees et al., 2017 , ActivityNet Heilbron et al., 2015 ), and moment retrieval returns the segment that matches a language query (Charades-STA Gao et al., 2017 , QVHighlights Lei et al., 2021 , DiDeMo Hendricks et al., 2017 ).
Dense event captioning localizes and describes possibly overlapping events (ActivityNet Captions Krishna et al., 2017 , addressed end to end by Vid2Seq Yang et al., 2023 ), and anticipation predicts an action not yet observed (e.g., Ego4D forecasting Grauman et al., 2022 ).
blocks.zh:
时间性理解在事件发生时恢复,持续多久,在不同时刻如何命令证据或如何连接.
Timoral 动作检测在未切入的视频中定位预先定义的动作(THUMOS Idrees等,2017年;ActivityNet Heilbron等,2015年),瞬间检索返回匹配语言查询的段(Charades-STA Gao等,2017年;QV高亮) Lei等,2021年; DiDeMo Hendricks等,2017年.
Dense事件对本地化进行描述并描述可能重叠的事件(ActivityNet Captions Krishna等,2017年,由Vid2Seq Yang等发表,2023年),并预测一项尚未观测到的行动(如Ego4D预测Grauman等,2022年).

blocks.en:
Fine-grained and long-form benchmarks stress subtle temporal differences and sparse evidence.
TemporalBench Cai et al., 2024 and TempCompass Liu et al., 2024d test ordering, speed, and direction, TimeBlind Li et al., 2026 pairs videos that differ only in temporal structure, and Video-MME-Logical Kwan et al., 2026 separates logical complexity from scene recognition.
MLVU Zhou et al., 2025b , LVBench Wang et al., 2025c , and LongVideoBench Wu et al., 2024 pose heterogeneous questions over long videos, and VideoOdyssey He et al., 2026 extends this to ultra-long, omni-modal video, measuring how much context stays usable as evidence length grows.
blocks.zh:
精细和长式的基准强调微妙的时间差异和稀少的证据。
临时奔驰 Cai等人,2024年和TempCompass Liu等,2024d测试订购,速度,和方向,TimeBlind Li等,2026对仅以时间结构相异的视频,而Video-MME-Logical Kwan等,2026对逻辑复杂性与场景识别进行了区分.
萨尔瓦多 Zhou等,2025b;LV Bench Wang等,2025c;Long Video Bench Wu等人,2024年在长相视频中提出了各种各样的问题,而VideoOdyssey He等人,2026年将这个问题扩展至超长的全方位模式视频,衡量随着证据长度的增大,上下文还能用到多少.

blocks.en:
Streaming benchmarks make state maintenance directly observable.
SVCBench Liu et al., 2026d asks for running object and event counts at many points in a video, TRACE Ma et al., 2026a scores answer quality together with latency, false alarms, and missed responses under causal input, and StreamingEval Tang et al., 2026 adds encoding throughput, time to first token, and a fixed memory budget.
blocks.zh:
简化基准可以直接观测到国家的维护。
SVCBench 自动取款机 刘等,"2026d"在视频中要求运行对象和事件计数在多分点,TRACE Ma等,"2026a"分数答质量与耐久性,假警报,和因果输入中错过的响应,"StreamingEval Tang等","2026"增加了编码吞吐量,时间到第一地标,以及固定的内存预算.

blocks.en: 5.1.4 Physical Understanding
blocks.zh: 5.1.4 实际理解

blocks.en:
Physical understanding concerns how a visible state can change under constraints that are often only partly observed.
Plausibility benchmarks ask whether an observed transition is possible: IntPhys Riochet et al., 2022 and IntPhys 2 Bordes et al., 2025 test object permanence and intuitive physics, ImplausiBench Motamed et al., 2025 contains videos that violate expected physical behavior, and Physion Bear et al., 2021 instead asks whether objects will make contact.
Other benchmarks ask for next states, interaction outcomes, or the mechanism behind a change.
CLEVRER Yi et al., 2020 asks descriptive, predictive, and explanatory questions about collisions, while PhysicsMind Mak et al., 2026 , PhysBench Chow et al., 2025 , and PAI-Bench-U Zhou et al., 2026 broaden coverage to object properties, commonsense constraints, task completion, and next actions.
APT Wu et al., 2026a further labels timestamped transitions by mechanism (contact, gravity, or friction).
blocks.zh:
实际理解涉及可见状态如何在常常只是部分观察到的制约下发生改变。
透明性基准询问能否实现观察到的过渡: ItPhys Riochet等,2022年和IntPhys 2 Bordes等,2025年测试物体的持久性和直觉物理,Implausi Bench Motamed等,2025年包含违反预期物理行为的视频,而Physion Bear等,2021年则询问物体是否会发生接触.
其他基准要求下一个国家、互动结果或变革背后的机制。
克莱尔 Yi等人,2020年,提出了关于碰撞的描述性、预测性和解释性问题,而PhysicsMind Mak等人,2026年,Phys Bench Chow等人,2025年和PAI-Bench-U Zhou等,2026拓宽了涵盖对象属性,常识约束,任务完成等下一步行动.
亚太 Wu等人,2026a进一步以机制(接触,重力,或摩擦)标出时间戳的过渡.

blocks.en:
Two benchmarks check that answers rest on physical evidence rather than priors.
MVP Krojer et al., 2025 pairs near-identical videos that require opposite answers, and VisPhyWorld Liang et al., 2026a asks the model to rebuild the scene as executable simulator code so that its physical hypothesis can be checked.
Physics benchmarks for generated video, such as Physics-IQ Motamed et al., 2026 and VideoPhy Bansal et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2026 , are covered in Sections 6.1.2 and 8.4 .
blocks.zh:
有两项基准检查,答案取决于物证而不是前科。
流动人口调查 Krojer等,2025对需要相反答案的相近同声视频,而VisPhyWorld Liang等,2026a则要求模型将场景重建为可执行模拟器代码,以检查其物理假说.
生成视频的物理基准,如Physics-IQ Motamed等人,2026年和Video Phy Bansal等人,2025;Bansal等人,2026;见6.1.2和8.4节。

blocks.en: 5.1.5 Causal Understanding
blocks.zh: 5.1.5 因果关系

blocks.en:
Causal understanding asks why an observed event occurred and how the outcome would change if an action, object, or condition were different.
On synthetic collisions, CLEVRER Yi et al., 2020 adds counterfactual questions to its explanatory ones.
Real-world and procedural benchmarks link actions to effects that may appear much later: NExT-QA Xiao et al., 2021 and STAR Wu et al., 2021 ask about event relations and reasons, Video-Holmes Cheng et al., 2026 and Causal2Needles Li et al., 2025f spread the clues far apart, and CaST-Bench Zhang et al., 2026h covers more varied settings and causal structures.
Counterfactual benchmarks test altered outcomes directly: CausalVQA Foss et al., 2025 asks counterfactual, hypothetical, and planning questions about real egocentric video, and DMC-CF Zhang et al., 2026g pairs such questions about real videos with causal-graph interventions, whose regenerated variants also limit data contamination.
blocks.zh:
原因理解询问为什么发生了所观察到的事件,如果一个动作、对象或条件不同,结果会如何改变。
关于合成相撞,CLEVRER Yi等2020年在其解释性问题中增加了反事实问题.
现实世界和程序基准将行动与以后可能出现的效果联系起来:NExT-QA Xiao等,2021年和STAR Wu等, 2021 问事件关系和原因, Video-Holmes Cheng等, 2026 和 Causal2 Needles Li等,2025f将线索相去甚远,而CaST-Bench Zhang等,2026h 涵盖了更多不同的设置和因果结构.
反事实基准测试直接改变的结果:CausalVQA Foss等, 2025 问关于真实自我中心视频的反事实,假设,和规划问题, DMC-CF Zhang等, 2026g 将真实视频的此类问题与因果图干预相配, 其再生变体也限制了数据被污染.

blocks.en: 5.2 Video Representation Learning and Encoding
blocks.zh: 5.2 视频代表学习和编码

blocks.en:
Video representation learning maps frames to features that can be reused across recognition, retrieval, grounding, reasoning, and multimodal modeling.
Convolutional backbones such as I3D Carreira & Zisserman, 2017 and SlowFast Feichtenhofer et al., 2019 established supervised spatiotemporal processing, and TimeSformer Bertasius et al., 2021 , ViViT Arnab et al., 2021 , and Video Swin Liu et al., 2022 carried the Vision Transformer Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 to video at different spatial and temporal scales.
The pretraining objective decides what these backbones retain, and we group objectives by their dominant supervision signal into the four families of Figure 3 .
The families overlap: masked feature prediction, for instance, is both masked and predictive.
Variational autoencoders and tokenizers built for synthesis are covered in Section 6 .
blocks.zh:
视频表达式学习地图框架,用于可跨识别、检索、地面、推理和多模式模式再利用的特征。
I3D Carreira & Zisserman, 2017年和SlowFast Feichtenhofer等人, 2019年等革命骨干建立了受监督的瞬间处理, TimeSformer Bertasius等人, 2021年, ViViT Arnab等,2021年;和Video Swin Liu等,2022年将"Vision Transformer Dosovitskiy等",2021年载入不同时空尺度的视频.
训练前的目标决定了这些骨干所保留的内容,我们通过他们的主导监督信号将目标组合到图3的四个家族中。
家庭重叠:例如,蒙面特征预测既蒙面又能预测。
用于合成的可变自编码器和活化器载于第6节。

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Four families of video representation learning.
They differ in how supervision targets are constructed and how predictions are compared with or generated from those targets.
blocks.zh:
图3:四个家庭的视频代理学习。
在如何构建监督目标以及如何与这些目标进行比较或产生预测方面,它们各不相同。

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Contrastive Learning
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 矛盾学习

blocks.en:
Contrastive learning pulls positive pairs together in embedding space and pushes mismatched pairs apart, commonly with an InfoNCE-style objective.
In video-only learning, CVRL Qian et al., 2021 and ρ \rho MoCo Feichtenhofer et al., 2021 draw positives from augmentations or clips of the same video, and the sampling distance sets a trade-off: views too close give little contrast, while views too far apart may show different events.
blocks.zh:
相矛盾的学习在嵌入空间中拉出正对并推出相不匹配的对相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
在只录相的学习中,CVRL Qian等,2021年和^rho MoCo Feichtenhofer等,2021年 从同段视频的增强或剪辑中抽取正数,采样距离设定了取舍:观点过于相近给出的对比不大,而观点相去过远可能显示出不同的事件.

blocks.en:
Video–text contrastive learning pairs clips with language.
Among dual-encoder retrieval models, Frozen in Time Bain et al., 2021 trains a space–time Transformer jointly on image–text and video–text pairs, and CLIP4Clip Luo et al., 2022 transfers the CLIP image–text encoder and adds temporal aggregation, while VideoCLIP Xu et al., 2021 , X-CLIP Ma et al., 2022 , ViCLIP Wang et al., 2024c , and Finsta Fei et al., 2024b develop video-specific alignment.
Foundation encoders combine contrastive pretraining with masked or generative losses (InternVideo Wang et al., 2022a , InternVideo2 Wang et al., 2024d ), distillation into a masked-video student (VideoPrism Zhao et al., 2024 ), or later alignment stages for language and dense prediction (Perception Encoder Bolya et al., 2025 ).
Global alignment can drop fine-grained detail: the World Embedding Benchmark Liu et al., 2026j shows that alignment and recoverable physical state can diverge, as physics-specific contrastive tuning improves video–text matching but weakens physical-quantity regression from frozen features; the added losses aim to retain it.
blocks.zh:
视频 - 文本对比性学习片段与语言相配.
在双编码器检索模型中,Frozen in Time Bain et al., 2021 在图像-文本和视频-文本对上联合培训了一款时空变换器,以及 CLIP4Clip Luo et al., 2022 传输 CLIP 图像-文本编码器并添加时空聚合,而 VideoCLIP Xu等,2021年;X-CLIP Ma等,2022年;ViCLIP Wang等,2024c,和芬斯塔 Fei et al., 2024b 开发视频专用对接.
基金会编码器将对比性预训与蒙面或基因损失相结合(InternVideo Wang等,2022a;InternVideo2 Wang等,2024d;蒸馏成蒙面-视频学生(VideoPrism Zhao等,2024;),或后来语言和密集预测的相接阶段(Perception Encoder Bolya等,2025.).
全球对齐可以降低精细的细节:世界嵌入基准Liu等人,2026年j 显示,对齐和可恢复的物理状态可以相去甚远,因为物理学特定的对比性调和可以改善视频-文本匹配,但会削弱从被冻结的特性中物理-数量回归;增加的损失旨在保留它。

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Masked Learning
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 蒙面学习

blocks.en:
Masked learning removes much of the spatiotemporal input and trains the model to recover it, an idea that VideoBERT Sun et al., 2019 applied early to quantized video tokens and speech transcripts jointly.
VideoMAE Tong et al., 2022 reconstructs pixels behind tube masks, with a high mask ratio that exploits the redundancy of adjacent frames, and VideoMAE-V2 Wang et al., 2023 scales it with dual masking.
Feature targets replace raw pixels: MaskFeat Wei et al., 2022 reconstructs handcrafted or learned features, and UMT Li et al., 2023a distills from an unmasked teacher that sees the full clip.
Learned or teacher targets shift capacity from low-level appearance toward the semantics and motion that the teacher encodes, but they also inherit its biases.
blocks.zh:
蒙面学习可以删除许多spatiotemporal输入,并训练模型以恢复它,这个想法是VideoBERT Sun等,2019年 提前申请,联合量化视频符和语音记录.
视频 Tong等,2022年重建管口罩后像素,口罩比高,能利用相邻相邻相框的冗余,而VideoMAE-V2 Wang等,2023年以双重口罩来缩放.
特性目标替换原始像素 : 遮盖Feat Wei等,2022年重建了手工或被学习的特征,而UMT Li等,2023a蒸馏出自一位看穿了完整片段的未化妆师.
学习或老师的目标将能力从低级外观转向老师所编码的语义和运动,但他们也继承了它的偏见.

blocks.en: 5.2.3 Predictive Learning
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 预测性学习

blocks.en:
Predictive learning trains a model to predict the latent representation of hidden or future content, without pixel reconstruction or negative examples.
V-JEPA Bardes et al., 2024 predicts the features of masked regions against a slowly updated target encoder, V-JEPA 2 Assran et al., 2025 scales this to larger and more diverse data, and V-JEPA 2.1 Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 improves dense features.
InternVideo-Next Wang et al., 2026 bridges the masked and predictive families, combining masked reconstruction with latent prediction of its first-stage targets, without video–text data.
Adding an action-conditioned transition model to such a representation yields the action-conditioned latent-state world models of Section 8 .
blocks.zh:
预测性学习训练一种模型,以预测隐藏内容或未来内容的潜在表现,而无需像素重建或负面实例.
V-JEPA(美国) Bardes等,2024年预测了被遮蔽区域对慢更新的目标编码器的特征,V-JEPA 2 Assran等,2025年将其规模化为更大更多样化的数据,而V-JEPA 2.1 Mur-Labadia等,2026年改进了密度特征.
实习录像 Wang et al., 2026 将被蒙住和预测的家庭相接, 将被蒙住的重建与对第一阶段目标的潜在预测结合起来,
在这种代表性中增加一个有行动条件的过渡模式,产生第8节有行动条件的潜在状态世界模式。

blocks.en: 5.2.4 Generative Learning
blocks.zh: 5.2.4 基因学习

blocks.en:
Generative pretraining shapes a representation by requiring it to produce missing or future content.
Visual autoregressive objectives Yan et al., 2021 predict future frames, patches, or tokens, which rewards sensitivity to appearance and motion but can spend capacity on reconstruction detail that recognition does not need.
Vision-language generation outputs text instead: GIT-style Wang et al., 2022 training generates captions or answers from visual features, and VideoCoCa Yan et al., 2022 combines captioning with contrastive alignment.
In both cases, the representation is shaped only by what captions describe.
Large video diffusion models offer a third route: Gen4U King et al., 2026 reuses a frozen generator’s intermediate activations for classification, geometry, and captioning, and GenCeption Wang et al., 2026c adapts a diffusion backbone into a text-steered model for depth, normals, pose, segmentation, and keypoints (Section 7.2 ).
blocks.zh:
基因预训通过要求它产生缺失或未来内容来塑造一种表现.
视觉自旋目标 Yan et al., 2021预测未来帧,补丁,或指使,奖励外观和运动的敏感性,但可以将能力花在重建细节上,而这种识别并不需要.
愿景生成产出文本: GIT 风格 Wang et al., 2022年培训从视觉功能中生成字幕或解答,而VideoCoCa Yan等,2022年将字幕与对比对齐结合起来.
在这两种情况下,代表只由标题来决定。
大型视频传播模型提供了第三条路线:GEN4U King等人,2026年对被冻结的发电机的中间活化进行再利用,用于分类、几何和标题,GenCeption Wang等人,2026c年将扩散骨干调整为深度、常态、姿势、分块和关键点的文本化模型(第7.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Video-Language Foundation Modeling
blocks.zh: 5.3 视频语言基金会建模

blocks.en:
Video-LLMs extend language foundation models to video for open-ended description, dialogue, question answering, grounding, and reasoning.
They take visual features from encoders such as those in Section 5.2 and must decide which frames to observe, how to encode time, and how many visual tokens the language model can afford.
We review their architectures, training, and test-time scaling in turn.
blocks.zh:
Video-LLMS将语言基础模型扩展至视频,用于开放式描述,对话,问答,地基和推理.
它们从第5.2节等编码器中取出视觉特征,必须决定要观察的帧,如何编码时间,以及语言模型能承受多少视觉符号.
我们依次审查它们的架构、培训和测试时间的缩放。

blocks.en: 5.3.1 Architectures

Visual front end. Many systems apply an image encoder such as CLIP Radford et al., 2021 or SigLIP Zhai et al., 2023 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 to sampled frames, a route that is cheap and semantically strong but leaves temporal modeling to later modules.
Native-video encoders Assran et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 model local motion before fusion, and direct patch or visual-token inputs keep finer spatial detail at a higher context cost.
No encoder can recover an event from an unsampled frame.
blocks.zh:
视觉前端. 许多系统应用了图像编码器,如CLIP Radford等,2021年或SigLIP Zhai等, 2023; Tschannn等, 2025 至采样帧, 这条路线便宜而有体力,但将时间模型留给后期模块.
原生视频编码器 Assran等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2026年聚变前的局部运动模型,以及直接的补丁或可视化输入保持更细的空间细节,其上下文成本更高.
任何编码器都无法从无样本的框架中恢复一个事件.

blocks.en:
Time and position. Frame order may be encoded by temporal embeddings, timestamps, or multidimensional rotary positions.
Qwen2.5-VL Bai et al., 2025a uses M-RoPE to coordinate temporal and spatial indices, Qwen3-VL Bai et al., 2025 adds textual timestamps so that answers can cite moments, and the InternVL series Wang et al., 2025d advances visual positions in fractional steps so that long sequences stay within the trained positional range.
Temporal Transformers and state-space models such as Mamba Gu & Dao, 2024 can also aggregate frame sequences before they reach the LLM.
blocks.zh:
时间和位置。 框架顺序可以通过时间嵌入,时间戳或多维旋转位置来编码.
倒数 Bai等,2025a使用M-ROPE来协调时间和空间指数,Qune3-VL Bai等,2025年增加了文字时间戳,以便回答可以引用瞬间,而InternVL系列Wang等,2025d则以分分步推进视觉位置,使长序停留在被训练的位置范围内.
Temperal Transformers and state-space models 如:Mamba Gu & Dao, 2024 在达到LLM前也可以聚合帧序列.

blocks.en:
Vision-language connector. The connector maps visual features into the language backbone’s embedding space and token budget.
Linear or MLP projectors turn each visual feature into a prefix token, as in LLaVA-style systems Liu et al., 2023 , while Q-Former and resampler designs Li et al., 2023 extract a fixed number of query tokens, as in early Video-LLaMA Zhang et al., 2023 and VideoChat Li et al., 2025e .
Gated cross-attention, as in Flamingo Alayrac et al., 2022 , instead lets language layers consult visual features at selected depths.
Structure-preserving compressors downsample while keeping spatial layout, through convolutional abstractors (Honeybee Cha et al., 2024 ), spatial-temporal convolution (VideoLLaMA 2 Cheng et al., 2024 ), or pixel unshuffle (InternVL Wang et al., 2025d ).
Projectors keep the most direct token path, resamplers and cross-attention give the most control over how much visual information enters the LLM, and compressors trade some directness for locality-aware reduction.
blocks.zh:
视觉语言连接器. 连接器将视觉特征映射入语言主干线的嵌入空间和符号预算.
线性或 MLP 投影器将每个视觉特性变成前缀符号, 如 LLAVA 风格系统 刘等,2023年;而Q-Former和再版设计师李等,2023年取出固定数量的查询符,如早期Video-LLaMA Zhang等,2023和Video 查特·李等,2025e.
Gated cross-attention, 如Flaminggo Alayrac等, 2022年, 转而让语言层在所选深度参考视觉特征.
结构保留式压缩机在保持空间布局的同时通过回旋抽象器(Honeybee Cha等,2024年),空间-时相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
投影机保留最直接的符号路径,再装模作样和交叉意向给多少可视化信息进入LLM的最大控制,而压缩机则交易一些可被地方意识所降低的直接性.

blocks.en:
Compression and memory. Video token count grows with both the number of frames and the tokens per frame, and pooling, merging, or resampling reduce it at the risk of erasing small objects, short events, or precise timestamps.
Some designs spend tokens unevenly over time: LLaVA-Video Zhang et al., 2025h keeps a few frames dense and pools the rest, Keye-VL-1.5 Yang et al., 2025 routes frames with large visual change to a high-resolution pathway, and LLaVA-OneVision-2 An et al., 2026a groups tokens adaptively like a video codec.
Others compress each unit: Chat-UniVi Jin et al., 2024 merges tokens into dynamic multi-scale units, LLaMA-VID Li et al., 2024c reduces each frame to as few as two tokens, and Video-LaVIT Jin et al., 2024a pairs keyframes with compact motion vectors.
For long video, LongVA Zhang et al., 2025d and LongVILA Chen et al., 2025f rely on long-context transfer and token budgeting, and Video-XL Shu et al., 2025 adds structured compression.
One finding bounds this design space: a few tokens carry most of the discriminative information, but finding them without an oracle is hard Hao et al., 2025 .
Memory solves a different problem from compression: MovieChat Song et al., 2024 and MA-LMM He et al., 2024 maintain a memory of past segments, which decides what remains available after the original frames leave the context (agent memory is treated in Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh:
压缩与记忆. 视频令牌计数随着帧数和每个相框的令牌数同时增加而增加,而集合,合并,或再被复制则会减少其被去除小物体,短事件,或精确的时间戳等风险.
有些设计在时间上花得不均匀:LLaVA-Video Kye-VL-1.5 Yang等,2025年 2025年 2025年 2025年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2018年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2018年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 2017年 年 2017年 2017年 2017年 年 2018 年 年 年 年 2017 2017年 2017年 年 年 年 年 2017年 年 年 20 An等,2026a群相会以适应性地表示出像视频编码器.
其他压缩每个单元: Chat-UniVi Jin等,2024年将活字符号合并为动态多尺度单位,LLaMA-VID Li等,2024c将每个帧缩小到以两个符号为多,而Video-LaVIT Jin等,2024a对键框带有紧凑运动向量.
长相视频,长相VA 张等,2025d和LongVILA Chen等,2025f 依赖长文本的传输和象征性的预算编制,而Video-XL Shu等,2025 增加了结构压缩.
一个发现约束了这个设计空间:少数信使携带着大部分歧视信息,
内存解决了与压缩不同的问题: 电影 Chat Song等人,2024年和MA-LMM 他等,2024年保持了过去段的记忆,它决定了原始帧离开上下文后仍然有哪些可用(代理记忆在第5.4节中处理).

blocks.en:
Language backbone and output. An instruction-following LLM combines the retained evidence with the query and produces dialogue, descriptions, explanations, or structured predictions.
Early systems extended image-language models to video with adapters and compressed frame tokens Zhang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025e ; Maaz et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024c , and later open models add larger multimodal mixtures, more efficient video tokens, and grounded or reasoning outputs Li et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025a ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025d ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026g .
Boxes, timestamps, and masks can be emitted as special tokens or by attached heads, which makes the evidence behind an answer easier to inspect.
Closed systems such as Gemini Team et al., 2024 show strong long-context video and audio results but disclose few design details.
Table 5 lists the encoder, connector, and LLM of representative open systems and what each training stage updates.
blocks.zh:
语言骨干与输出. 遵循指令的 LLM 将保留的证据与查询结合起来,生成对话,描述,解释,或结构化的预测.
早期系统将图像语言模型扩展至带有适配器和压缩帧符号的视频 Zhang等,2023;Li等,2025e;Maaz等,2024;Lin等,2024;Li等,2024c;后来的开放型号会添加更大的多式混合物,更有效的视频标志,以及被禁用或推理输出. Li等,2025;Bai等,2025a;Bai等,2025;Wang等,2025d;Yan等,2026;姚等,2024;张等,2025;Li等,2026g.
盒、时间戳和口罩可作为特殊标志或由相接头来排放,这使回答背后的证据更容易检查。
2024年双子座Team等闭塞系统显示强烈的长文视频和音频结果,但披露的设计细节很少.
表5列出了代表性开放系统的编码器、连接器和LLM以及每个培训阶段的更新内容。

blocks.en:
Streaming and audio-visual input. Streaming models must answer from the evidence seen so far and bound their state with windows, recurrent memory, or key–value (KV) caches.
VideoLLM-online Chen et al., 2024b introduced real-time dialogue over a continuously advancing stream, StreamingVLM Xu et al., 2026a keeps a compact KV cache for unbounded streams, and OneStreamer Zeng et al., 2026a writes timestamped caption memory and learns when to record and when to respond.
For audio-video input, Qwen2.5-Omni Xu et al., 2025 and Qwen3-Omni Xu et al., 2025a place both modalities on one timeline with time-aligned multimodal rotary positions.
blocks.zh:
分流和视听投入。 流出模型必须从迄今看到的证据中解答,并将其状态与窗口、经常性内存或密钥-值(KV)缓存相接。
视频LLM 在线 Chen等人,2024年b,在不断推进的溪流中引入实时对话,StreamingVLM Xu等,2026a为无约束流保留了紧凑的KV缓存,而OneStreamer Zeng等,2026a写出有时间标记的字幕内存并学习何时记录和何时回应.
用于音频视频输入, Quen2.5- Omni 徐等,2025年和Qune3-Omni 徐等,2025年a 将两种模式与时间相匹配的多模式旋转位置置于一个时间表上。
