blocks.en: 5.3.2 Learning Paradigms
blocks.zh: 5.3.2 学习范式

blocks.en:
Video-LLMs are usually trained in stages because the encoder, connector, and language backbone start from different representations.
In alignment pretraining , the encoder and LLM are often frozen while the connector learns from caption pairs, video–text matching, and grounding data, following the visual instruction tuning recipe for images Liu et al., 2023 .
Table 6 lists pair corpora and instruction datasets for this stage and the next.
blocks.zh:
Video-LLMs通常是分阶段训练的,因为编码器,接通器,语言主干从不同的表示开始.
在对齐预训中,编码器和LLM经常被冻结,而连接器则从标题对等、视频文本匹配和地面数据中学习,遵循图像的可视化指令调制谱 刘等,2023.
表6列出了该阶段和下阶段的双子公司和指令数据集.

blocks.en: Table 6: Datasets for Video-LLM pretraining and instruction tuning. Scale retains each source’s counting unit; mixed-modality and image-only auxiliary resources are identified explicitly.
blocks.zh: 表6:视频-LLM预训和教学调试数据集. 缩放保留了每个源的计数单位;明确识别了混合模式和仅图像辅助资源.

blocks.en:
Supervised instruction tuning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) then trains on VideoQA and dialogue data for question-conditioned answers, temporal grounding data for timestamps Qian et al., 2024 , and spatial grounding data for coordinates or other structured outputs.
Which components are updated varies: early Video-ChatGPT Maaz et al., 2024 tunes only its projector, Video-LLaVA Lin et al., 2024 also updates the LLM, and VideoLLaMA3 Zhang et al., 2025 and VideoChat3 Li et al., 2026g adapt both the visual and language components (Table 5 ).
The mixture of image, short-video, long-video, optical character recognition (OCR), and grounding data decides whether a model mainly describes clips or can locate and reason over the evidence behind an answer.
blocks.zh:
监督指导调. 监督的微调(SFT)然后在VideoQA和对话数据上进行测试,以获取问题有条件的答案,时间定位数据用于时间戳 Qian等,2024年,和用于坐标或其他结构化输出的空间地基数据.
哪些组件更新不同: 早期 Video-ChatGPT Maaz 等人, 2024 年只调用它的投影机 Video-LLaVA Lin等,2024也更新了LLM,而VideoLLAMA3 Zhang等,2025和VideoChat3 Li等,2026克同时适应视觉和语言成分(表5.
图像,短视频,长视频,光学字符识别(OCR)和地基数据的混合,决定一个模型是主要描述剪辑还是能够定位和解释一个答案背后的证据.

blocks.en:
Preference optimization and reinforcement learning. Post-training can then optimize preferences or task outcomes.
Reinforcement learning (RL) from human feedback Ouyang et al., 2022 and direct preference optimization, which Qwen2.5-VL Bai et al., 2025a and VistaDPO Huang et al., 2025 apply after SFT, improve visual faithfulness only insofar as the feedback separates grounded content from fluent but unsupported answers.
Reasoning-oriented methods instead use verifiable rewards, often with group relative policy optimization (GRPO) Guo et al., 2025 .
Video-R1 Feng et al., 2025 adds a temporal reward that compares rollouts on ordered and shuffled frames, LongVILA-R1 Chen et al., 2025e scales RL to long videos through its data and distributed training, and OneThinker Feng et al., 2026a broadens the task mixture and normalizes advantages with running per-task reward statistics.
blocks.zh:
优待优化与强化学习. 然后,培训后可以优化偏好或任务结果。
通过人类反馈加强学习 Ouyang等,2022年和直接优化优惠,Quen2.5-VL Bai等,2025a和VistaDPO Huang等人,2025年在SFT之后适用,只有在反馈将有根据的内容与流畅而无支持的答案分开时,才能提高视觉的忠诚度.
以理性为导向的方法取而代之的是使用可核查的奖励,往往采用集团相对政策优化(GPRO) 郭等,2025 (中文(简体) ).
视频-R1 Feng等,2025年增加一个时间奖励,比较订购和洗牌相框的推出情况;LongVILA-R1 Chen等,2025e通过其数据和分布式培训将RL比作长视频;OneThinker Feng等,2026a拓宽了任务混合,使每个任务奖励统计的运行优势正常化.

blocks.en:
Task-specific rewards target the output directly: Time-R1 Wang et al., 2025e rewards timestamp intersection-over-union for temporal grounding, VideoChat-R1 Li et al., 2025h jointly rewards spatiotemporal tasks without hurting general QA, and VideoP2R Jiang et al., 2026a rewards perception and reasoning separately.
Others modify GRPO itself: DeepVideo-R1 Park et al., 2025 recasts it as advantage regression with difficulty-aware augmentation, and GRPO-CARE Chen et al., 2026f adds a bonus if a slowly updated reference model reproduces the answer from the reasoning trace.
blocks.zh:
针对特定任务的奖励直接针对产出: Time-R1 Wang等,2025e 奖励时间戳 交叉结合 时间定位,视频 Chat-R1 Li等,2025h 联合奖励spatiopal任务而不影响一般QA,而VideoP2R Jiang等,2026a 奖励感想和推理分别.
其他修改 GRPO 本身: DeepVideo-R1 Park et al.,2025 将它重新设定为有难度认知增强的优势回归,而GRPO-CARE Chen et al.,2026f 如果一个缓慢更新的参考模型复制了推理跟踪的答案,则会增加奖金.

blocks.en:
Data and scaling. Data and curriculum matter as much as model size.
Current recipes such as InternVideo3 Yan et al., 2026 , Qwen3-VL Bai et al., 2025 , and VideoLLaMA3 Zhang et al., 2025 train jointly on image, video, and language data and widen task coverage with synthetic instructions; InternVideo3 and Qwen3-VL also add long-context curricula and use on-policy distillation to supply responses from states the model actually visits.
Apollo Zohar et al., 2025 studies this design space systematically, measuring how frame sampling, encoder choice, and token allocation interact across model scales.
Newer corpora add finer temporal supervision: OneStreamer-1M Zeng et al., 2026a times its captions and QA to the evidence available at each response point.
blocks.zh:
数据与规模. 数据和课程与模型大小同样重要。
InternVideo3等现行配方 Yan等,2026年,Quen3-VL Bai等人,2025年和VideoLLAMA3 Zhang等,2025年联合进行图像,视频,语言数据培训,并用合成指令来扩大任务覆盖面; InternVideo3和Qune3-VL还增加了长文课程并使用政策上提炼,以提供各州对模型实际访问的回应.
阿波罗·佐哈尔等,2025年系统研究了这个设计空间,测量了帧取样,编码器选择,和符号分配如何在模型尺度之间相互作用.
新公司增加精细的时间监督: OneStreamer-1M (英语). Zeng等人,是其标题的2026a倍和每个答复点现有证据的质量保证。

blocks.en: 5.3.3 Test-Time Scaling
blocks.zh: 5.3.3 (中文(简体) ). 测试时间缩放

blocks.en:
Test-time scaling spends extra computation after training to read the available video better.
Multimodal chain-of-thought Fei et al., 2024a ; Luo et al., 2024 spends tokens on intermediate reasoning, which helps only if those steps stay grounded in the frames.
Query-aware frame selection instead spends compute on choosing the input: SeViLA Yu et al., 2023a and VideoTree Wang et al., 2025g rank, retain, or hierarchically organize frames for the query.
Iterative “thinking with video” methods such as FrameThinker He et al., 2026d and VideoChat-A1 Wang et al., 2026g alternate between reasoning and revisiting frames over several steps.
Search and aggregation select among several reasoning paths by self-consistency, best-of- N N , or verifier and process-reward models, while V-Reason Sridhar et al., 2026 directly modifies the model’s inference-time behavior instead of sampling more outputs.
Each route trades latency and repeated visual computation for broader exploration or a second look at ambiguous evidence.
blocks.zh:
测试时间缩放在训练后花费额外的计算,以更好地阅读可用的视频.
思维的多式联运链 Fei等,2024a;Luo等,2024 用于中间推理的符号,只有当这些步骤扎根于框架时才有帮助。
查询- 意识框架选择而非计算选择 输入 : Yu等,2023a和VideoTree Wang等,2025g 排名,保留,或分级组织查询框架.
FrameThinker等代词“用视频思考”方法 他等,2026d和VideoChat-A1 Wang等,2026g在推理和再审框架之间交替取而代之,跨越了几个步骤.
搜索和汇总通过自相容性,最佳N-N,或验证和过程奖励模型,在几个推理路径中选择,而V-Reason Sridhar等,2026直接修改了模型的推断时间行为,而不是取样更多的输出.
每条路由都以耐久性和反复的视觉计算来进行更广泛的探索,或者对模棱两可的证据进行第二次审视.

blocks.en: The boundary with agentic modeling is gradual: thinking-with-video methods already revisit frames, and once a model issues explicit operations to fetch new crops, frames, retrieval results, or persistent memory, it enters the agentic setting of Section 5.4 .
blocks.zh: 与代理模型的分界线是渐进的:思维-视频方法已经重新审视了帧,一旦一个模型发出明确的操作来取取出新的作物,帧,取回结果,或者持续的内存,它便进入了第5.4节的代理设置.

blocks.en: 5.4 Agentic Video Modeling
blocks.zh: 5.4 代理视频建模

blocks.en:
Agentic video modeling turns evidence acquisition into a sequential decision problem: an LLM or Video-LLM forms subquestions, chooses a temporal region or visual detail to inspect, invokes an operation, and updates its reasoning from the result until it can answer.
Its actions change access to the recording by locating segments, sampling frames, cropping regions, querying tracks, or retrieving memory; actions that change the depicted world belong to the interactive rollouts of Section 8 .
blocks.zh:
代理视频模型化将证据获取转化为相继的决定问题:一个LLM或Video-LLM形成子问题,选择一个时区或视觉细节来检查,引用一个操作,并更新其推理,从结果到可以回答.
它的行动通过定位片段,采样框,裁剪区域,查询轨迹,或检索内存来改变对记录的获取;改变所描绘的世界的行动属于第8节的互动展开.

blocks.en: Table 7: Agentic video systems. Organization : Single = one reasoning controller; Multi-role = coordinated specialist reasoning roles, which may share a backbone.
blocks.zh: 表7:代理视频系统。 组织:Single = 1个推理控制器;Multi-role = 协调的专家推理角色,可能共享一个骨干.

blocks.en: 5.4.1 Video Agents
blocks.zh: 5.4.1 录像代理商

blocks.en:
Early video agents separate the controller’s reasoning state from the full video stream (Table 7 ).
Two systems named VideoAgent take different routes: VideoAgent (long-form) Wang et al., 2024a has an LLM iteratively gather a small set of question-relevant frames, and VideoAgent (memory) Fan et al., 2024 builds event and object-tracking memory and exposes segment localization and memory queries as tools.
VideoAgent2 Zhi et al., 2025 adds uncertainty-aware replanning, so that new observations can revise the search and intermediate evidence is verified.
Later controllers refine the observation policy: VCA Yang et al., 2025e explores unexamined segments out of curiosity, and VideoMind Liu et al., 2026i splits the loop into planner, grounder, verifier, and answerer roles, all chain-of-LoRA experts on one backbone.
blocks.zh:
早期的视频代理将控制者的推理状态从完整的视频流中分离出来(表7).
两个名为VideoAgent的系统走不同的路线:VideoAgent(长式) Wang等,2024a 有LLM迭代地收集了一小组与问题相关的帧,而VideoAgent (memory) Fan等,2024 构建了事件和对象跟踪存储器,并曝光了片段本地化和内存查询作为工具.
视频代理 2 Zhi等人,2025年增加了对不确定性的认知再规划,这样新的观察可以修改搜索并验证中间证据.
后期控制器完善了观测策略:VCA Yang等,"2025e"出于好奇探索了未经审查的片段,"VideoMind Liu等","2026i"将回路分为了规划者,地心者,核查者,以及回答者角色,所有LORA链条专家在一个骨干上.

blocks.en:
Agentic search extends adaptive observation from frame selection to a structured video collection.
Deep Video Discovery Zhang et al., 2025f segments long video into a multi-granular database and lets the controller choose search tools and parameters, and VideoExplorer Yuan et al., 2025 poses sub-questions inside the reasoning loop and locates the moments that answer them.
blocks.zh:
Agentic search将适应性观察从帧选择延伸到结构化的视频收藏.
深度视频发现 Zhang等,2025f 分出长视频进入多角度数据库,让控制器选择搜索工具和参数,而VideoExplorer Yuan等,2025 提出了推理回路内部的子问题并定位了回答这些问题的瞬间.

blocks.en:
Continuous streams add another decision: when to observe and when to speak, possibly before the user asks.
StreamAgent Yang et al., 2025a anticipates task-relevant events and shifts attention before they arrive, and AViLA Zhang et al., 2025a answers asynchronous queries once the accumulated evidence is sufficient.
blocks.zh:
连续流会增加另一个决定:观察时间和说话时间,可能是在用户询问之前.
流线代理 Yang等,2025a 预测与任务相关的事件,并转移注意到到达前,而AVilA Zhang等,2025a 一旦积累的证据足够,便会同步回答询问.

blocks.en:
Memory determines what an agent retains between observations.
Flat caption lists are cheap to query but lose temporal scope and visual detail.
VideoLucy Zuo et al., 2025 instead backtracks through a coarse-to-fine memory hierarchy and MM-Mem Lian et al., 2026 builds a sensory, episodic, and schema-level memory pyramid, while InternVideo3 Yan et al., 2026 accumulates observations, reasoning, and tool actions in one evolving context.
Memory-centric agents aim for competence that grows with history instead of resetting at every query: M3-Agent Long et al., 2026a consolidates an entity-centric long-term memory from continuous audio-visual input, and WorldMM Yeo et al., 2026 maintains a dynamic multimodal memory.
blocks.zh:
内存决定一个代理在观察之间保留什么.
平面标题列表可以便宜地查询,但会失去时间范围和视觉细节.
视频Lucy Zuo等人,2025年 转而通过粗对细的记忆层次和MM-Mem Lian等人,2026年 构建了感官,外观,和计划层次的记忆金字塔,而InternVideo3 Yan et al., 2026 在一个不断变化的背景下积累观测,推理,和工具行动.
以记忆为中心的代理以随历史而增长的能力为目标,而不是在每个查询中重设的能力:M3-Agent Long等,2026a从连续的视听输入中整合出一个以实体为中心的长期内存,而WorldMM Yeo等,2026年维持了动态多模式内存.

blocks.en:
Multi-agent collaboration divides the loop across specialized roles.
VideoMultiAgents Kugo et al., 2025 coordinates vision, text, and graph specialists, LongVideoAgent Liu et al., 2026e pairs a reasoning master with grounding assistants, and Think, Then Verify Wang et al., 2026f makes candidate answers survive adversarial checking.
MAPA Xu et al., 2026d pairs lightweight perception agents with action agents to avoid redundant computation.
blocks.zh:
多代理协作将各专门角色的循环划分开来.
视频多边代理 Kugo等,2025年,协调视觉、文字和图表专家,LongVideoAgent 刘等,2026e 配对 推理大师与地面助理, 和想,再校验 王等,2026f 让候选人的答案 通过对抗性检查。
马帕 徐等,2026d配对轻量级感知剂与动作剂,以避免冗余计算.

blocks.en:
Other agents are trained, not only prompted: SAGE Jain et al., 2026 learns with RL how far ahead to look, EVA Zhang et al., 2026l makes end-to-end RL of a video agent efficient, and CASE Du et al., 2026 learns when to stop searching.
Trained policies can lower tool cost and improve stopping, but they tie the agent to the tools seen in training.
blocks.zh:
其他人员接受培训,不仅受到下列因素的影响: 圣贤 Jain等,2026 与 RL 学习 展望未来有多远, EVA Zhang等,2026l 使视频代理的端到端RL高效,CASE Du等,2026 学会了何时停止搜索.
训练有素的政策可以降低工具成本并改进停用情况,但是它们将代理人与培训中看到的工具挂钩。

blocks.en:
Agent quality depends jointly on the backbone, observation policy, tool outputs, and memory: a wrong first hypothesis can steer later calls to the wrong interval, and noisy captions or detections propagate through the reasoning trace.
Agents are trained on tool-use traces for SFT and questions for RL (Ego-R1 Data Tian et al., 2026a , LongVT’s VideoSIAH Yang et al., 2026f , VideoThinker’s synthetic trajectories Li et al., 2026b ).
Benchmarks (Table 8 ) test sparse-evidence search (VideoSIAH-Eval Yang et al., 2026f ), multi-hop retrieval with evidence-necessity checks and tool-call cost (LongVidSearch Yu et al., 2026 ), trajectories against evidence milestones (AgentVidBench An et al., 2026 ), and combined video and web search (VideoGAIA Zhang et al., 2026 ).
Others test proactive and spoken audio-visual interaction (IPIBench Li et al., 2026d , OmniInteract Lu et al., 2026a ) and cross-session memory with cases where the needed history is missing (APM-Bench Huang et al., 2026 ).
Beyond answer accuracy, evaluation should report whether the retrieved evidence supports the answer and what the search costs; REPAIR AlHamidi et al., 2026 adds repeated paired runs to separate run-to-run variance from method effects and counts the operations and latency hidden behind visible tool calls.
blocks.zh:
代理质量共同依赖于主干,观察政策,工具输出,以及内存:错误的第一假设可以将后期的调用引导到错误的间隔,而吵闹的字幕或检测通过推理跟踪传播.
代理人接受关于SFT工具使用痕迹和RL问题的培训(Ego-R1 Data Tian等,2026a;Long) VT的录像 Yang等,2026f,VideoThinker合成轨迹 Li等, 2026b.), (中文(简体) ).
基准(表8)测试稀有证据搜索(VideoSIAH-Eval Yang等,2026f),多跳检索并附有证据必要性检查和工具调用费用(LongVidSearch Yu等,2026),对照证据里程碑的轨迹(AgentVid Bench An等,2026),以及综合视频和网络搜索(VideoGAIA Zhang等,2026)。
其他人测试主动和口语视听互动(IPIBench Li等,2026d;OmniInteract Lu等,2026a;和交叉会话记忆中缺少必要历史的案例(APM-Bench Huang等,2026)。
除了答案准确性外,评价还应报告所取出的证据是否支持答案,以及搜索费用如何;REPAIR Al-Hamidi等人,2026年增加了重复的对数运行,将运行中的差异与方法效应区分开来,并计算隐藏在可见工具呼叫后面的操作和耐用性.

blocks.en: Table 8: Video-agent benchmarks for evidence acquisition, interaction control, and persistent memory.
blocks.zh: 表8:证据获取、互动控制和持续内存的视频代理基准。

blocks.en: 5.4.2 Tool Use and Retrieval Augmentation
blocks.zh: 5.4.2 工具的使用和检索增强

blocks.en:
Tools supply observations that the base model cannot obtain reliably from its current context: detectors and trackers for entity state, temporal grounders for event boundaries, croppers for spatial detail, and OCR, speech recognition, or captioners for other modalities.
In modular agents, a prompted controller composes external tools: VisProg Gupta & Kembhavi, 2023 and ViperGPT Surís et al., 2023 generate executable programs over vision tools without training.
Native tool-calling models instead learn when to call a tool, with which parameters, and how to use the result.
LongVT Yang et al., 2026f surveys a long video, predicts a relevant interval, and crops and densely resamples it before continuing to reason, and VideoThinker Li et al., 2026b learns temporal retrieval and zoom from tool trajectories synthesized in caption space and grounded back to video.
Ego-R1 Tian et al., 2026a trains a chain of tool-thought with RL over day- and week-long egocentric recordings.
Tool use can also be distilled away: Agent-of-Thoughts Distillation Shi et al., 2025 distills agent traces into a single Video-LLM as chain-of-thought supervision, trading flexibility for one-pass inference.
blocks.zh:
工具提供基准模型无法从当前上下文中可靠地获得的观测数据:实体状态的探测器和跟踪器,事件边界的时空地表仪,空间细节的收割器,以及其他模式的OCR,语音识别或字幕.
在模块化代理中,被提示的控制器会由外部工具组成: VisProg Gupta & Kembhavi, 2023年和毒蛇GPT Surís等人,2023年,在没有培训的情况下,在视觉工具上产生可执行方案。
原生工具调用模型则学习何时调用工具,使用哪些参数,以及如何使用结果.
长 VT Yang等人,2026f 调查了一段长视频,预测了相关的间隔,并预测了农作物和密集地重新植入后再继续推理,而VideoThinker Li等人,2026b 从标题空间合成的工具轨迹中学习了时间检索和缩放,并被禁入视频.
Ego-R1 (英语). Tian et al., 2026a 训练一连串工具思维 与RL在白天和一周的自负式录音。
工具的使用也可以被蒸馏去: 沉淀剂 Shi等人,2025年 蒸馏剂 追踪到一个单一的Video-LLM 作为思维的链式监督, 交易灵活性 一通推论。

blocks.en:
Retrieval augmentation moves evidence into an external index.
One VideoRAG Jeong et al., 2025 retrieves query-relevant videos and keeps both their visual and textual content, while another Ren et al., 2026 combines graph-based text grounding with multimodal encoding to search very large collections.
The retrieval unit shapes what can be recovered: fixed-length chunks may split an event, so SceneRAG Zeng et al., 2026 indexes narrative scenes and adds an entity-relation graph for multi-hop retrieval, at the cost of errors in segmentation and graph construction.
Tools and retrieval address different bottlenecks: a cropper or grounder fetches finer local evidence on demand, whereas an index narrows the search across long videos or corpora.
Both still require the system to decide what to request, detect missing or conflicting evidence, and trace the answer back to its source clips.
blocks.zh:
检索增强将证据移入外部索引。
一个视频RAG Jeong等,2025检索出与查询相关的视频,并保留其视觉和文字内容,而另一个Ren等,2026年将基于图表的文本定位与多模式编码相结合,以搜索非常大型的集合.
取回单元塑造可以回收的东西:固定长块可能分割出一个事件,所以SceneRAG Zeng等,2026索引叙事场景并添加了多跳检索的实体关系图,以分解和图表构造出错为代价.
工具和检索处理不同的瓶颈:收割机或地上取出更精细的当地证据,而索引则将搜索范围缩小到长视频或公司。
两者都仍然要求系统决定要求什么,发现缺失或相冲突的证据,并将答案追溯到其源片段.

blocks.en: 5.5 Applications
blocks.zh: 5.5 申请

blocks.en: Applications pose these problems under domain-specific viewpoints, vocabularies, and event structures.
blocks.zh: 应用在特定领域的观点、词汇和事件结构下提出了这些问题。

blocks.en: 5.5.1 Embodied and Egocentric Perception
blocks.zh: 5.5.1 健全和以离子为中心的观念

blocks.en:
Egocentric video records activity from the wearer’s viewpoint, so the camera moves with the body, hands occlude manipulated objects, and key events are separated by long stretches of routine activity.
Standard resources include EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Damen et al., 2022 , Ego4D Grauman et al., 2022 , EgoSchema Mangalam et al., 2023 , and the paired first- and third-person views of Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al., 2025 (Section 4.1 ).
An egocentric assistant has to track the manipulated object and its state, the current task step, and the earlier event that explains the present situation, even when the object is hidden behind the hand or out of view.
blocks.zh:
Egocent视频从穿戴者的角度记录活动,因此相机会随身体移动,双手会吞噬被操纵的物体,而关键事件会被漫长的例行活动隔开.
标准资源包括EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Damen等,2022年,Ego4D Grauman等人,2022年,EgoSchema Mangalam 等,2023年,以及Ego-Exo4D Grauman 等的对等第一人称和第三人称观点,2025年(第4.1节.
一个以自我为中心的助手必须跟踪被操纵对象及其状态,当前的任务步骤,以及更早解释当前情况的事件,即使物体被隐藏在手后或被取出.

blocks.en:
Newer benchmarks target specific settings.
EgoTools Tian et al., 2026 tests understanding of physical tools and their effects (not software-tool calls), covering affordance, grounding, procedure, and spatial reasoning, and EgoPolice Gonzalez-Diez et al., 2026 tests police body-worn camera footage, where consequential events are rare and visibility is poor.
blocks.zh:
新的基准针对特定设置。
电子工具 Tian等,2026年测试了对物理工具及其效果的理解(不是软件工具呼叫),涵盖支付能力,地平面,程序和空间推理,而EgoPolice Gonzalez-Diez等,2026年测试了警察身体-成体相机镜头,这些镜头的发生事件很少,可见度也很低.

blocks.en: 5.5.2 Autonomous Driving
blocks.zh: 5.5.2 自主驾驶

blocks.en:
Driving video must be read as a dynamic scene of road geometry, traffic controls, vehicles, pedestrians, and their relations.
BDD100K Yu et al., 2020 supplies diverse annotated road video, and nuScenes Caesar et al., 2020 and the Waymo Open Dataset Sun et al., 2020 add synchronized camera and range-sensor sequences with 3D annotations.
Language-based benchmarks ask which participants and relations matter: DriveLM Sima et al., 2024 links key objects and their interactions to prediction and planning questions through graph-structured VideoQA, and the frame-level NuScenes-SpatialQA Tian et al., 2025 tests spatial relations in driving scenes.
OmniDrive Wang et al., 2025b aligns language reasoning with 3D driving tasks and adds counterfactual questions about how alternative actions would change an outcome.
The resulting scene state links video reading to the trajectory prediction, action selection, and closed-loop control of Section 8 .
blocks.zh:
驾驶视频必须被解读为道路几何,交通管制,车辆,行人及其关系的动态场景.
BDD100K 数据 Yu等人,2020年 提供多种附加注释的公路视频,nuScenes Caesar等人,2020年 和Waymo Open Dataset Sun等人,2020年 添加了同步相机和测距传感器序列并附有3D说明.
基于语言的基准询问哪些参与者和关系很重要: DriveLM Sima等,2024年通过图结构的VideoQA将关键物体及其相互作用与预测和规划问题联系起来,而帧级的NuScens-SpatialQA Tian等,2025年测试了驱动场景中的空间关系.
倾斜 Wang et al., 2025b 将语言推理与3D驱动任务相配合,并增加了关于替代行动如何改变结果的反事实问题.
产生的场景状态将视频读取与轨迹预测,动作选择,以及第8节的闭路控制联系起来. .

blocks.en: 5.5.3 Domain-Specific Video Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5.3 域-特定视频分析

blocks.en:
Medical and surgical video. Surgical video is structured by procedure phases, so recognizing visible instruments is not enough.
EndoNet Twinanda et al., 2017 introduced Cholec80 for phase and tool recognition, CholecT50 and Rendezvous Nwoye et al., 2022 refine the output into instrument–verb–target triplets, and SurgVLM Zeng et al., 2025 combines perception, temporal analysis, and question answering across surgical tasks.
Evaluation must check phase, anatomy, and action against the structured labels of clinical workflows, not the fluency of a description.
blocks.zh:
医外科视频. 外科视频按程序阶段排列,因此识别可见仪器是不够的.
EndoNet Twinanda等,2017年 引入Cholec80用于相相和工具识别,CholecT50和Rendezvous Nwoye等,2022年 将输出精细化为仪器-动词-目标三相,和 SurgVLM Zeng等人,2025年结合了感知,时间分析,以及跨外科任务问答.
评价必须对照临床工作流程的结构化标签,检查阶段、解剖学和行动,而不是描述的流畅度。

blocks.en:
Sports analytics. A match contains long stretches of routine play broken by brief, rule-dependent events.
SoccerNet Giancola et al., 2018 defined action spotting in broadcast soccer; SoccerNet-v2 Deliege et al., 2021 adds camera-shot segmentation and replay grounding, which require precise localization and knowledge of broadcast structure.
blocks.zh:
体育分析. 一场比赛包含很长一段由短暂的,依赖规则的事件所打破的常规游戏.
SoccerNet Giancola等,2018年 在广播足球中定义了动作斑点;SoccerNet-v2 Deliege等,2021年 增加了相机拍摄分片和回放地平面,这需要准确本地化和广播结构的知识.

blocks.en:
Film and edited video. In edited footage, shot size, cut type, and transitions are deliberate choices.
VEU-Bench Li et al., 2025a tests recognition, reasoning, and judging of editing attributes within and across shots, and finds that general Video-LLMs handle them poorly, in some cases below chance.
blocks.zh:
电影和编辑的视频。 在被编辑的镜头中,镜头大小,剪接类型,和过渡都是有意的选择.
VEU-贝奇 Li等,2025a测试识别,推理,判断镜头内和镜头间编辑属性,并发现一般Video-LLMs处理不善,有时还低于概率.

blocks.en:
Education and instructional video. Instructional video follows a procedure from an initial state through intermediate steps to a goal.
HowTo100M Miech et al., 2019 supplies narrated demonstrations, and CrossTask Zhukov et al., 2019 and COIN Tang et al., 2019 annotate steps for temporal localization.
Reading such video means tracking the progress of the procedure: separating narrated intention from visible operation, recovering omitted or repeated steps, and reasoning about order and prerequisites.
blocks.zh:
教育与教学视频. 教学录像遵循从初始状态到中间步骤到目标的程序。
如何达到100M Miech等,2019年提供叙事示威,CrossTask Zhukov等,2019年和COIN Tang等,2019年 注释时间本地化步骤.
阅读这种视频意味着跟踪程序的进展:将叙述的意图与可见的操作区分开来,恢复被省略或重复的步骤,以及对秩序和先决条件的推理.

blocks.en:
INSIGHT Video understanding is limited by state, not by context length Encoders compress observations, Video-LLMs map evidence into language, and agents choose what to inspect, but all of them are limited by what state they keep and ground, not by how many frames they accept.
Longer context helps only when it corrects or stabilizes that state, so evaluation should ask whether added evidence improves the state estimate, stays traceable to source clips, and survives later queries.
blocks.zh:
新闻 视频理解受状态所限,而不受上下文长度 Encoders压缩观测,Video-LLMS将证据映射到语言中,代理商选择检查什么,但所有这些都受它们保存和地面的状态所限,而不是接受多少帧.
更长的上下文只有在纠正或稳定了该状态时才有帮助,因此评价应该询问所增加的证据是否改善了状态估计,保持可追溯到源片段,并活过后期的询问.

blocks.en: INSIGHT Video understanding is limited by state, not by context length
blocks.zh: 新闻 视频理解受状态限制,而非上下文长度限制

blocks.en: 6 Video Generation: Writing the World
blocks.zh: 6 视频生成: 写作世界

blocks.en: Writing means rendering a new video trace from a partial world specification supplied as text, images, audio, motion, or other conditions.
blocks.zh: 写作是指从部分世界规格中产生新的视频痕迹,以文本,图像,音频,运动或其他条件提供.

blocks.en:
Video generation is the writing operation W → V W\rightarrow V of Section 3 : its conditions fix some entities, relations, and dynamics of W W and leave the rest to the generator.
Text may specify an event, an image may fix its initial appearance, audio may set visible rhythm or articulation, and trajectories camera or object motion.
blocks.zh:
视频生成是第3节W&V W\rightarrow V的写作操作:它的条件固定了WW的一些实体,关系和动态,剩下的留给了生成者.
文字可以指定一个事件,一个图像可以固定其初始外观,音频可以设置可见的节奏或发音,以及轨迹相机或物体运动.

blocks.en:
This chapter covers models whose output and training target are the video itself, judged by fidelity, condition adherence, temporal coherence, and controllable revision.
Persistent state under occlusion, revisits, long rollouts, and actions is treated in Section 8 .
We cover tasks and evaluation, latent representations, generative paradigms, control strategies, and applications.
Xing et al. Xing et al., 2025 review video diffusion models in depth.
blocks.zh:
本章涵盖的模型,其产出和培训目标是视频本身,根据忠诚、遵守条件、时间一致性和可控制的修订来判断。
第8节处理隔离、重新审视、长期推出和行动下的持久性状态。
我们涉及任务和评估、潜在表述、基因模式、控制战略和应用。
兴等. 邢等,2025年深入审查视频传播模式.

blocks.en: 6.1 Tasks, Conditions, and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.1 任务、条件和评价

blocks.en:
A video-generation task is defined by the information fixed before synthesis: text, images, source videos, audio, reference identities, or prescribed motion.
Evaluation measures the visual and temporal quality of the result, its adherence to the condition, and the stability of the entities, events, and physical relations it shows.
Table 9 lists training resources, Table 10 lists metrics and learned scorers, and Table 11 lists benchmarks and the conditions they test.
blocks.zh:
视频生成任务由合成前固定的信息定义:文本,图像,源视频,音频,参考身份,或被设定的运动.
评价衡量结果的视觉和时间质量、遵守条件以及所显示的实体、事件和物理关系的稳定性。
表9列出了培训资源,表10列出了衡量尺度和学习分数,表11列出了基准及其测试条件。

blocks.en: 6.1.1 Generation Tasks by Condition
blocks.zh: 6.1.1 按条件分列的生成任务

blocks.en:
Text, image, and video conditions. Text-to-video (T2V) maps a description of content, style, or events to a video and leaves most appearance and motion to the model, as in Sora Brooks et al., 2024 , Wan Wan et al., 2025 , and HunyuanVideo Kong et al., 2024 .
Image-to-video (I2V) fixes the initial state or reference appearance and must add plausible motion without losing that structure and identity, as in Stable Video Diffusion Blattmann et al., 2023 and the human-animation systems Animate Anyone Hu, 2024 and MagicAnimate Xu et al., 2024a .
Video-to-video (V2V) starts from a source video and covers transformations with different preservation requirements.
Editing changes selected content and should stay local, as in Tune-A-Video Wu et al., 2023 , Video-P2P Liu et al., 2024a , FateZero Qi et al., 2023 , and TokenFlow Geyer et al., 2024 .
Translation maps the source to another appearance or domain while keeping its content.
Interpolation connects observed endpoints, and extension continues the sequence beyond its last frame, as in NUWA-XL Yin et al., 2023a , SEINE Chen et al., 2024f , and StreamingT2V Henschel et al., 2025 .
blocks.zh:
文字,图像,和视频条件. Text-to-video(T2V)将内容,风格,或事件描述到视频中,并将大部分外观和运动留给了模型,如Sora Brooks等,2024年;Wan Wan等,2025年;Hunyuan Video Kong等,2024年.
图像到视频(I2V)固定了初始状态或参考外观,必须增加合理运动而不失去这种结构和身份,例如,稳定视频传播Blattmann等人,2023年和人类活化系统Animate Anyone Hu, 2024年和MagicAnimate Xu等人,2024a年。
视频到视频(V2V)从源视频开始,并覆盖具有不同保存要求的转换.
编辑所选内容并保持本地化, 如Tune-A- Video Wu等,2023年,视频-P2P 刘等,2024a,命运 无 Qi等,2023年,和托肯 Flow Geyer等, 2024年.
在保存其内容的同时将来源映射到另一个外观或域.
内插连接观测到的端点,扩展将序列延续到最后一帧以外,如NUWA-XL Yin等人,2023a,SEINE Chen等,2024f;和StreatingT2V Henschel等,2025年。

blocks.en:
Audio and audio-visual conditions. In audio-driven generation, a speech, music, or sound track sets visible dynamics such as lip motion, expression, gesture, or rhythm, as in Wav2Lip Prajwal et al., 2020 , SadTalker Zhang et al., 2023b , EMO Tian et al., 2024 , and Hallo Xu et al., 2024 .
Joint audio-video generation instead produces both streams and must keep their events synchronized as well as each stream plausible, as in JavisDiT Liu et al., 2026a , JavisDiT++ Liu et al., 2026b , and Ovi Low et al., 2025 .
blocks.zh:
视听条件. 在由音频驱动的一代中,一个演讲,音乐,或音轨设定了诸如唇动,表达,手势,或节奏等可见的动态,如Wav2Lip Prajwal等,2020年,SadTalker 张等,2023b,EMO Tian等人,2024年,和Hallo 许等,2024.
联合音频-视频生成则产生双流,必须保持事件同步以及每流的合理性,如JavisDIT 刘等,2026a;JavisDiT++;刘等,2026b;Ovi Low等,2025.

blocks.en:
Geometric, motion, and identity conditions. Camera, motion, and trajectory conditions prescribe how the viewpoint or scene elements evolve.
Camera poses and paths control the observation process, as in CameraCtrl He et al., 2025 , while object trajectories, human poses, and action sequences constrain motion within the scene, as in MotionCtrl Wang et al., 2024i , DragNUWA Yin et al., 2023 , VideoComposer Wang et al., 2023a , and Wan-Move Chu et al., 2025 .
Identity- or subject-conditioned generation, as in ConsisID Yuan et al., 2025a , fixes which person, object, or subject persists over time, and that subject must stay stable under pose, viewpoint, and occlusion changes.
blocks.zh:
几何,运动,和身份条件。 相机、运动和轨迹条件规定了视线或场景要素的演变方式。
相机的姿势和路径控制观测过程,如相机 Ctrl He等,2025年,而物体的轨迹、人体姿势和行动序列会限制场内的运动,如MotionCtrl Wang等,2024i, DragNUWA Yin等,2023年,VideoComposer Wang等人,2023a, 和Wan-Move Chu等, 2025 (英语).
身份-或标的生成,如ConsisID Yuan等,2025a, 确定哪些人、对象或主体长期存在, 该主体必须保持稳定,在姿势、观点和隔离变化下。

blocks.en:
Any-conditioned and unified control. Any-conditioned systems accept a variable subset of text, image, audio, structure, motion, and reference inputs, as in FullDiT Ju et al., 2025 , UNIC Ye et al., 2026a , and Any2Caption Wu et al., 2025b .
They must bind each cue to the right entity, region, time span, or modality and reconcile cues of different granularity.
Section 6.4 describes how such conditions enter the model.
blocks.zh:
任何有条件的统一控制. 任何有条件的系统接受文本、图像、音频、结构、运动和参考输入的可变子集,如FullDiT Ju等人,2025年,联合国新闻中心 Ye等,2026a;Any2 Caption Wu等,2025b。
它们必须把每个提示绑在正确的实体、区域、时间段或方式上,并调和不同颗粒的提示。
第6.4节描述了这些条件如何进入模型。

blocks.en:
Training supervision. Each task needs training pairs that expose its condition–output correspondence (Table 9 ).
Caption corpora such as Panda-70M Chen et al., 2024d and UltraVideo Xue et al., 2025 serve T2V, and image conditioning and extension can be learned by keeping selected frames or prefixes of a clip Jiang et al., 2025 .
Editing needs source–instruction–target triplets, as in OpenVE-3M He et al., 2026a .
Camera control uses posed video such as RealEstate10K Zhou et al., 2018a , motion control uses tracked point trajectories Chu et al., 2025 , and audio-visual generation needs synchronized tracks such as VGGSound Chen et al., 2020 .
Identity control pairs references and targets from different contexts or shots, as in Phantom-Data Chen et al., 2026g , MuSS Zhang et al., 2026b , and Omni-R2V Li et al., 2026e , so the model cannot simply copy the reference’s pose or background into the output.
blocks.zh:
培训监督。 每项任务都需要培训对口,暴露其状况-产出对应关系(表9)。
熊猫-70M等Caption Corpora 陈等,2024d和UltraVideo Xue等人,2025年服务于T2V,通过保留剪辑"Jiang等人"的选定帧或前缀,可以学习图像的配置和扩展. 2025.
编辑需要源 - 指令 - 目标 三进制, 如 OpenVE-3M He等, 2026a. (英语).
相机控制用途已显示视频, 如RealEstate10K Zhou等,2018a,运动控制使用跟踪点轨迹 Chu等,2025年,和视听生成需要同步的音轨,如VGGSound Chen等,2020年.
身份控制对不同背景或镜头的参考和目标配对,如Phantom-Data Chen等人,2026g;MuSS 张等,2026b;和Omni-R2V Li et al., 2026e., 因此模型不能简单地将参考的姿势或背景复制到输出中去.

blocks.en: Table 9: Training resources for conditioned video generation and editing. Condition lists available input modalities or control signals; their use depends on the training task. Scale retains the source’s counting unit.
blocks.zh: 表9:有条件视频制作和编辑的培训资源。 条件列出了可用的输入模式或控制信号;其使用取决于培训任务. 缩放保留源的计数单位。

blocks.en: 6.1.2 Evaluation and Metrics
blocks.zh: 6.1.2 评价与计量

blocks.en:
Video-generation quality has several dimensions, and the right profile depends on the task: T2V emphasizes semantic alignment, editing requires source preservation and locality, audio-driven generation requires synchronization, and motion control requires trajectory adherence.
A single aggregate score hides the failure that limits a system, so we group metrics by the property they measure (Table 10 ) and benchmarks by the cases they test (Table 11 ).
blocks.zh:
视频生成质量有多个维度,正确的剖面取决于任务: T2V强调语义对接,编辑需要源保存和位置,音频驱动生成需要同步,而运动控制需要轨迹的坚持.
单一的汇总分数掩盖了限制一个系统的失败,所以我们按它们测量的属性(表10)和它们测试的个案的基准(表11)来分组衡量标准.

blocks.en:
Visual fidelity and temporal quality. FID Heusel et al., 2017 compares frame-feature distributions and ignores temporal order.
The Inception Score Salimans et al., 2016 rewards confident, diverse classifier predictions without reference to real data, which limits its meaning outside the classifier’s domain Barratt & Sharma, 2018 .
FVD Unterthiner et al., 2018 extends the comparison to video features, but it depends on the feature extractor and sample count and can under-penalize temporal corruption in favor of static samples Ge et al., 2024 .
JEDi Luo et al., 2025 instead uses V-JEPA features and a maximum mean discrepancy, avoiding FVD’s Gaussian assumption and needing fewer samples.
PSNR, SSIM Wang et al., 2004 , and LPIPS Zhang et al., 2018 suit reconstruction and source preservation but penalize valid alternative futures.
FVMD Liu et al., 2024 and STREAM Kim et al., 2024 target motion consistency and spatiotemporal quality, and VMBench Ling et al., 2025 checks whether motion strength matches the prompt.
Diversity needs repeated samples under one condition: DiVid Hu et al., 2026a measures variation in semantics, style, subject, scene, motion, and camera alongside quality and faithfulness.
blocks.zh:
视觉忠诚和时间品质。 进口 Heusel等,2017年比较了帧地貌分布,并忽略了时间顺序.
Inception Score Salimans 等, 2016 奖赏自信, 多样化的分类者预测而不参考真实数据, 这限制了分类者域外的意义 Barratt & Sharma, 2018.
FVD 电视剧 Unterthiner等,2018年 将比较扩展到了视频功能,但取决于功能提取器和样本计数,并且可以对时间腐败进行低于惩罚,有利于静态样本. Ge等, 2024 (英语).
JEDi Luo等,2025年,使用V-JEPA特征和最大平均差异,避免了FVD的高斯假设,需要较少的样本.
PSNR, 苏西姆 Wang等,2004年;LPIPS Zhang等,2018年 适应重建和源头保护,但惩罚有效的替代期货.
FVMD 电视剧 刘等,2024年和STREAM Kim等,2024年目标运动一致性和spatiental 质地,而VMBench Ling等,2025年检查运动强度是否与快取相匹配.
多样性需要重复样品,条件之一是: 数字 Hu等,2026a测量语义,风格,主题,场景,运动,相机与质量和忠诚度相并列的变异.

blocks.en:
Condition alignment and compositionality. Condition-aware evaluation checks whether the video follows its condition.
CLIPScore Hessel et al., 2021 measures image–caption similarity, and its frame-averaged video variants ignore temporal order and motion.
cFreD Koo et al., 2026 adds text–visual cross-covariances to a conditional Fréchet distance, so it penalizes videos swapped among prompts, which a marginal distance cannot detect.
FETV Liu et al., 2023a and T2V-CompBench Sun et al., 2025 separate objects, attributes, relations, actions, and temporal composition.
Structured conditions have their own tests: MultiRef-Compass Zhang et al., 2026k checks how several references bind to audio-visual content.
OmniVBench Li et al., 2026e applies case-specific checklists for reference fidelity and binding, and MoveBench Chu et al., 2025 measures trajectory endpoint error.
For source-conditioned tasks, V2V-Bench Liu et al., 2026f scores what the instruction should change separately from what the source should preserve.
blocks.zh:
条件一致和组成。 条件感知评价检查视频是否遵循其状态.
CLIPScore Hessel等,2021 度量图像-封装相似性,其帧平均视频变体忽略了时间顺序和运动.
cFreD 法语 Koo 等, 2026 在有条件的Fréchet距离之外添加了文本-视觉交叉变量,
费特弗 刘等,2023a和T2V-Comp Bench Sun等,2025年 分离对象,属性,关系,动作,以及时间组成.
结构化的条件有各自的测试: 多参考目录 Zhang等,2026k 检查多处引用如何与视听内容相接.
OmniV 奔驰 Li等,2026e应用了针对具体案例的核对表来进行参考忠诚和约束,而Move Bench Chu等,2025年测量了轨迹终点出错.
对于有源条件的任务,V2V-Bench Liu等,2026f对指令的分数与源应保留的内容分开.

blocks.en:
Physical and world consistency. Realistic local motion can still show impossible interactions, unstable objects, or broken persistence.
VideoPhy Bansal et al., 2025 and VideoPhy-2 Bansal et al., 2026 test physical commonsense, the latter in harder action-centric interactions.
PhysicsMind Mak et al., 2026 and VideoScience-Bench Hu et al., 2026d test mechanics and basic scientific phenomena, and PhyAVBench Xie et al., 2025b tests whether generated sound changes with paired physical conditions.
PhyProbe Ku et al., 2026 instead trains a physical-violation scorer on frozen visual features and shows that prior learned evaluators depend on their annotation distributions, though it retains some dataset dependence itself.
Persistence under revisits and occlusion is tested by the world-model benchmarks of Section 8.4 .
blocks.zh:
物理和世界一致性。 现实的局部运动仍然可以显示不可能的相互作用,不稳定的物体,或者断裂的持久性.
视频 Phy Bansal等人,2025年和视频 Phy-2 Bansal等,2026年测试物理常识,后者在更硬的动作-以中心为相互作用.
物理学 Mak等人,2026年和VideoScience-Bench Hu等,2026d测试力学和基础科学现象,和PhyAV Bench Xie等,2025b测试是否在相对物理条件下产生声音变化.
物理探测器 Ku等取而代之,2026年在被冻结的视觉特征上训练了物理-违章计分器,并显示之前学习过的评价师依赖于其注释分布,虽然它保留了某些数据集依赖性本身.
第8.4节的世界模式基准测试了重新审视和隔离下的持久性。

blocks.en:
Human preference, learned evaluators, and suites. Human comparisons capture coherence, visual appeal, and instruction adherence that fixed feature distances miss.
Learned evaluators model such judgments: VideoScore He et al., 2024a predicts several human-rated properties, VideoScore2 He et al., 2026c adds physical and commonsense scores with rationales, and MJ-VIDEO Tong et al., 2025 trains a reward model on fine-grained preferences.
All three inherit the coverage and biases of their annotations, which for VideoScore2 are partly model-generated.
Suites such as VBench Huang et al., 2024a and EvalCrafter Liu et al., 2024c combine perceptual, semantic, and temporal dimensions, and VBench-2.0 Zheng et al., 2025 extends them to human fidelity, controllability, creativity, physics, and commonsense.
blocks.zh:
人类的偏好,有学识的评价师和套房. 人类比较能够捕捉到一致性、视觉吸引力和指令的坚持性,这些指令的固定特征距离缺失。
经验丰富的评价人员为这种判断树立了榜样: 视频分数 他等人, 2024a 预测若干人级属性, VideoScore2 他等,2026c 增加了物理分和常识分数并附有原理,而MJ-VIDEO Tong等,2025 训练了一种奖赏模式以优异优待.
三者都继承了他们的说明的覆盖面和偏见,对于VideoScore2来说,其部分是模型生成的.
V Bench Huang等人,2024a和EvalCrafter等诉讼案 刘等,2024c 结合了知觉,语义,和时间等维度,而V Bench-2.0 郑等,2025 将其延伸至人类的忠诚,可控性,创造性,物理,常识等.

blocks.en:
Multi-shot and audio-visual generation. Multi-shot and audio-visual outputs also need evaluation across shot boundaries and modalities.
MSVBench Shi et al., 2026 scores story alignment, cross-shot consistency, visual quality, and motion, while the Cinematic Narrative Benchmark of MuSS Zhang et al., 2026b separates fidelity to external references from identity persistence across shots and detects reference copying.
JavisBench Liu et al., 2026a tests joint generation of scenes with multiple or overlapping sound events, T2AV-Compass Cao et al., 2026 standardizes text-to-audio-video evaluation, and LongAV-Compass Liu et al., 2026g extends it to minute-scale settings where identity, narrative continuity, and synchronization can fail at different times.
At the metric level, Fréchet Audio Distance Kilgour et al., 2019 compares audio-feature distributions but ignores the video, LSE-D and LSE-C Prajwal et al., 2020 measure speech–mouth alignment, and JavisScore Liu et al., 2026a measures audio-video correspondence in broader sounding scenes.
blocks.zh:
多镜头和相声制作. 多镜头和视听产出也需要跨越镜头界限和模式进行评价。
MSV 奔驰 Shi等,2026评出故事对接,交叉镜头一致性,视觉质量,动作,而MuSS Zhang等的"电影叙事基准",2026b将真实性与外部引用区分开来,将身份持久性区分开来跨镜头并检测参考复制.
贾维斯奔驰 刘等,2026a测试多相或相重叠的场景联合生成,T2AV-Compass Cao等,2026标准化了文本到音频的视频评价,而LongAV-Compass Liu等,2026g将其扩展为分级设置,身份,叙事连续性,同步性在不同时间可以失败.
Fréchet Audio District Kilgour等,2019年 比较了音频版面的分布,但忽略了视频,LSE-D和LSE-C Prajwal等,2020年 测量语音–口语对接,而JavisScore Liu等,2026a 测量了更广泛的音响场景中的音频-视频对接.

blocks.en: 6.2 Video Latent Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 6.2 视频代理学习

blocks.en:
Many current video generators work in a compressed latent space: an encoder maps video to a shorter representation, the generator models its distribution, and a decoder reconstructs the frames.
Compression lowers training and sampling cost, especially for long videos, while the bottleneck and decoder decide whether fine texture, fast motion, and small objects survive.
Figure 4 contrasts the four families: continuous latents for diffusion and flow objectives, discrete tokens for autoregressive or masked prediction, hybrids that mix continuous and discrete forms or pair a tokenizer with a diffusion decoder, and semantically aligned representations that also serve understanding.
blocks.zh:
许多目前的视频生成器在被压缩的潜在空间工作:一个编码器将视频映射到一个更短的表示,生成器模型其发行,一个解码器重建了帧.
压缩降低了训练和采样成本,特别是长相视频,而瓶颈和解码器则决定精细的纹理,快动和小物体是否存活.
图4对比了这四个家族:扩散和流动目标的连续潜在;自相递减或被掩盖的预测的离散符号;将连续和离散形式相混合的杂交体或与扩散解码器相配的活化剂;以及同样有助于理解的集成等同表示。

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Latent representations for video generation.
Continuous, discrete, hybrid, and semantically aligned designs differ in how tokenizers and VAEs shape reconstruction fidelity, compression, sequence modeling, and unification with understanding.
Semantic alignment can be applied to either continuous or discrete representations.
blocks.zh:
图4:录像制作的Latent演示。
连续的,离散的,混合的,和相适应的设计,在象征剂和VAEs如何塑造重建忠心,压缩,序列建模,以及理解的统一方面,是不同的.
语义一致可以适用于连续表达或离散表达.

blocks.en: 6.2.1 Continuous Latents
blocks.zh: 6.2.1 连续诉讼

blocks.en:
Per-frame image VAEs. Latent diffusion Rombach et al., 2022 established the value of training a generative model in the continuous space of a pretrained image autoencoder, and the simplest video extension encodes each frame independently.
VideoLDM Blattmann et al., 2023a and AnimateDiff Guo et al., 2024 reuse image autoencoders and add temporal layers to image diffusion backbones.
This keeps the image prior and eases reuse of text-to-image backbones.
However, the latent sequence still grows linearly with the number of frames, and temporal coherence must be learned by the generator or by temporal layers in the decoder.
blocks.zh:
每帧图像 VAEs. Latent spission Rombach等, 2022年 在预训图像自编码器的连续空间中建立了培养基因模型的价值,最简单的视频扩展独立地编码了每个帧.
视频LDM Blattmann等,2023a和AnimateDiff Guo等,2024再用图像自编码器,并给图像传播骨干上添加了时间层.
这保持了图像的先行性并方便了文本到图像主干线的再利用.
然而,潜在的序列仍然随着帧数的线性增长,时间一致性必须由生成器或解码器中的时间层来学习.

blocks.en:
Spatiotemporal and Causal VAEs. Video VAEs use 3D or factorized spatiotemporal operations to compress both resolution and time.
Temporal compression shortens the sequence, lowers attention cost, and exploits redundancy between nearby frames, but an aggressive bottleneck can smooth brief events or fast motion.
CV-VAE Zhao et al., 2024a keeps its video latent space compatible with a pretrained image VAE so that image-generation priors remain usable, whereas CogVideoX Yang et al., 2025g and Cosmos NVIDIA et al., 2025 use dedicated 3D tokenizers for high spatial and temporal compression.
A causal 3D VAE computes the latent at time t t without future frames and encodes the first frame without preceding context, so one tokenizer handles both images and videos and streaming or autoregressive generators see no future leakage.
blocks.zh:
Spatiotemporal and Causal VAEs. 中国植物物种信息数据库. Video VAEs使用3D或因子化的spatiotal操作来压缩分辨率和时间.
时间压缩缩短了顺序,降低了注意力成本,并利用了相邻相框之间的冗余,但具有攻击性的瓶颈可以平缓短暂的事件或快动作.
简历 Zhao等, 2024a, 保持其视频潜在空间与经过预先训练的图像相兼容, 以便图像生成前缀仍然可用, 而 CogVideoX Yang等,2025g和Cosmos NVIDIA等,2025使用专用的3D活化剂进行高空间和时间压缩.
一个因果3D VAE在没有未来框架的情况下计算出时间t t的潜伏性,并在没有先前上下文的情况下编码出第一个帧,所以一个标语器既处理图像又处理视频,并流出或自递回的生成器不会看到未来的渗出.

blocks.en: 6.2.2 Discrete Tokens
blocks.zh: 6.2.2 分层托肯斯

blocks.en:
From vector quantization to codebook-free schemes. VQ-VAE Oord et al., 2017 replaces each encoder output with the index of a learned codebook entry, producing categorical symbols that next-token or masked-token models can predict.
VQGAN Esser et al., 2021 improves high-resolution reconstruction with perceptual and adversarial losses, and RQ-VAE Lee et al., 2022 stacks residual codes to increase precision without enlarging the token grid.
Learned codebooks, however, may be used unevenly or collapse to a small active subset.
Later quantizers drop the learned codebook: FSQ Mentzer et al., 2024 rounds a few scalar dimensions to fixed levels, LFQ in MAGVIT-v2 Yu et al., 2024 uses binary dimensions to obtain a very large implicit vocabulary, and BSQ Zhao et al., 2025b projects embeddings onto a hypersphere before binary quantization.
They differ in optimization stability, vocabulary size, and distortion at a given token budget.
blocks.zh:
从向量量化到无密码计划. VQ-VAE 数据 Oord等,2017年 将每个编码器输出替换为已学习到的编码本条目的索引,产生断断续续的符号,由下个或被遮住的模型预测.
瓦努阿图 Esser等,2021年 改进高分辨度重建,并带有知觉和对抗性损失,而RQ-VAE Lee等,2022年 堆放剩余代码来提高精度,而无需扩大信使网格.
然而,学到的代码簿可能会被不平均地使用,或者崩溃到一个活动的小子集.
后来的量化器放弃了学到的代码本: 财务问题 Mentzer 等,2024将一些scalar维度弹射到固定水平上,LFQ 在MAGVIT-v2 Yu等,2024使用二进制维度来得到一个非常大的隐含词汇,而BSQ Zhao等,2025b项目在二进制分解前嵌入到超平面上.
它们在优化稳定性、词汇大小和特定符号预算扭曲方面各不相同。

blocks.en:
Video tokenization. The video encoder also fixes the spatiotemporal extent of each token and hence the sequence length.
C-ViViT in Phenaki Villegas et al., 2023 factorizes spatial and temporal encoding into causal discrete tokens, MAGVIT-v2 pairs a causal tokenizer with LFQ for both autoregressive and masked generation, and HiTVideo Zhou et al., 2026e shortens the sequence with hierarchical codes that place semantics and fine detail in different layers.
Fixed grids, however, spend as many tokens on a static shot as on a fast-changing scene.
Adaptive tokenizers allocate the budget by content: EVATok Xiong et al., 2026 predicts how many tokens each segment needs, and VideoFlexTok Atanov et al., 2026 emits a variable-length coarse-to-fine sequence whose early tokens carry semantics and motion and whose later tokens add detail.
blocks.zh:
视频标志化. 视频编码器还修正了每个令牌的spatiotemporal范围并因此修正了序列长度.
C-ViViT in Phenaki Villegas等,2023年 将空间和时间编码成因果离散符号,MAGVIT-v2对用LFQ进行自回和被遮蔽的生成的因果活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活
然而,固定的网格在静态镜头上花费了和快速变化的场景一样多的代币.
适配符按照内容分配预算: EVATok Xiong等,2026预测每个段需要多少个令牌,而VideoFlexTok Atanov等,2026发布可变长粗到细序列,其早期令牌会携带语义和运动,后期令牌会增加细节.

blocks.en: 6.2.3 Hybrid and Semantically Aligned Representations
blocks.zh: 6.2.3 混合代表制和语义统一代表制

blocks.en:
Hybrid tokenizers combine continuous and discrete forms or change the decoder.
OneVAE Zhou et al., 2026d initializes a discrete video VAE from a continuous one and trains both in one network, so continuous latents can feed diffusion or flow models and discrete codes can feed sequence models.
Divot Ge et al., 2025 and DiCoDe Li et al., 2024d instead decode with a diffusion model.
Divot learns continuous features for LLM-based understanding and reconstruction, and DiCoDe compresses video into deep tokens that an LLM predicts autoregressively.
blocks.zh:
混合活化活化剂结合了连续和离散形式或改变解码器.
一个VAE Zhou 等,2026d从连续的视频中初始化出离散的视频VAE,并在一个网络中进行列车,因此相连续的潜伏可以提供传播或流出模型,离散代码可以提供序列模型.
Divot Ge等人,2025年和DiCoDe Li等,2024d取而代之用扩散模型解码.
Divot学习基于LLM的理解与重建的连续功能,而DiCoDe将视频压缩为LLM会自发地预测到的深层符号.

blocks.en:
Semantic alignment adds a further requirement.
A reconstruction-optimal latent may keep texture and local motion without organizing them into the objects, events, and relations needed for understanding, while a highly semantic latent may discard the detail that generation needs.
VILA-U Wu et al., 2025e trains one discrete tokenizer for both reconstruction and text alignment, and the SEED tokenizer Ge et al., 2024a gives a language model a semantically organized visual code.
PyraTok Susladkar et al., 2026 quantizes features at several spatiotemporal scales against one text-guided codebook, so coarse semantics and fine detail occupy different levels.
Section 7 pursues this question in models that share LLMs, parameters, or objectives across understanding and generation.
blocks.zh:
语义一致又增加了一项要求.
重建-最佳潜想可能保持纹理和局部运动,而不将它们组织成理解所需的物体、事件和关系,而高度语义潜想则可能放弃一代人所需要的细节。
VILA-U 维基百科 Wu et al.,2025e为重建与文本对接而训练出一款离散的活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化了活字化了活字化活字化活字化活字化活字化了活字化活字化了活字化活字化了活字化了活字化活字化了活字化字化活字化字化. Wu等,2024a,2024a)为"Se"Se"Se"W"W")"(W")"
派拉语Name Tok Susladkar 等,2026年 将特征在几个spatiotemporal比照一个文本制导的编码本进行分数,因此粗糙的语义和细细细节占据了不同的级别.
第7节在各种模式中探讨这个问题,这些模式在理解和生成方面共享法学硕士学位、参数或目标。

blocks.en:
Representation autoencoders start from the semantic side: they freeze a pretrained encoder as the tokenizer and train only a projector or pooler and a decoder.
V-RAE Guo et al., 2026 compares image and video encoders such as DINOv3 and V-JEPA 2.1 and finds that reconstruction ranking does not consistently predict generation quality, so a semantic latent must be tested inside the target generator.
blocks.zh:
表示自编码器从语义方面开始:它们会冻结一个被预先训练的编码器作为指示器,并且只训练一个投影器或池子和解码器.
紫外线 Guo等,2026年比较了DINOv3和V-JEPA 2.1等图像和视频编码器,并发现重建排名不能一致地预测生成质量,因此必须在目标生成器内部测试一个语义潜伏.

blocks.en: 6.3 Generative Video Foundation Modeling
blocks.zh: 6.3 基因视频基金会建模

blocks.en:
Video generators differ in their generative objective, the order in which space-time units are predicted, and the system that organizes synthesis.
Diffusion, autoregressive or masked prediction, and flow matching define model-level generation processes (Figure 5 ), whereas LLM/MLLM-assisted and agentic systems add planning, tool use, and revision around a visual generator that may use any of the three.
The levels combine in practice: a system may denoise each chunk while rolling out autoregressively in time, and an agent may repeatedly call a flow-based generator.
Preference optimization is applied on top of these generators.
VideoReward Liu et al., 2025a aligns a flow-based generator with Flow-DPO on a multidimensional preference signal, and LiFT Wang et al., 2024e applies reward-weighted fine-tuning with a reward model learned from human annotations.
World-R1 Wang et al., 2026d uses feedback from pretrained 3D and vision-language models to reinforce geometric consistency through Flow-GRPO.
Table 12 compares representative systems whose technical routes are publicly documented.
blocks.zh:
视频生成器在基因目标,预测时空单位的顺序,以及组织合成的系统上各不相同.
分化,自回或被遮蔽的预测,流相匹配定义了模型级生成过程(图5),而LLM/MLLM辅助和代理系统则会围绕一个可能使用其中任何一种的可视生成器来添加规划,工具使用和修改.
这些电位在实践中是结合在一起的:一个系统可能使每个电位脱落,同时在时间上自动滚出,而一个电源可能反复调用流源发电机。
在这些发电机上应用优先优化。
视频奖励 刘等,2025a 在多维偏好信号上将以流为主的生成器与Flow-DPO相配合,而LiFT Wang等,2024e采用从人文说明中吸取的奖励模式进行奖励加权微调.
World-R1 Wang 等,2026d 使用经过预训的3D和视觉语言模型的反馈,通过Flow-GRPO增强几何一致性.
表12比较了技术路线公开记录的代表性系统。
