blocks.en: 6.3.1 Diffusion-Based Generation
blocks.zh: 6.3.1 以传播为基础的世代

blocks.en:
Diffusion models learn to reverse a gradual corruption process: a clean video latent is perturbed according to a noise schedule, and the model learns to predict the noise, a velocity, or an equivalent denoising target at any noise level Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 .
The ϵ \epsilon - and v v -prediction objectives and EDM-style schedules are alternative parameterizations of this problem (Section 4.3 ); they affect optimization and sampling, not the video architecture.
Flow-matching generators (Section 6.3.3 ) share these backbones, so the backbone and long-video designs below apply to both.
blocks.zh:
传播模型学会扭转逐渐的腐败过程:一个干净的视频潜伏根据噪声表被扰动,模型学会预测噪声,速度,或者在任何噪声级别上等同的去诺目标. 何来等. 2020; 罗姆巴赫等, 2022.
\\epsilon -和 v - 预测目标与EDM 风格的时间表是这个问题的替代参数化(第4.3节);它们影响优化和取样,而不是视频架构.
流相相发电机(第6.3.3节)共享这些骨干,因此下面的骨干和长视频设计都适用于两者.

blocks.en:
Backbone and attention. Early video diffusion systems, including Video Diffusion Models Ho et al., 2022a , Imagen Video Ho et al., 2022 , and Make-A-Video Singer et al., 2023 , extended convolutional U-Nets with temporal convolutions or factorized spatial and temporal attention.
Lumiere Bar-Tal et al., 2024 instead generates the whole clip in one pass with a space-time U-Net that downsamples in both space and time, avoiding keyframe generation followed by temporal super-resolution.
Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) Peebles & Xie, 2023 then made it easier to scale attention over compressed space-time tokens.
CogVideoX Yang et al., 2025g , Mochi Genmo Team, 2024 , and LTX-Video HaCohen et al., 2024 pair a causal or highly compressed video VAE with a DiT.
CogVideoX uses an expert Transformer with separate text and video normalization, Mochi gives the visual stream more capacity in an asymmetric DiT, and LTX-Video compresses aggressively so that full spatiotemporal attention stays affordable.
Joint audio-video backbones couple two modality streams through bidirectional cross-modal attention, so timing and semantics are exchanged throughout synthesis.
LTX-2 HaCohen et al., 2026 extends LTX-Video with separate modality VAEs and asymmetric audio and video streams, and Ovi Low et al., 2025 couples matched audio and video DiTs trained with flow matching.
blocks.zh:
后骨并发. 早期视频传播系统,包括视频传播模型 Ho等人,2022a,影像视频 Ho等人,2022年,和Make-A-Video Singer等,2023年,以时间演化或因地制宜地分解空间和时间注意力来扩展革命型U-Net.
Lumiere Bar-Tal等,2024年取而代之的是用一个时空U-Net在空间和时间上都下取样来生成整段片段,避免了键框生成后出现时空超分辨率.
分流变形器(DiTs) Peebles & Xie, 2023后更方便地将注意力比压缩的时空符号更能被放大.
缩写 Yang等,2025g,Mochi Genmo Team, 2024, and LTX-Video HaCohen等, 2024 相配一出因果或高度压缩的视频 VAE 有一出DiT.
科格维多 X使用一个具有单独文本和视频正常化的专家变形器,Mochi在不对称的DiT中给予视觉流更多的容量,而LTX-Video压缩则激烈地进行,以便完全的spatiental关注保持可承受.
联合音频-视频主干线通过双向交叉模式的注意来将两个模式流相接,因此时间和语义在整个合成过程中交换.
LTX-2 HaCohen等人,2026年 以单独的模式VAEs和不对称的音频和视频流来扩展LTX-Video,而Ovi Low等人,2025年 情侣匹配了经过流量匹配培训的音频和视频 DiT.

blocks.en:
The main backbone trade-off concerns attention.
Factorized attention separates spatial and temporal interactions to save cost, whereas full spatiotemporal attention lets all space-time tokens interact at a higher memory cost.
Sparse and linear attention cut this cost for long or high-resolution clips.
HunyuanVideo 1.5 Wu et al., 2025 uses selective and sliding tile attention within a unified T2V and I2V training framework, and SANA-Video 2.0 Chen et al., 2026c interleaves gated linear attention with periodic softmax layers and routes block summaries across depth.
Conditions enter the backbone through cross-attention, adaptive normalization such as AdaLN, joint text-video attention, or channel and token concatenation (Section 6.4 ).
blocks.zh:
主要的骨干取舍涉及关注。
因素化的注意将空间和时间的相互作用分开来节省成本,而全时的注意则让所有时空符以更高的内存成本相互作用.
斯帕斯和线性关注为长片或高分辨率片段削减了这一成本.
湖南卫视1.5 Wu等人,2025年 在统一的T2V和I2V训练框架内使用选择性和滑动的瓦片注意,而SANA-Video 2.0 Chen等人,2026c相接出有门的线性注意与周期性软马克斯地层相接,路线阻断摘要跨深度.
条件通过交叉关注、适应性正常化(如AdaLN)、联合文本-视频关注或通道和信使凝聚(第6.4节)进入主干。

blocks.en:
Streaming and long videos. Standard diffusion denoises a fixed-length clip as a whole, whereas streaming variants generate causally, chunk by chunk.
Diffusion Forcing Chen et al., 2024 gives each frame its own noise level, MAGI-1 Teng et al., 2025 denoises chunks autoregressively, CausVid Yin et al., 2025 distills a bidirectional model into a few-step causal generator, Self-Forcing Huang et al., 2025a trains on the model’s own rollouts, and Causal Forcing Zhu et al., 2026a distills from an autoregressive teacher (Section 8.2.2 , Table 17 ).
S2PD Hu et al., 2026b instead changes the sampling order within a clip, generating blocks autoregressively at high noise, then refining the sequence in parallel at low noise.
blocks.zh:
流出和长视频。 标准扩散使固定长度的夹片整体化,而流出变体则产生因果分出块.
扩散 Chen等,2024年给出了每个框架的自有噪声水平,MAGI-1 Teng等,2025 denoises自发地块, CausVid Yin等人,2025年将双向型号蒸馏成几相因子生成器,自强黄等人,2025a次列车在模型本身的推出上,Causal Forcing Zhu等人,2026a次蒸馏出自自自递式教师(第8.2.2节,表17.
S2PD 软件 Hu等,2026b取而代之,在一个片段内改变采样顺序,在高噪声下自动地生成块,再在低噪声下平行地提炼出序列.

blocks.en:
Long videos raise a different problem: repeated local generation keeps short-term motion but gradually loses appearance and global structure.
StreamingT2V Henschel et al., 2025 carries anchor frames and short- and long-term memory across windows, FreeLong Lu et al., 2024 blends low-frequency global features with high-frequency local ones during denoising without training, and FramePack Zhang et al., 2025c compresses past frames by importance to bound the context.
Other methods change training or the history representation.
LongTake Park et al., 2026 supervises later frames from long real-video prefixes before self-rollout distribution matching, and its evaluation separates sustained motion from appearance quality, since a nearly static continuation can score well on consistency.
Test-time training Dalal et al., 2025 stores context in MLP weights that a self-supervised loss updates while the sequence is processed, and has been demonstrated on one-minute, storyboard-conditioned cartoons.
blocks.zh:
长相相片提出了另一个问题: 重复的本地一代保持了短期运动,但逐渐失去外观和全球结构.
流线 T2V Henschel等人,2025年,搭载锚架和短期和长期内存横跨窗户,FreeLong Lu等人,2024年 将低频全球地物与未经培训的去声时的高频局部地物相融合,FramePack Zhang等人,2025年c 按重要性压缩了过去的地物来约束上下文.
其他方法改变培训或历史代表性。
长取 Park et al., 2026监督后期帧在自滚出发行匹配前从长真视频前缀中分出,其评价将持续运动与外观质量区分开来,因为近乎静态的续作可以在一致性上得分良好.
试验时间培训 Dalal等,2025 将上下文存储于 MLP 加权中,在处理序列时进行自控的损失更新,并在一分钟,故事板条件卡通上被演示出.

blocks.en: 6.3.2 Autoregressive and Masked Token Generation
blocks.zh: 6.3.2 自动递归和蒙面托肯一代

blocks.en:
Autoregressive video models factorize the distribution over an ordered sequence of video units.
With discrete tokens, this resembles language modeling: VideoGPT Yan et al., 2021 paired a VQ-VAE with a Transformer prior over video codes, CogVideo Hong et al., 2023 scaled the recipe to text-conditioned generation, and VideoPoet Kondratyuk et al., 2024 applied it in a multimodal sequence model.
Loong Wang et al., 2024f places text and video tokens in one sequence and uses short-to-long training and inference-time re-encoding to limit error accumulation in minute-level videos.
InfinityStar Liu et al., 2025b extends discrete autoregression to 720p image, video, and long-video generation, reporting about 30 times lower latency than Wan 2.1-14B in its own single-GPU setting.
The route offers a standard causal likelihood and flexible length, at the cost of long decoding chains, dependence on tokenizer quality, and errors that propagate through the prefix.
blocks.zh:
自动后退式视频模型将发行量纳入一个顺序的视频单元。
与离散符号类似语言模型: VideoGPT Yan等,2021年将一款VQ-VAE与一台变形器在视频代码上之前配对,CogVideo Hong等,2023年将配方缩放为有文本条件的生成,而VideoPoet Kondratyuk等,2024年将其应用于多模式序列模型.
Loong Wang et al., 2024f 将文本和视频符号放入一个序列,并使用短到长的培训和推断时间再编码,以限制分钟视频中的错误积累.
无穷星 刘等,2025b 将离散自旋扩展至720p图像,视频,和长视频生成,在自己的单相GPU设定中报告延迟度比Wan 2.1-14B低约30倍.
路由提供了标准的因果概率和灵活的长度,代价是长的解码链,依赖活化剂质量,以及通过前缀传播的错误.

blocks.en:
Masked generation relaxes the one-token-at-a-time order: the model predicts sets of masked positions from visible tokens, often refining coarse-to-fine over several rounds.
Phenaki Villegas et al., 2023 applies a bidirectional masked Transformer to causal video tokens, MAGVIT-v2 Yu et al., 2024 improves the tokenizer and the masked generation framework, and Lumos-1 Yuan et al., 2026 keeps frames causal while decoding each frame in parallel with mask-based discrete diffusion.
Continuous tokens support the same factorization.
MAR Li et al., 2024b introduced a diffusion loss for the conditional distribution of a continuous image token, and NOVA Deng et al., 2025a and VideoMAR Yu et al., 2025 carry it to video, predicting frames causally in time and continuous tokens within each frame with a diffusion loss.
blocks.zh:
被蒙蔽的一代可以放松一脚一脚一脚的顺序:模型从可见的活物上预测出被蒙蔽的几组位置,经常会通过多发来精炼粗糙到精细.
Phenaki Villegas等,2023年 对因果视频符号应用了双向口罩变形器,MAGVIT-v2 Yu等,2024年改进了活化剂和口罩生成框架,而Lumos-1 Yuan等,2026年将帧因果保留下来,同时将每个帧的解码与口罩分离散平行.
连续符号支持同样的要素化.
马尔 Li等, 2024b, 引入了对连续图像符号有条件发行的传播损失, NOVA Deng等, 2025a和VideoMAR Yu等,2025年将它带入视频,在时间上对帧进行因果预测,并在每个帧内连续地表示有扩散损失.

blocks.en: 6.3.3 Flow-Based Generation
blocks.zh: 6.3.3 基于流量的生成

blocks.en:
Flow matching Lipman et al., 2023 trains a time-dependent vector field that transports samples from a simple base distribution to the data along a prescribed probability path, and generation integrates the corresponding ordinary differential equation.
It differs from the usual diffusion account in its training target and sampling path: rectified-flow formulations favor nearly straight paths, which can reduce the number of solver steps, and the same DiT or multimodal DiT (MMDiT) can parameterize either target.
Stable Diffusion 3 Esser et al., 2024 made the rectified-flow and MMDiT combination prominent for images, and video systems adapted it to space-time latents.
HunyuanVideo Kong et al., 2024 , Step-Video-T2V Ma et al., 2025 , Goku Chen et al., 2025c , and Wan Wan et al., 2025 scale flow matching with DiT backbones and video VAEs, HunyuanVideo with a dual-stream-to-single-stream Transformer.
Pyramid Flow Jin et al., 2025 changes the path itself, linking spatial pyramid stages and compressing full-resolution history with a temporal pyramid so that one DiT is trained end to end across resolutions.
blocks.zh:
与Lipman等人相匹配的流量,2023训练出一个有时间依赖的矢量场,将样本从简单的碱基分布沿规定的概率路径传输到数据,生成集成相应的普通微分方程.
它不同于其训练目标和采样路径中通常的传播说明:正流配方偏好近直道,这可以减少解步数,而同一种DiT或多模式DiT(MMDIT)可以参数化任一目标.
稳定扩散 3 Esser等人,2024年,使纠正流和MMDiT组合在图像中突出,视频系统将其适应了时空潜伏。
湖南话 视频 Kong等人,2024年,Step-Video-T2V Ma等,2025年,悟空 Chen等, 2025c;和Wan Wan等, 2025 比例流与 DiT 骨干和视频 VAE相匹配, HunyuanVideo 有双流至单流变形器.
Pyramid Flow Jin等,2025年 改变路径本身,将空间金字塔相相接,并用时间金字塔来压缩全分辨率历史,使一款"DiT"被训练后会跨分辨率结束.

blocks.en:
Normalizing flows are a distinct, likelihood-based route that should not be confused with flow matching.
STARFlow-V Gu et al., 2026 applies invertible autoregressive transformations to pretrained video-VAE latents, with a global–local decomposition and a light causal denoiser, so the likelihood is tractable in latent space.
blocks.zh:
使流量正常化是一种独特的、基于可能性的路线,不应与流量匹配相混淆。
STAR-Flow-V号 Gu等人, 2026 将不可逆自旋变换应用到预受训练的视频-VAE潜伏中, 具有全局-局部分解和轻分解因子分解, 因此可能性在潜伏空间中是可以被取走的.

blocks.en:
Figure 6: System-level organization for video generation.
An LLM or MLLM plans for a visual generator through an explicit plan, such as shot lists, storyboards, or layouts, or through learned plan embeddings, and agentic systems close the loop with scripting, generation, evaluation, and revision under a controller.
blocks.zh:
图6:视频生成的系统级组织.
一个LLM或MLLM计划一个视觉生成器,通过一个明确的计划,例如拍摄列表,故事板,或者布局,或者通过学习到的计划嵌入,代理系统通过一个控制器下的脚本,生成,评价和修订来关闭循环.

blocks.en: 6.3.4 LLM/MLLM-Assisted Generation
blocks.zh: 6.3.4 LLM/MLM-辅助生成

blocks.en:
LLM/MLLM-assisted generation covers systems in which a language model plans, expands, captions, or structures the conditions for a separate visual sampler.
A language model that predicts video tokens directly belongs to autoregressive generation instead.
In the common arrangement (Figure 6 ), the language model turns an underspecified request into scenes, shots, layouts, or refined prompts that a diffusion, flow, or autoregressive generator consumes.
VideoDirectorGPT Lin et al., 2024a produces a grounded video plan before layout-conditioned generation, and LLM-grounded Video Diffusion Lian et al., 2024 and Dysen-VDM Fei et al., 2024 draft dynamic scene layouts or scene graphs that guide the denoiser, so the language model handles composition and timing while the video model handles appearance and motion.
Any2Caption Wu et al., 2025b interprets text, image, video, region, motion, and camera cues and translates them into dense structured captions for a downstream generator.
blocks.zh:
LLM/MLLM辅助生成涵盖一个语言模型规划,扩展,标题,或构建单独视觉采样器条件的系统.
一个预测视频符号的语言模型直接属于自递生成.
在共同的安排(图6)中,语言模型将一个未指定的请求转变为场景,镜头,布局,或精细的提示,一个扩散,流出,或自递式生成器所消耗.
视频导演GPT Lin et al., 2024a)在布局有条件的生成前制作有底盘的视频计划,而LLM-有底盘的Video Difusion Lian et al., 2024 and Dysen-VDM Fei等,2024年草案动态场景布局或场景图来指导denoiser,因此语言模型处理组成和时间,而视频模型处理外观和运动.
Any2 标题 Wu等,2025b 诠释了文本,图像,视频,区域,运动,相机提示,并将其翻译为下游生成器的密集结构字幕.

blocks.en:
The language model and the generator can also be coupled more tightly than through a written prompt.
MetaCanvas Lin et al., 2025 lets an MLLM plan in spatial or spatiotemporal latent spaces connected to diffusion backbones, including image-to-video and editing settings.
TV2TV Han et al., 2026 couples the two more tightly, interleaving language next-token prediction with video flow matching in one framework.
blocks.zh:
语言模型和生成器也可以比通过书面提示更紧密地组合.
梅塔坎瓦斯语Name Lin 等,2025年,允许在空间或spatientimpor潜入空间中,与传播主干连接,包括图像到视频和编辑设置,MLLM计划.
电视2TV Han等人,2026年 更紧密地与两个情侣, 交接语言 次接相接的预测 视频流匹配在一个框架。

blocks.en: 6.3.5 Agentic Generation
blocks.zh: 6.3.5 物剂生成

blocks.en:
Agentic generation turns planning into an executable loop: a controller decomposes a request, calls specialized models or tools, inspects intermediate results, and revises the plan or conditions when the output falls short (Figure 6 ).
The recurring stages are scripting, storyboarding, visual generation, evaluation, and revision.
blocks.zh:
代理生成将规划转换为可执行循环:一个控制器会分解一个请求,调用专门的模型或工具,检查中间结果,并在输出不足时修改计划或条件(图6.
反复出现的阶段是脚本、故事板、视觉生成、评价和修订。

blocks.en:
Current agents mainly decompose long-form creation or coordinate tools.
MovieAgent Wu et al., 2025d assigns screenplay, directing, storyboard, and scene construction to cooperating agents, and Anim-Director Li et al., 2024e has an MLLM write a storyline and script, produce consistent scene references, and select outputs from generative tools.
Mora Yuan et al., 2024a routes among generation and editing skills in a multi-agent workflow.
blocks.zh:
目前剂主要分解出长形创建或协调工具.
电影代理商 Wu et al.,2025d为合作代理指定了剧本,导演,故事板和场景构造,而Anim-Director Li et al.,2024e有MLLM写故事线和剧本,制作一致的场景参考,并从基因工具中选择出品.
莫拉语Name Yuan等,2024a在多代理工作流程中的生成和编辑技能路线.

blocks.en: 6.4 Control Strategies
blocks.zh: 6.4 控制战略

blocks.en:
Section 6.1 classifies generation by the information supplied; here we classify control by the component through which that information alters generation.
A camera path, pose sequence, or reference image may enter as input tokens, adapter features, a latent trajectory, sampling guidance, or tuned parameters.
This entry point determines what must be trained, how strong and local the control is, and how easily several signals combine.
Figure 7 locates the entry points relative to the backbone, and Table 13 compares the six families.
A single system often combines several, as in source inversion followed by attention reuse and classifier-free guidance.
blocks.zh:
第6.1节按提供的信息对生成进行分类;在此,我们按该信息改变生成的组件对控制进行分类。
相机路径、姿势序列或参考图像可作为输入符、适配器特征、潜在轨迹、取样指向或调制参数输入。
这个切入点决定了必须训练什么,控制有多强大和局部,以及几个信号如何容易地结合.
图7列出了与骨干相对的切入点,表13比较了六个家庭。
单一系统往往结合几个系统,如源倒置,然后是注意力再利用和无分级器引导.

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Control mechanisms by intervention site.
Each route is identified by the component through which its principal control signal enters generation: the input, the attention maps, the latent state, block features, parameters and embeddings, or the sampling update.
blocks.zh:
图7:按干预地点分列的控制机制。
每个路径由其主要控制信号进入生成过程的组件识别:输入,注意图,潜伏状态,块特征,参数和嵌入,或采样更新.

blocks.en: Table 13: Control strategies for video generation, grouped by where the control signal enters the generator (Figure 7 ). Practical systems often combine several families.
blocks.zh: 表13: 视频生成的控制策略,按控制信号进入生成器的地点分组(图7). 实用的系统往往把几个家庭结合起来。

blocks.en: 6.4.1 Attention-Based Control
blocks.zh: 6.4.1 注意控制

blocks.en:
Attention-based methods reuse the correspondences that a text-conditioned generator already forms: cross-attention links prompt tokens to spatial features, and self-attention relates visual features to one another.
Prompt-to-Prompt Hertz et al., 2023 injects cross-attention maps from a source prompt into the denoising run for an edited prompt, keeping the layout while changing a word, an attribute, or a concept’s strength.
blocks.zh:
基于注意的方法重用文本条件生成器已经形成的对应物:交叉注意将即时符号与空间特征相链接,自我注意将视觉特征相联.
快速到Prompt Hertz et al., 2023 从源代码的快取地图注入被编辑的快取的去名运行中, 在改变一个单词、一个属性或一个概念的强度时保持布局 。

blocks.en:
Video editing also needs the change to stay stable across frames.
Video-P2P Liu et al., 2024a and FateZero Qi et al., 2023 combine attention control with inversion of the source video.
Video-P2P adds separate guidance for source and target prompts, and FateZero fuses source and target cross- and self-attention maps recorded during inversion.
TokenFlow Geyer et al., 2024 instead propagates diffusion features between frames through feature-space correspondences, so an image editor produces temporally consistent edits without training.
blocks.zh:
视频编辑还需要改变才能保持跨帧稳定.
视频-P2P 刘等,2024a和FateZero Qi等,2023年将注意力控制与源视频倒置相结合.
Video-P2P为源和目标提示添加了单独的指针,而FateZero引信的源和在倒置时记录的目标交叉和自留图.
TokenFlow Geyer等人,2024年转而通过地物-空间通信在帧之间传播传播特征,因此一幅图像编辑器在没有训练的情况下产生时间上一致的编辑.

blocks.en: 6.4.2 Adapter-Based Control
blocks.zh: 6.4.2 基于适应器的控制

blocks.en:
Adapters add a trainable path for external structure while keeping most or all of the pretrained generator frozen.
ControlNet Zhang et al., 2023a copies the encoder blocks of a frozen image diffusion model into a conditional branch joined by zero-initialized convolutions, whereas T2I-Adapter Mou et al., 2024 adds features from a small condition encoder at several resolutions.
They represent the two main variants: a heavy side network that mirrors the backbone and a light adapter that produces residual features.
blocks.zh:
适配器为外部结构添加了可被训练路径,同时使大部分或全部被预先训练的发电机被冻结.
控制网 Zhang等,2023a将被冷冻的图像传播模型的编码器块复制成由零初始化的分解结合的有条件分解,而T2I-Adapter Mou等,2024在多份分辨率中从一个小条件编码器中添加了特征.
它们代表了两个主要的变体:一是反射出主干线的重型侧式网络,一是产生剩余特性的光适配器.

blocks.en:
Video adapters must also encode how a condition changes over time.
MotionCtrl Wang et al., 2024i represents camera motion with poses and object motion with trajectories so that the two can be composed.
VideoControlNet Hu & Xu, 2023 brings ControlNet to video-to-video translation with motion guidance that keeps the injected structure aligned across frames.
Unified adapters train several controls together.
VACE Jiang et al., 2025 encodes reference frames, source video, and masks in a Video Condition Unit and injects them into a frozen DiT through a context adapter, supporting reference generation, editing, and masked editing with shared adapter parameters.
blocks.zh:
视频适配器还必须编码一个条件如何随时间变化.
动议 Wang等,2024i代表相机运动有姿势,物体运动有轨电车,使两者能组成.
视频控制 Net Hu & Xu, 2023年将ControlNet带入视频到视频的翻译中,带有使注入结构保持跨帧对齐的运动引导.
统一的适配器一起训练几个控制器.
瓦努阿图 Jiang等,2025年 将参考框架,源视频和口罩编码在一个视频条件单元中,并通过上下文适配器将其注入被冻结的DiT,支持参考生成,编辑,并用共享适配器参数进行口罩编辑.

blocks.en: 6.4.3 Latent-Space Control
blocks.zh: 6.4.3 后舱空间控制

blocks.en:
Latent-space methods act on the noisy sample or the denoising trajectory itself.
Partial noising, as in SDEdit Meng et al., 2022 , perturbs an input to an intermediate noise level and denoises it under a new condition, so the noise level trades fidelity against edit strength.
Inversion maps an observed video to a noise trajectory from which the generator approximately reconstructs it, often through deterministic DDIM sampling Song et al., 2021 ; editing then changes the condition or selected latents along the reverse path.
blocks.zh:
低等空间方法在吵闹的样本上 或自毁轨迹上发挥作用
部分点名,如SDedit Meng等人,2022年,扰动了中间噪声水平的输入并让其在新的条件下被去除,因此噪声水平与编辑强度相交换忠实.
Inversion将一个被观测到的视频映射到一个噪声轨迹上,生成器大约从中重建出,通常通过Song等人的决定性DDIM采样,2021年;然后编辑后沿着倒向路径改变条件或选定的潜伏.

blocks.en:
A method may also construct latent conditions directly.
Wan-Move Chu et al., 2025 projects dense point trajectories into latent space and propagates first-frame features along them, giving an image-to-video model a motion condition without a separate motion encoder.
VLIPP Yang et al., 2025d has a vision-language model plan coarse object motion, renders the plan as a synthetic motion video, and converts its optical flow into structured noise that initializes a motion-controllable image-to-video model (Section 8.2.4 ).
blocks.zh:
一种方法也可直接构建潜在条件。
婉动 Chu等人,2025年将密集点轨迹投射入潜入空间,并沿着它们传播出第一帧地物,给一个图像到视频模型一个运动条件,没有单独的运动编码器.
VLIPP 软件 Yang等,2025d有一个视觉语言模型计划粗糙的物体运动,使该计划成为合成运动视频,并将其光学流转化为结构化噪声,初始化了可运动可控图像到视频模型(第8.2.4节).

blocks.en: 6.4.4 Concatenation and In-Context Conditioning
blocks.zh: 6.4.4 结合和内附条件

blocks.en:
The most direct route places the condition in the model input.
Channel concatenation appends aligned condition latents to the noisy video latent, as in the image-to-video variants of Stable Video Diffusion Blattmann et al., 2023 and CogVideoX Yang et al., 2025g and in VideoComposer Wang et al., 2023a , which fuses spatial and temporal conditions before concatenation.
Token concatenation instead appends condition embeddings to the sequence processed by self- or joint attention.
blocks.zh:
最直接的路由将条件放入模型输入.
频道接合附件将潜在条件与噪音视频接合,如2023年稳定视频传播布拉特曼等和CogVideoX的图像到视频变体 Yang等,2025g和VideoComposer Wang等,2023a.中,将空间和时间条件融为一体后再接合.
Token contentation 代替将条件嵌入到由自注意力或联合注意力处理的序列中.

blocks.en:
FullDiT Ju et al., 2025 maps heterogeneous conditions into one sequence and models them with full attention, avoiding separately trained side branches.
In-context generation places reference examples or source–target pairs in the sequence so that the model infers the requested transformation, as Emu2 Sun et al., 2024 showed for multimodal image generation and UNIC Ye et al., 2026a applies to unified video editing.
Retrieval can supply further condition tokens: PhysRAG Cheng et al., 2026a retrieves videos of relevant physical phenomena, extracts physical information, and injects it into a video diffusion model through learnable queries.
blocks.zh:
满分 Ju等人,2025年,将各种条件绘制成一个序列,并充分注意加以模型,避免单独训练的副分支。
Context生成将参考实例或源目标对放在序列中,以便模型推断所要求的变换,如Emu2 Sun等人,2024年为多模式图像生成显示,而UNIC Ye等人,2026a适用于统一的视频编辑。
检索可以提供进一步的条件符: 医生 Cheng等,2026a取回了相关物理现象的视频,取出物理信息,并通过可学习的查询将其注入视频传播模型.

blocks.en: 6.4.5 Guidance-Based Control
blocks.zh: 6.4.5 指导性控制

blocks.en:
Guidance changes the sampling direction instead of adding a persistent condition branch.
Classifier-free guidance (CFG) Ho & Salimans, 2022 combines conditional and unconditional predictions at each denoising step, ϵ ^ cfg = ϵ θ ​ ( z k , k , ∅ ) + γ ⁡ ( ϵ θ ​ ( z k , k , c ) − ϵ θ ​ ( z k , k , ∅ ) ) , \widehat{\epsilon}_{\mathrm{cfg}}=\epsilon_{\theta}(z_{k},k,\varnothing)+\gamma\bigl(\epsilon_{\theta}(z_{k},k,c)-\epsilon_{\theta}(z_{k},k,\varnothing)\bigr), (6) where z k z_{k} is the noisy latent at denoising step k k , ∅ \varnothing denotes the null condition, and γ \gamma is the guidance scale; γ = 1 \gamma=1 recovers the conditional prediction.
CFG needs a model trained with condition dropout, and raising γ \gamma usually strengthens alignment but reduces diversity.

More general guidance uses the gradient of an energy, attention, correspondence, or physical objective to modify each update and can impose constraints absent from the training data.
Universal guidance Bansal et al., 2024 and training-free energy guidance Yu et al., 2023 use external objectives, whereas diffusion self-guidance Epstein et al., 2023 defines them on the generator’s internal attention and feature maps.
blocks.zh:
更一般的指导利用能量、注意力、通信或物理目标的梯度来修改每次更新,并可施加培训数据所没有的限制。
通用指导 Bansal等人,2024年和无培训能源指导 Yu等人,2023年使用外部目标,而扩散自导Epstein等人,2023年则在生成器的内部注意力和地物图上定义了这些目标.

blocks.en: 6.4.6 Tuning-Based Control
blocks.zh: 6.4.6 接力控制

blocks.en:
Tuning stores a new subject, style, or source-video prior in learned embeddings or weights.
For images, Textual Inversion Gal et al., 2023 learns new text embeddings for a user concept, DreamBooth Ruiz et al., 2023 fine-tunes the model on a few subject images with a prior-preservation loss, and LoRA Hu et al., 2022 learns low-rank weight updates while keeping the base weights fixed.
Video adds the requirement that the learned identity stay stable under motion and viewpoint change.
blocks.zh:
Tuning 在所学的嵌入或分量中存储了一个新的主题,风格,或源视频前.
对于图像, 文本倒置 Gal等,2023 为用户概念学习了新文本嵌入, DreamBooth Ruiz等,2023 微调了在几个主题图像上的模型,预留损失;而Lora Hu等,2022 学习了低等重量更新,同时保持了基重不变.
视频还增加了一项要求,即学习到的身份在运动和观点变化时必须保持稳定。

blocks.en:
Tune-A-Video Wu et al., 2023 and LoRA-Edit Gao et al., 2026 tune on each source video.
Tune-A-Video adapts an image diffusion model from one text–video pair with spatiotemporal attention and DDIM inversion, and LoRA-Edit applies mask-aware LoRA tuning to an image-to-video model, taking structure and motion from the source and edited appearance from reference images.
Video2LoRA Wu et al., 2026d avoids per-reference optimization: a hypernetwork predicts reference-specific LoRA weights in one forward pass.
blocks.zh:
Tune-A-视频 Wu et al., 2023 and LoRA-Edit Gao et al., 2026曲调在每个源视频上.
Tune-A-Video从一个文本中调整出一对图像扩散模型——video配对并带有spatiopal关注和DDIM倒置,而Lora-Edit则将口罩-意识LORA调用到一对图像到视频模型,从源头取来结构和运动,从参考图像中编辑出外观.
视频2LORA Wu等,2026d避免了每个引用优化:一个超网络预测一个前传中特定引用的LORA权重.

blocks.en: 6.5 Applications
blocks.zh: 6.5 申请

blocks.en:
Generated video serves as content, as an avatar, as a visual plan, or as training data, and each use places different demands on conditioning, latency, consistency, and evaluation.
Systems that also model action-conditioned transitions are treated in Section 8 .
blocks.zh:
生成的视频作为内容,作相机,作为视觉计划,或作为培训数据,每种使用都对条件,耐久性,一致性和评价提出了不同的要求.
第8节处理同样为行动条件过渡模式的系统。

blocks.en: 6.5.1 Creative Content Production
blocks.zh: 6.5.1 创造性内容制作

blocks.en:
Video generation enters production at several stages, from concept shots and storyboards to narrative footage, advertising and educational variants, and visual-effects edits.
The agentic systems of Section 6.3.5 handle planning and tool orchestration, while foundation generators increasingly bundle creation and revision operations.
Following Sora Brooks et al., 2024 , Movie Gen Polyak et al., 2024 combines text-to-video generation with personalization, instruction-based editing, and synchronized audio.
Closed systems such as Kling Kuaishou Technology, 2024 and Sora 2 OpenAI, 2025 offer text- and image-to-video generation as products, and Sora 2 adds synchronized audio.
Open models such as VideoCrafter2 Chen et al., 2024a , Open-Sora Zheng et al., 2024 , Wan Wan et al., 2025 , HunyuanVideo Kong et al., 2024 , and Step-Video-T2V Ma et al., 2025 make text-to-video generation available through released weights.
Seedance 1.0 Gao et al., 2025a adds native multi-shot generation with consistent subjects, and Seedance 2.0 Team Seedance et al., 2026 accepts text, image, audio, and video inputs for joint audio-video generation, reference-based generation, and editing.
blocks.zh:
视频生成进入制作的几个阶段,从概念镜头和故事板到叙事镜头,广告和教育变体,视觉效果编辑.
第6.3.5节的代理系统处理规划和工具的编组,而基础发电机则越来越多地捆绑创建和修订业务。
追随空后 Brooks等,2024年; Movie Gen Polyak等,2024年 将文本到视频生成与个性化相结合,以指导为主的编辑,同步音频.
Kling Kuaishou Technology,2024和Sora 2 OpenAI,2025等封闭系统提供文本和图像到视频生成作为产品,而Sora 2则增加了同步音频.
打开像 VideoCrafter2 这样的模型 陈等,2024a,开放索拉 Zheng等,2024年;Wan Wan等,2025年;Hunyuan 视频 Kong等, 2024年, 和Step-Video-T2V Ma等,2025年通过放出重量提供文本到视频生成.
种子1.0 Gao et al.,2025a 添加了本土多镜头生成,主题一致,而"种子2.0 Team Seedance"et al.,2026 接受文本,图像,音频,视频输入,用于联合音频-视频生成,基于参考生成,并进行编辑.

blocks.en:
Production also needs what per-clip realism does not measure: keeping a character, location, or style across shots, revising one element without disturbing the rest, and controlling camera and motion.
These needs tie personalization and control (Section 6.4 ) to cross-shot and preference evaluation (Section 6.1.2 ).
blocks.zh:
制作还需要每个剪接现实主义无法衡量的东西:保持一个人物,位置,或风格横穿镜头,修改一个元素而不扰扰其他元素,以及控制相机和运动.
这些需要将个性化和控制(第6.4节)与交叉镜头和偏好评价挂钩(第6.1.2节)。

blocks.en: 6.5.2 Avatars and Character Animation
blocks.zh: 6.5.2 神通和人物动画

blocks.en:
Avatar generation maps speech, motion, or other control signals to the visible behavior of a person or character.
Its lineage runs through the audio-driven systems of Section 6.1 : Wav2Lip Prajwal et al., 2020 edits the mouth region with a lip-sync expert, and SadTalker Zhang et al., 2023b predicts expression and head-pose coefficients of a 3D face model.
Diffusion models such as EMO Tian et al., 2024 and Hallo Xu et al., 2024 generate expressive portrait motion directly from audio, and VLOGGER Corona et al., 2025 extends the output to the upper body with hand and gesture motion from a single reference image.
Pose-driven animation, as in Animate Anyone Hu, 2024 and MagicAnimate Xu et al., 2024a , replaces audio with a motion sequence and is judged against that motion instead of speech.
In both settings, identity, clothing, background, and non-speech motion must stay stable over long or varied inputs.
blocks.zh:
神通一代将语音,运动或其他控制信号映射到一个人或人物的可见行为上.
其分系贯穿了6.1节的音频驱动系统: Wav2Lip Prajwal等,2020年用唇音专家来编辑口区,而SadTalker Zhang等,2023b预测了3D面模的表达和头像系数.
2024年EMO Tian等人和Hallo等传播模型 徐等,2024 从音频直接生成表达式肖像运动,而VLOGGER Corona等,2025年 将输出用手和手势运动从单一参考图像延伸至上体.
Pose驱动动画,如"Animate Anyone Hu","2024"和"MagicAnimate Xu等"等2024a中,将音频取而代之,取而代之的是动作序列并被判定为以该动作取而代之.
在这两种情况下,身份、服装、背景和非言论运动都必须在长期或多种投入中保持稳定。

blocks.en:
Real-time avatars must also produce frames at a sustained rate with bounded delay while staying synchronized with incoming audio or motion.
MuseTalk Zhang et al., 2024a dubs video in latent space and reports 30 frames per second at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution on a V100 GPU.
Vidu S1 Zhang et al., 2026f lets voice instructions redirect an ongoing character stream, and Vidu S2 Zhang et al., 2026e adds references that can be updated during streaming and frame-aligned editing of an incoming video stream.
Mid-stream control adds action-to-output latency to throughput as a criterion and links avatars to the real-time interactive world models of Section 8.2.3 .
blocks.zh:
实时相机还必须以持续的速度产生帧并有限定的延迟,同时与来电音频或运动同步.
MuseTalk 语言 Zhang等,2024a dubs 视频在潜伏空间,并以256×256256\times 256分辨率报告每秒30帧的V100 GPU.
维都S1 Zhang等,2026f允许语音指令重定向一个进行中的角色流,而Vidu S2 Zhang等,2026e添加了可以在流出和帧相通编辑来袭视频流时更新的引用.
中流控制为吞吐量增加了动作对输出时滞,并将此作为标准,并连接到8.2.3节的实时交互世界模型.

blocks.en: 6.5.3 Video Plans for Embodied Agents
blocks.zh: 6.5.3 健康代理人录像计划

blocks.en:
Generated video can serve as a plan between a task specification and physical execution, and methods differ mainly in how they recover actions from it.
UniPi Du et al., 2023 generates a future video from a text task and extracts controls with an inverse dynamics model, using images as a planning space shared by embodiments with different action spaces.
AVDC Ko et al., 2024 infers actions from dense correspondences between generated frames, so policies can be learned from videos without action labels.
RoboDreamer Zhou et al., 2024 composes video predictions of reusable instruction primitives to generalize to new object–action combinations, and Dreamitate Liang et al., 2025 fine-tunes a video model on human demonstrations and tracks the generated tool motion to control a robot.
A generated plan stays fixed, whereas an interactive simulator such as UniSim Yang et al., 2024 updates its predictions as actions arrive (Section 8 ).
blocks.zh:
生成的视频可以作为任务规格与实际执行之间的计划,方法主要在如何从中取回动作上有所不同.
UniPi 软件 Du et al., 2023 从文本任务中生成未来的视频,并用反向动态模型提取控制,将图像作为不同动作空间的化身共享的规划空间.
AVDC 维多 Ko等,2024从生成帧之间的密集对应推断出动作,因此可以在没有动作标签的视频中学习政策.
机械梦器 周克等,2024作视频预测可再用指令原生以通俗化为新的对象-动作组合,而Dreamitate Liang等,2025作细化了人类演示的视频模型并跟踪生成的工具运动来控制机器人.
生成的计划保持不变,而UniSim Yang等交互式模拟器则在动作到达时更新预测(第8节)。

blocks.en: 6.5.4 Synthetic Data for Embodied AI and Driving
blocks.zh: 6.5.4 人工智能和驾驶合成数据

blocks.en:
Embodied and driving systems need observations of rare tasks, environments, and failures that are costly or unsafe to collect.
Video generation can supply them offline by varying appearance, layout, traffic, camera pose, or actions while keeping the annotations carried by the condition.
In driving, MagicDrive Gao et al., 2024 conditions multi-camera street views on camera poses, road maps, 3D bounding boxes, and text with cross-view attention, and Panacea Wen et al., 2024 generates annotated multi-view videos from bird’s-eye-view layouts.
DriveDreamer Wang et al., 2024 and GAIA-1 Hu et al., 2023 go further and predict future driving observations under scene or action conditions (Section 8 ).
In robotics, the data must also carry actions: DreamGen Jang et al., 2025 adapts an image-to-video model to a target embodiment and labels its generated trajectories with a latent-action or inverse-dynamics model.
GigaWorld-0 Team et al., 2025 pairs a controllable video generator with 3D generation and system identification to train vision-language-action policies (Section 8 ).
Generated data are judged by downstream perception and policy results on real observations, not by visual fidelity.
blocks.zh:
健全和驱动系统需要观察难得的任务、环境以及收集成本高或不安全的故障。
视频生成可以通过不同的外观,布局,流量,相机姿势,或动作,同时保留条件所携带的说明来提供.
在驾驶方面,MagicDrive Gao 等,2024年在相机姿势上的条件为多相机街景,行进图,3D边框,以及文字有交叉视野的注意;而Panacea Wen等,2024年从鸟眼视野布局中生成了附加说明的多相机视频.
驱动梦想器 Wang等人,2024年和GAIA-1 Hu等人,2023年更进一步,预测未来在现场或行动条件下的驾驶观察(第8节)。
在机器人学中,数据还必须包含动作: 梦幻游戏 Jang等,2025年,将图像到视频模型与目标化相适应,并用潜在动作或反动力模型标出其生成的轨迹.
GigaWorld-0 (英语). Team等,2025年,将可控视频生成器与3D生成器和系统识别相配,以培训视觉语言行动政策(第8节)。
生成的数据是根据下游对真实观察的看法和政策结果来判断的,而不是通过视觉的忠诚来判断的.

blocks.en:
INSIGHT Rendering fidelity and stateful control are distinct scaling axes Video priors increasingly make each clip convincing, yet visual fidelity and stateful control are separate goals.
A good control changes only its target, keeps that change over time, and combines with other controls without disturbing identity, geometry, or motion.
Progress should therefore be measured by comparing matched rollouts with and without the control, not by the quality of each rollout alone.
blocks.zh:
新闻 真实性和状态控制是不同的缩放轴,视频前传使每个片段越来越令人信服,而视觉上的忠实和状态控制则是单独的目标.
良好的控制只改变它的目标, 随时间而改变, 并结合其他控制 而不扰动的身份,几何,或运动。
因此,衡量进展的方法应当是将相应推出与不受控制进行对比,而不是单靠每次推出的质量。

blocks.en: INSIGHT Rendering fidelity and stateful control are distinct scaling axes
blocks.zh: 新闻 保持忠诚和状态控制是独特的缩放轴

blocks.en: 7 Unified Video Models: Sharing the World
blocks.zh: 7 统一视频 型号: 分享世界

blocks.en: Sharing means understanding and generation use common representations, parameters, interfaces, or objectives.
blocks.zh: 共享是指理解并生成使用共同的表示,参数,界面,或目标.

blocks.en:
Video understanding and generation have traditionally relied on separate encoders and generators.
Unified video models implement the sharing relation V ↔ W V\leftrightarrow W of Section 3 : inferred content can condition generation, and generative structure can support understanding and reasoning.
blocks.zh:
视频理解和生成传统上依赖单独的编码器和发电机.
统一视频模型 执行共享关系 V QQ W V\ 右 第3节W:推断出的内容可以附带生成条件,基因结构可以支持理解和推理.

blocks.en:
Definition evaluates sharing at three levels: capability coverage (one system performs both directions), architectural sharing (the directions use common components), and functional synergy (one direction improves the other under a controlled comparison).
We cover systems with video input or output that link understanding and generation, and cite image-only work where it supplies a design or evaluation protocol missing for video.
blocks.zh:
定义在三个层面评价共享:能力覆盖(一个系统执行双向),建筑共享(方向使用共同组件)和功能协同(一个方向在受控比较下改善另一个方向).
我们用视频输入或输出来覆盖系统,将理解和生成联系起来,并引用只提供视频缺失的设计或评价协议的图像作品。

blocks.en: 7.1 Unified Architectures
blocks.zh: 7.1 统一建筑

blocks.en:
Figure 8: Four architecture families for unified video understanding and generation, ordered by the abstraction of what is shared: discrete-token unification shares a token sequence and autoregressive backbone; continuous latent-space unification shares a continuous representation with direction-specific heads; decoupled and modular unification links separate experts through a semantic bridge; and agentic and tool-augmented unification shares a task state maintained by a controller.
The families can be combined: an agent may call tools built on any of the other three.
blocks.zh:
图 8: 4个架构家族,用于统一的视频理解和生成,由所共享内容的抽象排序: 离散-托肯统一共享一个符号序列和自旋回向主干; 持续潜在-空间统一共享一个与方向特定头的连续代表; 解相和模块统一通过语义桥连接独立的专家; 代理和工具辅助统一共享一个控制器维护的任务状态.
家庭可以合并:代理人可以调用其他三个工具。

blocks.en:
Unified architectures differ in where understanding and generation meet (Figure 8 ): in a shared token sequence, a shared continuous latent space, a semantic bridge between decoupled experts, or the task state of an agent that calls specialized tools.
Table 14 compares representative video systems along the component dimensions of Zhao et al. Zhao et al., 2025 .
The first three families have image-domain precedents: Chameleon Team, 2024 for early-fusion token sequences, Transfusion Zhou et al., 2025 for autoregressive text and diffusion images in one Transformer, Janus Wu et al., 2025a for decoupled encoders, and MetaQueries Pan et al., 2025 for learned-query bridges.
On the video side, UniVL Luo et al., 2020 earlier unified video–language understanding and caption generation, though its generated output was text, not video.
blocks.zh:
统一架构在理解和生成的交会地点(图8):在一个共享的符号序列中,一个共享的连续潜入空间,解相专家之间的语义桥梁,或者一个调用专门工具的代理的任务状态.

blocks.en: 7.1.1 Discrete-Token Unification

Discrete-token models convert text, images, and video into symbols that are interleaved in one sequence.
A single Transformer then serves both directions with next-token prediction: answering predicts text tokens after video context, and generation predicts visual tokens after a text or visual condition.
Emu3 Wang et al., 2024b follows this design without diffusion heads, covering image and video understanding and generation, and Emu3.5 Cui et al., 2025 scales the same objective to video-heavy data and reports world-modeling behavior such as spatiotemporally consistent exploration.
Video-LaVIT Jin et al., 2024a cuts the token cost of video by tokenizing keyframes and motion separately, and VILA-U Wu et al., 2025e trains its vision tower to align discrete tokens with language while keeping the detail needed for generation.
SEED-LLaMA Ge et al., 2024a pairs discrete visual tokens with a diffusion image decoder; it answers video questions but generates only images.
Two variants change the role of the tokens or the objective: Vega Wang et al., 2026e predicts semantic keyframe tokens autoregressively and leaves appearance to a diffusion renderer, and NExT-OMNI Luo et al., 2026d replaces autoregression with discrete flow matching over text, image, video, and audio tokens.
blocks.zh:
Discrete-token 模型将文本,图像,和视频转换成以一个序列相接的符号.
然后,一个单变形器服务于相邻的预测的双向:在视频上下文后回答预测文本符号,在文本或视觉条件后生成预测视觉符号.
Emu3 Wang等,2024b 遵循这种设计而不用扩散头,覆盖了图像和视频的理解和生成,而Emu3.5 Cui等,2025 缩放了视频重数据的目标,并报告了瞬间一致探索等世界模型行为.
视频-LaVIT Jin等,2024a,通过分别标出键框和动量来降低视频的象征性成本,以及VILA-U Wu et al.,2025e 训练它的视觉塔来将离散符号与语言相配合,同时保持生成所需的细节.
西德莱玛 Ge等,2024a配对相离视觉符号并配有扩散图像解码器;它回答视频问题而只生成图像.
两种变体改变符或目标的作用: 维嘉 Wang et al., 2026e 自动预测语义键框符并留外观给扩散渲染器,而NExT-OMNI Luo et al., 2026d 以离散流相匹配于文本,图像,视频,和音频等符号来取代自旋.

blocks.en:
This route gives many input–output combinations one vocabulary, one sequence format, and one likelihood objective.
However, the tokenizer becomes the bottleneck: codes must preserve appearance and motion without making sequences unmanageably long, and quantization discards information before the Transformer sees it.
Long autoregressive outputs also accumulate errors through their generated prefix.
blocks.zh:
这个路由给出了许多输入-输出组合一个词汇,一个序列格式,和一个概率目标.
然而,符号化器成为了瓶颈:代码必须保持外观和运动,而不会使序列变得无法管理地长;而量化则会在变形器看到之前丢弃信息.
较长的自旋输出也通过所生成的前缀来累积出错误.

blocks.en: 7.1.2 Continuous Latent-Space Unification
blocks.zh: 7.1.2 连续的近端空间统一

blocks.en:
Continuous latent-space models avoid quantization: an encoder maps images or video into a continuous feature space that an understanding head reads and a decoder, diffusion model, or flow head turns back into pixels.
The latent space is shared, but the losses and output heads can differ, because language prediction and pixel generation have different numerical requirements.
TUNA Liu et al., 2026k cascades a VAE encoder with a representation encoder, and Show-o2 Xie et al., 2025a replaces the discrete vocabulary of Show-o Xie et al., 2025 with a 3D causal VAE; both predict text autoregressively and generate images and video with flow matching.
Uni-ViGU Qin et al., 2026 starts from the other end, extending a video diffusion generator with discrete flow matching for text and lightweight understanding layers.
AToken Lu et al., 2026 and HYDRA-X Zhang et al., 2026a make the tokenizer itself the shared component, training it with reconstruction and semantic objectives over images, video, and, for AToken, 3D.
PixelUMM Wei et al., 2026a drops the pretrained encoder and VAE: pixel patches and video tubelets enter a mixture-of-transformers in which the two directions keep separate projections and feed-forward layers but share attention, supporting video question answering, generation, and editing.
blocks.zh:
持续的潜入空间模型避免被量化:一个编码器将图像或视频映射到一个连续的特征空间,一个理解头读取并解码,扩散模型,或流出头回转成像素.
潜在的空间是共享的,但损失和输出头可能有所不同,因为语言预测和像素生成有不同的数值要求.
泰国 Liu等,2026k级联VAE编码器并配有表示编码器,Show-o2 Xie等,2025a以3D因子VAE取代了Show-o Xie等的离散词汇"2025";两者均以3D因子VAE来自动预测文本并生成图像和相流相匹配的视频.
单声道 秦等,2026从另一端起步,延伸出一个带离散流相匹配的视频传播生成器,用于文本和轻量级理解层.
AToken Lu等,2026年和Hydra-X Zhang等,2026a 使活化器本身成为了共享的部分,在图像,视频上对它进行了重建和语义目标的培训,对AToken来说是3D.
像素Umm Wei等,2026a 放下了被预先训练的编码器和VAE:像素补丁和视频管子进入了变相器的混合物,在变相器中,两个方向分别保持了预测和向导分层,但分享注意力,支持视频提问回答,生成,并进行编辑.

blocks.en:
Continuous spaces fit diffusion and flow generators naturally, but they expose a tension that recurs across unified models.
Understanding benefits from invariance to texture and small appearance changes, whereas generation must retain enough detail to reconstruct them.
blocks.zh:
连续的空间自然地适合扩散和流出发电机,但是它们暴露出一种跨越统一模型的张力.
理解不向纹理变化和小外观变化的好处,而一代人必须保留足够的细节来重建.

blocks.en: 7.1.3 Decoupled and Modular Unification
blocks.zh: 7.1.3 脱钩和模块统一

blocks.en:
Decoupled systems sidestep this tension by keeping separate visual pathways for the two directions, linked through an LLM, a projection layer, or a learned adapter.
The understanding encoder can drop nuisance detail and emphasize objects, relations, actions, or text, while a separate tokenizer or decoder keeps the fine spatial and temporal detail needed to generate video.
NExT-GPT Wu et al., 2024c and GPT4Video Wang et al., 2024h set the modular baseline around an instruction-following LLM and frozen pretrained encoders and generators, so only a small part of the system is trained: NExT-GPT links the LLM to diffusion decoders through lightweight projections, whereas GPT4Video has the LLM write textual prompts for an off-the-shelf text-to-video model.
Later systems train the bridge.
Omni-Video Tan et al., 2025 , UniVid Luo et al., 2025a , and UniVideo Wei et al., 2026 let an MLLM interpret the instruction and pass continuous features through an adapter or bridge to a diffusion decoder; UniVid adds a reflection mechanism for temporal reasoning.
Omni-Video 2 Yang et al., 2026 keeps the MLLM frozen and conditions the decoder on a predicted target caption and source-video latents for editing, and ReViSE Liu et al., 2025d trains an Omni-Video model with feedback from its own VLM (Section 7.2.4 ).
blocks.zh:
脱钩的系统绕过这种张力,通过LLM,投影层,或学习到的适配器,为两个方向保持单独的可视路径相接.
理解编码器可以去掉扰动细节并去强调对象,关系,动作,或文字等,而单独的活化器或解码器则保留产生视频所需的细微的时空细节.
NExT - GPT 系统 Wu等,2024c和GPT4Video Wang等,2024h围绕一个跟随LLM的指令和被冷冻的预先训练的编码器和发电机设定了模块基线,因此只有一小部分系统经过了培训:NExT-GPT通过轻量级预测将LLM连接到扩散解码器,而GPT4Video则有LLM写入文本提示,用于现成的文本到视频模型.
后来的系统对桥进行训练.
央视 Tan等,2025年;UniVid Luo等,2025a;UniVideo Wei等,2026年,让MLLM通过适配器或桥接传递连续特性到扩散解码器;UniVid为时间推理增加了一个反射机制.
央视 2 Yang等,2026年,将MLLM冻结,并将解码器设定在预测的目标标题和源-视频潜在编辑上,ReVise Liu等,2025d 培训一种Omni-Video模型,其反馈来自自己的VLM(第7.2.4节)。

blocks.en:
Other systems redesign the bridge itself.
Lumos-Nexus Xing et al., 2026 aligns a small generator with the understanding model and mixes its velocity predictions with those of a larger pretrained generator at inference.
MoRoute Gao et al., 2026a learns which layer of a frozen VLM conditions each diffusion block, and Mamoda2.5 Shi et al., 2026c feeds semantic features to a sparse-expert diffusion backbone through learned queries.
Lance Fu et al., 2026a replaces the bridge with shared attention: separate semantic and VAE encoders feed dual experts that attend over one interleaved sequence.
JavisGPT Liu et al., 2025c extends the encoder–LLM–decoder pattern to sounding video, passing synchrony-aware queries to a joint audio–video generator.
blocks.zh:
其他系统重新设计了桥梁本身。
卢莫斯- 内克萨斯 Xing等,2026年将一款小型发电机与理解模型相配合,并结合其速度预测与推论中更大的预受训练发电机的预测.
莫鲁特 Gao 等,2026a 学习了每个扩散区块哪个层被冻结的VLM条件,而Mamoda2.5 Shi等人,2026c通过所了解的询问,将语义特征反馈到一个稀缺的专家传播骨干.
兰斯 Fu等人,2026a 以共同关注取代了桥: 单独的语义和VAE编码器为参加一个互分序列的双重专家提供素材.
贾维斯GPT Liu等,2025c将编码器–LLM–解码器模式延伸至发声视频,将同步-感知查询传递给联合音频-视频生成器.

blocks.en:
Decoupling keeps strong pretrained components and makes each one replaceable.
However, the bridge can become an information bottleneck: a semantic clue sufficient for following an instruction may omit the appearance, geometry, or motion that the decoder needs.
blocks.zh:
脱钩保留了很强的预先训练的部件,使每个部件都可以被替换.
然而,桥可以成为一个信息瓶颈:一个足以遵循指令的语义线索可能会省略解码器需要的外观,几何或运动.

blocks.en: 7.1.4 Agentic and Tool-Augmented Unification
blocks.zh: 7.1.4 代理和工具强化统一

blocks.en:
Agentic systems leave perception, generation, editing, and evaluation to specialized models.
A controller reads the request and media, plans operations, calls tools, inspects their outputs, and revises the plan; what is shared is a task state such as a script, shot plan, prompt, edit graph, or critique.
VideoAgent (editing) Zhou et al., 2026a plans shots and retrieves source clips before calling a library of editing agents, and VISTA Long et al., 2026 wraps a video generator in a loop of temporal planning, candidate selection, multimodal critique, and prompt rewriting.
UniVA Liang et al., 2025a plans and calls understanding, generation, editing, and segmentation tools that share global, task, and user memories.
blocks.zh:
代理系统将感知、生成、编辑和评价留给专门模型。
控制器读取请求和介质,计划操作,调用工具,检查其输出,并修改计划;共享的是一个任务状态,如脚本,拍摄计划,即时,编辑图表,或批评.
视频代理(编辑) Zhou et al.,2026a计划拍摄并取回源剪辑后再拨打编辑代理的图书馆,而VISTA Long et al.,2026将视频生成器包裹在时间规划,候选人选择,多模式批评,以及即时重写等循环中.
联盟 Liang 等,2025a计划并呼唤理解,生成,编辑,分解工具共享全球,任务,用户记忆.

blocks.en:
Agents can combine strong tools without forcing their internal representations to agree, and each tool can be swapped as better models appear.
However, they depend on tool selection, intermediate formats, and evaluator reliability: one wrong caption, retrieval result, or critique can redirect the whole workflow.
blocks.zh:
代理可以结合强大的工具而无需强迫其内部代表达成一致,随着更好的模型出现,每个工具都可以被互换.
然而,它们取决于工具选择、中间格式和评价者的可靠性:一个错误的标题、检索结果或批评可以改变整个工作流程的方向。

blocks.en:
Figure 9: Learning paradigms in unified video models.
Isolated learning keeps independently pretrained experts; dual learning relates inverse tasks or reconstruction cycles; co-learning optimizes both directions jointly; and synergistic learning targets cross-direction benefit.
The paradigms can coexist.
blocks.zh:
图9 统一视频模型中的学习范式.
孤立的学习保持了独立的预先培训的专家;双重学习涉及反向任务或重建周期;共同学习可共同优化双向;协同学习目标可实现交叉指导效益.
范式可以并存.

blocks.en: 7.2 Learning Paradigms
blocks.zh: 7.2 学习范式

blocks.en:
Architecture fixes where understanding and generation meet; training determines what signal flows between them (Figure 9 ).
Isolated learning connects independently trained experts, dual learning relates the two directions through inverse or cycle objectives, co-learning optimizes both over shared parameters or representations, and synergistic learning uses one direction to improve the other.
The paradigms can coexist; for example, a cycle objective can be part of joint training.
blocks.zh:
确定理解和生成地点的架构;培训决定它们之间的信号流动(图9)。
孤立的学习连接独立训练的专家,双向学习通过反向或周期目标将两个方向联系起来,共同学习在共享参数或表述上都优化,协同学习用一个方向来改进另一个方向.
模式可以共存;例如,周期目标可以成为联合培训的一部分。

blocks.en: 7.2.1 Isolated Learning
blocks.zh: 7.2.1 孤立学习

blocks.en:
Isolated learning trains understanding and generation as independent experts and connects them after pretraining through a small trained module, while most expert parameters stay frozen.
NExT-GPT Wu et al., 2024c and GPT4Video Wang et al., 2024h follow this recipe (Section 7.1 ), as GILL Koh et al., 2023 did for a frozen language model and a frozen image generator.
Isolated learning is cheap and modular, and the source of each capability stays easy to identify.
However, generation losses never update the video encoder and understanding losses never update the decoder, so no cross-direction transfer can occur, which makes isolated systems the natural baseline for measuring what tighter coupling adds.
blocks.zh:
孤立的学习培训是作为独立专家来理解和生成的,并通过一个经过培训的小型模块进行预训后将其连接起来,而大多数专家参数仍然被冻结.
NExT - GPT 系统 Wu等人,2024c和GPT4Video Wang等人,2024h 遵循了这个食谱(第7.1节),如GILL Koh等人,2023年为冷冻语言模型和冷冻图像生成器.
孤立的学习是廉价的和模块化的,每个能力的来源都保持易于识别.
然而,生成损失从不更新视频编码器,理解损失也从不更新解码器,因此无法发生交叉方向传输,这使得被孤立的系统成为测量收紧耦合所增加内容的自然基线.

blocks.en: 7.2.2 Dual Learning
blocks.zh: 7.2.2 双重学习

blocks.en:
Dual learning treats understanding and generation as approximately inverse problems: a model reconstructs a condition from generated content, regenerates an observation from an inferred representation, or enforces agreement over a round trip.
Such objectives let one direction supervise the other when paired labels are scarce.
As many videos fit one description and one condition allows many valid futures, a video cycle must preserve task-relevant events, identities, viewpoints, and motion while tolerating appearance variation.
blocks.zh:
双重学习将理解和生成视为大致反向的问题:模型从生成的内容中重建一个条件,从推断的表示中再现一个观察,或者在回程中执行协议.
这些目标允许一个方向在配对标签稀缺时监督另一个方向。
由于许多视频符合一个描述和一个条件允许许多有效的未来,视频循环必须保留与任务相关的事件,身份,观点,以及运动,同时容忍外观变异.

blocks.en:
Uni-ViGU Qin et al., 2026 is the clearest video-native example.
Starting from a video generator, it recovers understanding as the inverse task: it first reconstructs prompts to recall learned text–video associations and then trains on detailed captions, keeping the original generation path.
Dedicated cycle objectives remain image-based: CyCLeGen Shan et al., 2026 couples image–layout cycles, UniCorn Fang et al., 2026a distills text–image–text self-play among proposer, solver, and judge roles, and Reconstruction Alignment Xie et al., 2026 trains a model to reconstruct an image from its own understanding embeddings.
blocks.zh:
单声道 秦等,2026年是最清晰的视频本土案例.
从一个视频生成器开始,它恢复了作为反向任务的理解:它首先重建了提醒人们回顾学到的文本 - 视频关联,然后用详细的字幕进行训练,保持原始的生成路径.
CyCleGen Shan等人, 2026 情侣形象-放出循环, UniCorn Fang等人, 2026a 蒸馏文本-图像-文本自玩在提议者, 解析者, 和判断角色, 重建调整 Xie等人, 2026 训练一个模型, 从自己的理解嵌入中重建图像.

blocks.en: 7.2.3 Co-learning
blocks.zh: 7.2.3 共同学习

blocks.en:
Co-learning optimizes understanding and generation objectives in one shared model or a jointly trained bridge, and each of the first three families of Section 7.1 supports it.
Discrete-token models such as Emu3 Wang et al., 2024b , Video-LaVIT Jin et al., 2024a , and VILA-U Wu et al., 2025e apply one next-token objective to both directions, while Vega Wang et al., 2026e shapes a shared semantic token space and keeps a separate diffusion renderer.
Continuous and hybrid models share a visual space or Transformer but keep distinct losses, as in TUNA Liu et al., 2026k , Show-o2 Xie et al., 2025a , HYDRA-X Zhang et al., 2026a , PixelUMM Wei et al., 2026a , and the single-Transformer HaploOmni Xiao et al., 2025 .
BAGEL Deng et al., 2025 co-trains a mixture of transformer experts that share attention but keep direction-specific projections and feed-forward layers, a design Lance applies to video (Section 7.1 ).
Bridge models such as Omni-Video Tan et al., 2025 , UniVid Luo et al., 2025a , and UniVideo Wei et al., 2026 co-train the adapter between an MLLM and a video decoder.
blocks.zh:
共同学习在一个共享模式或联合训练的桥梁中优化了理解和生成目标,第7.1节前三个家族各自支持.
(原始内容存档于2017-10-21). Discrete-toked models 如 Emu3 Wang等, 2024b, Video-LaVIT Jin等,2024a;和VILA-U Wu等,2025e对双向应用了下一个托肯目标;而Vega Wang等,2026e塑造了共享的语义符号空间并保留了单独的扩散渲染器.
如TUNA Liu等人,2026k, Show-o2 Xie等,2025a;Hydra-X;Zhang等,2026a;Pixelumm。 Wei等, 2026a.,和单曲转会 HaploOmni Xiao等, 2025.
巴盖尔 Deng等,2025年,共同绘制了一种变压器专家的混合物,这些专家分享注意力,但保持方向特定的预测和向上分层,一种设计Lance适用于视频(第7.1节.
Omni-Video Tan等桥梁模型,2025年;UniVid Luo等,2025年a;UniVideo Wei等,2026年在MLLM和视频解码器之间共同训练适配器.

blocks.en:
Joint training creates an optimization imbalance between the two objectives.
Understanding data rewards semantic invariance and concise answers, whereas generation data rewards retaining appearance and motion detail.
Differences in dataset scale, loss magnitude, and convergence speed can let one direction dominate the shared parameters, so the data mixture and schedule decide how strongly each capability updates the model.
Lance Fu et al., 2026a counters this interference with staged multitask training and adaptive data scheduling.
Tong et al. Tong et al., 2026a study related choices when pretraining a Transfusion-style backbone from scratch, comparing representation autoencoders, data mixtures, and dense or sparse-expert architectures with compute-matched image–text analyses.
blocks.zh:
联合培训造成两个目标之间的优化不平衡。
理解数据会奖励语义上的无常和简洁的答案,而生成数据则奖励保留外观和运动细节.
数据集尺度,损失规模,和趋同速度的差异,可以让一个方向主导共享参数,因此数据混合和调度决定每个能力对模型的更新力度.
兰斯 Fu等人, 2026a 反驳这种干扰 舞台多任务培训和适应性数据调度。
汤等. Tong等人,2026a研究了从头开始对输液式骨干进行预训时的相关选择,比较了代表自动编码器、数据混合物以及密集或稀有的专家结构与相匹配的图像-文本分析。

blocks.en: 7.2.4 Synergistic Learning
blocks.zh: 7.2.4 协同学习

blocks.en:
Synergistic learning uses one direction to improve the other; its evidence is a measured gain in the receiving direction.
From understanding to generation, OmniWeaving Pan et al., 2026 conditions a video generator on an MLLM that can first write a reasoning trace about interleaved text, image, and video inputs; after end-to-end training, enabling this thinking mode raises its scores on intent-driven and interpolative tasks of IntelligentVBench.
ReViSE Liu et al., 2025d turns understanding into a training signal for editing: the frozen VLM inside an Omni-Video model scores a one-step estimate of the edited video, and its answer-token probabilities serve as a differentiable reward alongside flow matching.
Ablations against supervised fine-tuning on RVE-Bench support this understanding-to-editing transfer.
Lance’s data-mixture ablations Fu et al., 2026a give video evidence in both directions: adding understanding data improves generation on VBench, and adding generation data improves understanding on MVBench.
blocks.zh:
协同学习用一个方向来改进另一个方向;它的证据是接收方向上的有分量的收益.
从理解到生成,OmniWeaving Pan等,2026年在MLLM上设定了视频生成器的条件,它首先可以写出关于互放文本,图像和视频输入的推理痕迹;经过端到端的训练后,使这种思维模式能够提升其在IntelligentV Bench的意向驱动和插入任务上的分数.
重维SE Liu 等,2025d 将理解转化为编辑的训练信号:Omni-Video模型内被冻结的VLM对被编辑的视频评分为一步一等,其解答-token概率与流量匹配同时起到不同的奖励作用.
与RVE-Bench监督的微调相比,支持这种理解到编辑的转移。
兰斯的混合数据 Fu等,2026a 双向提供视频证据:增加理解数据能改善V Bench上的生成,并增加生成数据能增进对MV Bench的理解.

blocks.en:
From generation to understanding, Uni-ViGU Qin et al., 2026 transfers a generator’s text–video associations through inverse-task training (Section 7.2.2 ), and Thinking with Video Tong et al., 2026 generates intermediate frames at inference (Section 7.3.2 ).
CounterVid Poppi et al., 2026 transfers through data: it synthesizes counterfactual action clips and trains a video-language model with a preference objective, reducing action and temporal hallucinations more than generic visual negatives do.
UnityVideo Huang et al., 2026a jointly learns depth, flow, segmentation, pose, and other visual conditions, improving both world-aware generation and the prediction of those signals.
Gen4U King et al., 2026 and GenCeption Wang et al., 2026c reuse frozen or adapted video diffusion features for perception (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
世代相传,Uni-ViGU 秦等,2026年通过反向任务训练传输出一出发电机的文本-视频联想(第7.2.2节),与Video Tong等,2026年通过推论生成中间帧(第7.3.2节).
ConfVid Poppi等,2026 通过数据传输:它合成了反事实动作剪辑并训练了具有偏好目标的视频语言模型,比一般视觉负片更能减少动作和时间幻觉.
统一视频 Huang et al., 2026a联合学习了深度,流量,分化,姿势等视觉条件,既改善了世界认知的生成,也改善了这些信号的预测.
通用四U King等人,2026年和GenCeption Wang等,2026c再利用被冷冻或被改编的视频传播功能用于感知(第5.2节.

blocks.en:
Integrated tasks provide a third kind of evidence.
UniUGP Lu et al., 2025 tests whether scene reasoning and predicted video improve driving trajectories within one system (Section 7.3.3 ).
EWAM Wang et al., 2026b shows that masking or counterfactually replacing predicted-future features changes a manipulation policy’s actions and success.
Tong et al. Tong et al., 2026a also find that general multimodal pretraining data, especially raw video, helps offline navigation planning through action-conditioned prediction.
Apart from Lance’s data-mixture ablations, controlled bidirectional tests remain image-based (Section 7.4 ).
blocks.zh:
综合任务提供了第三种证据。
联盟 Lu等人,2025年,测试场景推理和预测视频是否改善了一个系统内的驾驶轨迹(第7.3.3.
埃瓦姆 Wang et al., 2026b 显示掩盖或反正地取代了预测的未来特征改变了操纵政策的行为和成功.
汤等. Tong等,2026a还发现一般多式预训数据,特别是原始视频,通过有行动条件的预测,帮助进行下线导航规划.
除了Lance的混合数据外,控制的双向测试仍然是以图像为基础的(第7.4节)。

blocks.en: 7.3 Applications
blocks.zh: 7.3 申请

blocks.en: Applications test whether information passed between understanding and generation improves a task outcome.
blocks.zh: 应用测试在理解与生成之间传递的信息是否改善任务结果.

blocks.en: 7.3.1 Instruction-Driven Video Editing and Creation
blocks.zh: 7.3.1 指导性录像编辑和创作

blocks.en:
Instruction-driven editing follows a read–modify–write pattern: the model identifies the entities, events, motion, and time span an instruction refers to, then changes them while preserving everything else.
A plausible output is still wrong if it edits the wrong interval, loses subject identity, or damages surrounding content.
Unified models place both steps in one system: Omni-Video Tan et al., 2025 and UniVideo Wei et al., 2026 pass MLLM interpretations to a diffusion decoder (Section 7.1 ), and UNIC Ye et al., 2026a casts editing as in-context generation over one shared sequence.
ReViSE Liu et al., 2025d adds reasoning to editing data: it pairs reasoning-enriched instructions with target edits and separates modifying a clip from generating a plausible continuation.
blocks.zh:
指令驱动的编辑遵循了读取-修改-写出模式:模型识别一个指令所指的实体、事件、运动和时间跨度,然后在保留其他一切的同时修改它们。
如果编辑错误的间隔, 丢失主题身份, 或损坏周围的内容, 可能输出仍然是错误的 。
统一模型将两个步骤放在一个系统中: 央视 Tan等人,2025年和UniVideo Wei等人,2026年将MLLM解释传递给扩散解码器(第7.1节),而Ye等联合国新闻中心,2026a将编辑工作作为内文生成,置于一个共享序列之上。
重维SE 刘等,2025d 为编辑数据添加了推理:它将推理-浓缩指令与目标编辑相配并分出修改剪辑与产生可信续作.

blocks.en:
Agentic systems extend editing into production workflows: VideoAgent (editing) Zhou et al., 2026a plans and assembles multi-shot edits, and VISTA Long et al., 2026 uses its own critiques to rewrite prompts across rounds (Section 7.1 ).
Evaluation should therefore score localization, preservation of untouched content, and improvement across rounds, not only the quality of the final video.
blocks.zh:
代理系统将编辑扩展为生产工作流程: 视频代理(编辑) Zhou等人,2026a计划并组装多镜头编辑,而VISTA Long等人,2026使用自己的批评来重写横轮的提示(第7.1节.
因此,评价应评分本地化、保存未受影响内容以及各轮改进,而不仅仅是最后录像的质量。

blocks.en: 7.3.2 Generative Reasoning
blocks.zh: 7.3.2 遗传原因

blocks.en:
Generative reasoning uses generation as an intermediate computation.
A video can show a changing configuration that is hard to express in one image or a textual chain of thought, as objects move, occlusions change, and the consequences of an operation unfold.
The generated sequence then serves as an inspectable hypothesis about the process.
Thinking with Video Tong et al., 2026 uses a video generator to produce intermediate frames during multimodal reasoning and evaluates them on VideoThinkBench.
OpenCoF Chen et al., 2026d trains chain-of-frame generation on temporally organized reasoning videos, while MME-CoF-Pro Qi et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026b shows that answer accuracy can rise while intermediate frames stay inconsistent or hallucinated.
ProAR Shen et al., 2026 makes autoregressive video diffusion prospective by predicting its own goal frame alongside each chunk.
blocks.zh:
基因推理使用生成作为中间计算.
视频可以显示一个变相的配置,在物体移动,被隔离变化,操作的后果展开时,在一个图像或文字链中难以表达.
然后生成的序列作为对该过程的可检查假设.
与视频思考 Tong等,2026年使用视频生成器在多模式推理过程中产生中间帧,并在VideoThink Bench上评价.
打开CoF Chen等,2026d列车在时序排列的推理视频上进行帧链生成,而MME-CoF-Pro Qi等,2026;Luo等,2026b显示,在中间帧保持不一致或幻觉的情况下,答案精度会上升.
专栏 Shen等人,2026年,通过预测自己的目标框架与每个块一起,使自旋式视频传播前景.

blocks.en:
However, generated reasoning traces add a failure mode: a coherent but unsupported intermediate video can make a later answer look well grounded.
Reliable use thus needs observed evidence separated from generated hypotheses, and tests of whether the intermediate video changes the answer for the right reason.
blocks.zh:
然而,所生成的推理痕迹增加了一个失败模式:一个连贯而无支持的中间视频可以让后期的答案看起来有良好的基础.
因此,可靠使用需要从产生的假设中分离出观察到的证据,并测试中间视频是否出于正确的理由改变答案。

blocks.en: 7.3.3 Unified Perception-Generation-Planning Systems
blocks.zh: 7.3.3 统一观念-基因-规划系统

blocks.en:
In planning, generated video predicts what an action will do: the system reads the current observation, predicts how the scene may evolve under a plan, and uses that prediction to choose or refine the action.
Its value lies in the resulting decision, not in visual quality.
UniUGP Lu et al., 2025 applies this loop to autonomous driving: from multi-frame observations and instructions, its hybrid experts produce scene reasoning, future video, and a trajectory, connected through a four-stage curriculum.
The question is whether future generation improves planning in difficult or long-tail situations.
VideoAgent (planning) Soni et al., 2024 applies the same idea to embodied tasks, refining generated video plans through self-conditioning and execution feedback.
blocks.zh:
在规划中,所生成的视频预测一个动作会做什么:系统读取当前观察,预测场景可能如何在计划下演进,并使用该预测来选择或完善动作.
它的价值在于由此产生的决定,而不是视觉质量。
联盟 Lu et al., 2025)将这个循环应用于自主驾驶:从多帧观测和指令中,其混合型专家产生场景推理,未来视频,并有轨迹,通过四个阶段的课程相接.
问题在于后人是在困难或长期情况下改进规划。
视频代理(规划) Soni等,2024年 将同样的想法应用到包含的任务中,通过自建和执行反馈来完善生成的视频计划.

blocks.en:
Recent models extend sharing to actions.
Cosmos 3 NVIDIA, 2026 places language, image, video, audio, and action sequences in one omnimodal mixture-of-transformers.
UniWAM Song et al., 2026a couples a physical reasoner, a video generator, and an action predictor through joint attention, and perturbs predicted future latents during post-training so that actions do not over-rely on imagined futures.
EWAM Wang et al., 2026b tests whether a predicted-future pathway matters for action (Section 7.2.4 ), and Section 8 details action-conditioned prediction.
blocks.zh:
最近的模型将共享扩展至动作.
Cosmos 3 NVIDIA, 2026 将语言,图像,视频,音频,和动作序列放入了一种全模式的转换器中.
单相机 Song等人, 2026a夫妇通过共同关注来进行物理理性,视频生成器,以及动作预测器, 扰动者在训练后预言未来潜伏,
埃瓦姆 Wang等,2026b, 检验预测未来路径是否对行动很重要(第7.2.4节), 第8节详细介绍了行动条件的预测。

blocks.en: 7.4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 7.4 评价

blocks.en:
Table 15 expands the sharing row of Table 2 into evaluation levels: separate competence, integrated behavior, and measured synergy.
Video coverage is mature at the first level, emerging at the second, and mostly directional at the third.
Levels 1 and 2 refine the capability-coverage level of Definition and Level 3 its functional-synergy level; architectural sharing is a property of the design (Section 7.1 ), not a benchmark score, and decision utility is covered by the integrated tasks of Section 7.2.4 .
blocks.zh:
表15将表2的共享行扩展为评价级别:单独能力,综合行为,并衡量协同.
视频覆盖面在一级成熟,在二级出现,在三级大多为定向.
一级和二级完善了定义和三级的能力覆盖水平,其功能-协同水平;建筑共享是设计的财产(第7.1节),而不是基准分数,决策效用由第7.2.4节的综合任务涵盖。

blocks.en: Table 15: Evidence ladder for unified video models, from separate competence to measured cross-direction transfer.
blocks.zh: 表15 统一视频模型的证据阶梯,从独立能力到测量跨方向传输.

blocks.en: 7.4.1 Per-Direction Evaluation
blocks.zh: 7.4.1 逐级评价

blocks.en:
Each direction is evaluated with its own community’s protocols: MVBench Li et al., 2024a , Video-MME Fu et al., 2025 , LongVideoBench Wu et al., 2024 , LVBench Wang et al., 2025c , and MLVU Zhou et al., 2025b for understanding (Section 5.1 ), and VBench Huang et al., 2024a and VBench-2.0 Zheng et al., 2025 for generation (Section 6.1.2 ).
Results should be reported separately, since perceptual and faithfulness criteria are not interchangeable with question-answer accuracy.
Matched single-task baselines can also reveal interference, where joint training improves one direction but degrades the other.
blocks.zh:
每个方向都通过自己的社区协议进行评估: MV Bench Li等,2024a,视频-MME Fu等人,2025年,《长视频奔驰》 Wu等,2024年,LV Bench Wang等,2025c;MLVU Zhou等,2025b 用于理解(第5.1节),而V Bench Huang等,2024a和V Bench-2.0 Zheng等,2025 (第6.1.2节)。
应分别报告结果,因为概念标准和忠诚标准不能与回答的准确性相取舍。
匹配的单任务基线也可以揭示出干扰,其中联合培训可以改善一个方向,但可降低另一个方向.

blocks.en: 7.4.2 Unified, Interleaved, and Synergy Evaluation
blocks.zh: 7.4.2 统一、互开和协同评价

blocks.en:
Integrated benchmarks test whether one system handles a wider family of input–output transformations.
UniVBench Wei et al., 2026b is the most direct video-centered example: it evaluates understanding, generation, editing, and reconstruction on multi-shot videos with a shared agentic evaluator, and its reconstruction and editing tasks check whether source content survives.
RVE-Bench Liu et al., 2025d and VR-Bench Xing et al., 2026 test whether reasoning-conditioned edits and generations do what the inferred intent implies, and UniVA-Bench Liang et al., 2025a scores agentic workflows on both final media and planning behavior.
UniM Li et al., 2026h extends input and output to text, image, video, and audio, while MME-Unify Xie et al., 2026a covers integrated tasks in image–text settings.
blocks.zh:
综合基准检验一个系统是否处理更广泛的投入-产出转变。
UniV 奔驰 Wei等,2026b是最直接的以视频为中心的例子:它与共享代理评价员在多镜头视频上评价理解,生成,编辑和重建,它的重建和编辑任务检查源内容是否存活.
RVE - Bench (英语). 刘等,"2025d"和"VR-Bench Xing等","2026年检验推理条件编辑和世代是否按照推断意图行事","UniVA-Bench Liang等","2025a评分最终媒体和规划行为上的代理工作流程.
统一管理 Li等,2026h 将输入和输出扩展到了文本,图像,视频和音频,而MME-Unify Xie等,2026a 涵盖了图像-文本设置中的综合任务.

blocks.en:
Synergy evaluation instead compares matched routes, such as understanding-guided generation against plain generation, or understanding with and without generated intermediates.
Image-domain studies lead here: DreamLLM Dong et al., 2024 was an early study of synergy between understanding and generation in interleaved documents, and Uni-MMMU Zou et al., 2026 , RealUnify Shi et al., 2026b , and UniSandbox Niu et al., 2025a score both directions with coupled tasks, matched routes, or decoupled tracks.
UniG2U-Bench Wen et al., 2026 finds that an extra generation step helps understanding on tasks that need visual transformation but can be neutral or harmful elsewhere.
Pseudo-Unification Yang et al., 2026a probes internal information patterns and finds divergent processing behind nominally shared parameters.
Video evidence so far comes from training ablations and interventions and is mostly directional (Section 7.2.4 ); Section 9.3 discusses what a video synergy test would need.
blocks.zh:
相反,协同评价比较了匹配的路径,如理解引导生成与平原生成,或理解与生成的中间体是否匹配。
图像域研究在此牵头: DreamLLM Dong等,2024年是互页文件中理解与生成的协同作用的早期研究,而Uni-MMMU Zou等,2026年,Real Unify Shi等,2026b;和UniSandbox Niu等,2025a 得分双向,任务并重,路线相匹配,或分道扬镳.
UniG2U- 奔驰 Wen等,2026 发现多出一代一步有助于理解那些需要视觉转变但可以在其他地方中性或有害的任务.
修道会 Yang等,2026a探究了内部信息模式,发现在名义上共享的参数后面有不同的处理.
迄今为止,视频证据来自培训模拟和干预,大多是定向的(第7.2.4节);第9.3节讨论了视频协同测试需要什么。

blocks.en: 7.4.3 Protocols and Consistency
blocks.zh: 7.4.3 议定书和一致性

blocks.en:
Round-trip evaluation tests whether content survives an understanding–generation cycle: a model infers an event or layout, renders it, and reads it back, or generates a video, describes it, and regenerates it.
Existing round-trip training objectives are image-based (Section 7.2.2 ), and the reconstruction task of UniVBench is the closest video protocol.
A video protocol must name entities, event order, geometry, or dynamics to keep, score intended changes separately, and add non-unified and no-cycle controls.
blocks.zh:
圆通评估测试内容是否在理解-生成周期存活下来:模型推断出一个事件或布局,使其形成,并读取,或生成视频,描述,再生.
现有的往返训练目标是以图像为基础的(第7.2.2节),UniV Bench的重建任务是最接近的视频协议.
视频协议必须命名实体,事件顺序,几何,或动态来保持,分出预定的更改,并添加非统一和无循环的控制.

blocks.en:
Reliable measurement also needs information controls.
Train–test overlap can confound transfer with memorization, intermediate representations can leak answers across directions, and text accuracy, video fidelity, and cross-modal consistency may rely on different, possibly biased judges.
UniSandbox Niu et al., 2025a reduces leakage with synthetic tasks and separated modules, TorchUMM Luo et al., 2026e standardizes model interfaces and task implementations, and UniSAFE Lee et al., 2026 evaluates safety across input–output modality combinations.
Judges can themselves be unified: UnifiedReward Wang et al., 2025f trains one reward model to rank and score image and video outputs for both understanding and generation.
blocks.zh:
可靠的衡量还需要信息控制。
列车-测试重叠可能使转移与记忆相混淆,中间表述可能跨越方向漏出答案,文本准确性、视频忠诚度和跨模式一致性可能依赖于不同的、可能带有偏见的法官。
统一对话框 Niu等人,2025a 减少与合成任务和分离模块相通的渗漏,TorchUMM Luo等人,2026e 标准化了模型接口和任务执行,Unisafe Lee等人,2026 评估了输入-输出模式组合的安全性。
法官本身可以统一: United Reward Wang et al., 2025f 培训一个奖励模式,对图像和视频产出进行分级和评分,既便于理解,也便于生成。

blocks.en:
INSIGHT Synergy requires controlled cross-direction transfer Shared tokens or parameters show coupling, separate scores show competence, and mixed input–output tasks show interoperability.
Synergy needs a controlled comparison: ablate the cross-direction path under matched data, capacity, and compute, and measure the change in generation, understanding, or an integrated task.
blocks.zh:
新闻 协同需要有控制的交叉方向传输 共享的符号或参数显示耦合,单独的分数显示能力,混合输入-输出任务显示互通性.
协同需要可控比较:在相匹配的数据,能力,和计算下,将交叉方向路径降低,并测量生成,理解或综合任务的变化.

blocks.en: INSIGHT Synergy requires controlled cross-direction transfer
blocks.zh: 新闻 协同需要有控制的交叉方向传输

blocks.en: 8 Video World Models: Interacting with the World
blocks.zh: 8个视频世界模式: 与世界互动

blocks.en: Interacting means modeling state transition itself: how an established world evolves over time and, when actions, controls, or new observations are supplied, how they change that evolution.
blocks.zh: 互动意味着建模状态过渡本身:一个已经建立的世界如何随时间演变,在提供行动,控制或新观察时,它们如何改变这种演变.

blocks.en:
Interacting is the operation W ↺ W\circlearrowleft of Section 3 : the model advances its state, s t + 1 ∼ p θ ​ ( s t + 1 ∣ s ≤ t , a t , c t ) s_{t+1}\sim p_{\theta}(s_{t+1}\mid s_{\leq t},a_{t},c_{t}) , and decodes observations when visible output is needed.
Rollout exposes failures that a single plausible clip hides: generated errors feed back as context, off-screen content is forgotten, smooth motion breaks physical or causal structure, and actions miss their intended effects.
We first place current models in the taxonomy of Section 4.4 , then examine control, memory, responsiveness, grounding, applications, and evaluation.
Zhu et al. Zhu et al., 2024 survey general world models starting from Sora; this chapter focuses on video-centered state.

Figure 10: The 2 × 3 2\times 3 taxonomy of video world models.
Rows give the prediction space: observations (frames, video tokens, or video-decoding latents) or latent states (video-derived features predicted without required rendering).
Columns give the transition: passive prediction without action input, action-conditioned prediction with controls fixed before prediction, and interactive prediction that receives new controls after feedback.
Each cell shows its prediction form and representative models; x x denotes observations, z z features, a a actions, H H the horizon, and C C and Q Q the context and target positions of masked feature prediction.
blocks.zh:
图10:2×3 2\times 3个视频世界模型分类法.
行给出了预测空间:观测(帧,视频信号符,或视频解码潜伏)或潜伏状态(视频衍生的功能预测不需要渲染).
列给出了过渡:无动作输入的被动预测,有动作条件的预测,在预测前固定控制,在反馈后接收出新控制的交互式预测.
每个细胞显示其预测形式和代表性模型;xx表示观测,z z特征,一个动作,H H地平线,而C和Q则显示被蒙蔽的地平面预测的背景和目标位置.

blocks.en: 8.1 Architectures and Training Paradigms
blocks.zh: 8.1 建筑和培训范例

blocks.en:
Crossing the two axes of Section 4.4 gives the 2 × 3 2\times 3 grid of Figure 10 .
A cell describes how a model is trained and used, so one model can occupy several cells: an action-conditioned latent predictor can score fixed candidate actions or run inside a planner that acts, observes, and replans.
Likewise, the attention pattern does not decide the column; a model is interactive when it accepts new controls between emitted frames or chunks.
Table 16 lists representative implementations, one row per evaluated protocol.
blocks.zh:
跨越第4.4节的两条轴使图10的2×3 2\times 3格.
一个细胞描述了一个模型是如何被训练和使用的,因此一个模型可以占据几个细胞:一个行动条件潜伏的预测器可以得分固定的候选动作,或者运行在一个计划者内部,进行操作,观察,再规划.
同样,注意模式也不决定列;当一个模型接受被放出的框架或块之间的新控制时,它是交互式的.
表16列出了有代表性的执行情况,每个评估的协议各一行。

blocks.en:
Training data. Each cell needs data that expose the transition it learns.
Passive predictors such as V-JEPA 2 and V-JEPA 2.1 pretrain on large image–video mixtures Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 , in which video supplies temporal change but no actions.
Action-conditioned learning needs synchronized observations and controls, such as the DROID robot demonstrations Khazatsky et al., 2024 that train the action-conditioned V-JEPA predictors.
Open X-Embodiment O’Neill et al., 2024 pools robot data across embodiments in one format, although action units and coordinate frames still need alignment.
Annotated video adds further supervision: camera geometry and depth (OmniWorld Zhou et al., 2026c , SolarWM Huang et al., 2026b ), multi-view tactile contact (Deform360 Li et al., 2026c ), game actions with ground-truth world state (WildWorld Li et al., 2026j ), and recorded intervention branches (CG-World Cai et al., 2026a ).
blocks.zh:
培训数据。 每个细胞都需要能够揭示其所学到的过渡性的数据.
V-JEPA 2和V-JEPA 2.1等被动预测器在大图像上的预排-视频混合物 Assran等人,2025年;Mur-Labadia等人,2026年,其中视频提供时间变化但无动作.
行动条件学习需要同步观测和控制,如DROID机器人演示 Khazatsky等,2024年,训练行动条件V-JEPA预测器.
打开X-Embodiment O'Neill 等,2024 集成机器人数据以一种格式跨越了浮雕,尽管动作单元和坐标框仍然需要对齐.
附加说明的视频增加了进一步的监督:相机几何和深度(OmniWorld Zhou等,2026c;SolarWM) Huang et al., 2026b.),多视图触觉接触(Deform360 Li等, 2026c.),地地-真实世界状态的游戏动作(WildWorld Li等, 2026j.),并收录了干预分支(CG-World Cai等, 2026a.).

blocks.en: 8.1.1 Observation-Space Passive Prediction
blocks.zh: 8.1.1 观测-空间被动预测

blocks.en:
Passive visual models predict future observations from history alone.
They can represent uncertainty over several plausible futures, as the action-free setting of SV2P Babaeizadeh et al., 2018 does by sampling latent variables to predict multiple future frames.
Large video generators used as forecasters also belong here: Sora Brooks et al., 2024 was presented as a step toward world simulation, Physics-IQ Motamed et al., 2026 scores how such generators continue a real initial segment, and the base video-to-world models of Cosmos NVIDIA et al., 2025 predict futures from a video prefix before any action-conditioned post-training.
Training targets the next frame or a future segment with reconstruction, likelihood, adversarial, diffusion, or flow losses.
Autoregressive models feed their predictions back as history, whereas block predictors generate a pending segment jointly.
Passive prediction supplies dynamics priors and uncertainty estimates for the controlled cells.
blocks.zh:
被动视觉模型仅从历史中预测出未来的观测.
正如2018年SV2P Babaeizadeh等人通过取样潜在变量来预测多个未来框架那样,它们可以代表一些可能的未来的不确定性。
作为预报器使用的大型相机也属于这里: 空难 Brooks等人,2024年被介绍为走向世界模拟的一个步骤,Physics-IQ Motamed等人,2026年评分这些发电机如何继续真正的初始部分,Cosmos NVIDIA等人,2025年的基础视频到世界模型预测未来从视频前缀到任何行动条件的后培训.
培训的目标是下一个框架或未来的部分,包括重建、可能性、对抗性、扩散或流量损失。
自动递减模型将它们的预测反馈到历史中,而块预测器则共同产生一个待决的段.
被动预测为受控细胞提供了动态前科和不确定性估计.

blocks.en: 8.1.2 Observation-Space Action-Conditioned Prediction
blocks.zh: 8.1.2 观测-空间行动-有条件的预测

blocks.en:
This cell receives the controls for a whole predicted segment before generation, such as ego motion, a robot trajectory, camera poses, road layout, or planned object states.
GAIA-1 Hu et al., 2023 predicts discrete image tokens conditioned on text and action tokens before decoding video, and DrivingWorld Hu et al., 2027 predicts driving observations together with ego state.
Conditions range from ego dynamics, agent configurations, and road semantics (GAIA-2 Russell et al., 2025 ) and commands, goal points, and trajectories (Vista Gao et al., 2024a ) to frame-level robot actions (IRASim Zhu et al., 2025 ).
DriveDreamer Wang et al., 2024 and post-trained Cosmos variants NVIDIA et al., 2025 condition on bird’s-eye-view maps, 3D boxes, and camera configurations.
blocks.zh:
这个细胞在生成前接收到整个预测段的控制,例如自负运动,机器人轨迹,相机姿势,道路布局,或计划对象状态等.
圭亚那1号 Hu等,2023预测解码视频前以文字和动作符号为条件的离散图像符号,而DriverWorld Hu等,2027预测驾驶观察与自负状态.
条件从自我动力学,代理构型,和道路语义学(GAIA-2 Russell等,2025年)和指令,入球点和轨迹(Vista Gao等,2024a年)到帧级机器人动作(IRASim Zhu等,2025年.
驱动梦想器 Wang等,2024和后训练的Cosmos变体 NVIDIA等,2025年 关于鸟瞰图,3D盒和相机配置的条件.

blocks.en:
Most models in this cell adapt a pretrained video generator through condition encoders, cross-attention, or control branches, and add structure, multi-view, or action-fidelity losses to the visual objective.
Making them interactive requires causal generation that accepts new controls during rollout.
Vid2World Huang et al., 2026e makes a video diffusion model autoregressive and action-guided, minWM Zhao et al., 2026 combines control tuning, autoregressive training, and few-step distillation, and BiWM Rui et al., 2026 keeps bidirectional computation within causal generation.
blocks.zh:
此单元格中的大多数模型都通过条件编码器,交叉意向,或控制分支来调整预先训练的视频生成器,并给视觉目标添加结构,多视图,或动作失真.
使它们互动需要因果生成,在推出时接受新的控制.
维德2世界 Huang et al., 2026e制作一个视频传播模式自相递解和动作导出,minWM Zhao等,2026年结合了控制调子,自相递回训练,并少步分馏,而BiWM Rui等,2026年在因果生成中保持双向计算.

blocks.en: 8.1.3 Observation-Space Interactive World Models
blocks.zh: 8.1.3 观测-空间互动世界模式

blocks.en:
Interactive visual models generate causally: emitted frames become history, and each new action changes the future that has not yet been generated.
Genie Bruce et al., 2024 predicts video tokens from learned latent actions, GameNGen Valevski et al., 2025 diffuses the next game frame from past frames and actions, and DIAMOND Alonso et al., 2024 both trains policies inside its generated observations and runs as an interactive simulator.
GameFactory Yu et al., 2025b extends playable generation to newly constructed scenes, and Matrix-Game Zhang et al., 2025g couples visual context to keyboard and mouse input, with a later version He et al., 2025a adding chunked, few-step streaming diffusion.
Oasis Decart et al., 2024 renders a playable Minecraft-like world from keyboard and mouse input in real time, Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al., 2025d maps keyboard and mouse actions into a shared camera representation and conditions on hybrid history to keep long play consistent, and Genie 3 Parker-Holder & Fruchter, 2025 generates worlds from text prompts that users navigate in real time for several minutes.
blocks.zh:
交互式视觉模型产生因果:放出的框架成为历史,而每个新动作都会改变尚未产生的未来.
Genie Bruce等人, 2024 预测从学到的潜伏动作获得的视频符号 GameNgen Valevski等人, 2025 传播 从过去的帧和行动获得的下个游戏帧, 和 DIAMOND Alonso等人, 2024 都在其生成的观测中训练出政策,并作为交互式模拟器运行.
游戏事实 Yu等,2025b 将可玩的一代扩展至新建的场景,而Matrix-Game Zhang等,2025g 情侣可视上下文至键盘和鼠标输入,后期版本 他等人,2025年a 增加了零散的,几步的流传.
Oasis Decart等, 2024 年 由键盘和鼠标实时输入的可玩的 Minecraft, Hunyuan-GameCraft Li等,2025d将键盘和鼠标动作映射到一个共享相机的表示和混合历史的条件上,以保持长时间播放的一致性,而Genie 3 Parker-Holder & Fruchter,2025从用户实时导航数分钟的文本提示产生出世界.

blocks.en:
Controls can also be speech, and several actors can share one world.
Vidu S1 and S2 Zhang et al., 2026f ; Zhang et al., 2026e take speech and updated references as controls on a streaming character (Section 6.5 ), and Wan-Streamer Huang et al., 2026d keeps audio-visual context to respond full-duplex to incoming events (Section 8.2.3 ).
Solaris Savva et al., 2026 pairs synchronized actions and observations from two Minecraft players, and MultiWorld Wu et al., 2026 binds actions to agent identities and updates a shared geometry-aware representation between chunks, so that every actor affects the same world.
blocks.zh:
控制也可以是言论,几个角色可以共享一个世界.
Vidu S1和S2 Zhang等人,2026f;Zhang等人,2026e 将演讲和更新引用作为对流体特征的控制(第6.5节),而Wan-Streamer Huang等人,2026d 保留视听背景,以充分应对来袭事件(第8.2.3节).
Solaris Savva等,2026对动作和两个Minecraft玩家的观察同步,而MultiWorld Wu等,2026对动作绑定了代理身份,并更新了块之间共享的几何感知代表,使每个角色影响同一个世界.

blocks.en: 8.1.4 Latent-State Passive Prediction
blocks.zh: 8.1.4 后继状态被动预测

blocks.en:
Latent passive models predict video-derived features without actions, often as pretraining for later transition models.
V-JEPA Bardes et al., 2024 learns by predicting the features of masked video regions, and the pretraining stage of V-JEPA 2 Assran et al., 2025 scales this objective over images and video.
Because the masked region can be predicted from frames on both sides, this objective is not causal forecasting; future prediction requires a separate, causal protocol.
We keep these models in the taxonomy because their predictors supply the feature space and initialization of the action-conditioned latent cells; on their own, they are pretraining for transition models rather than complete world models.
Later variants change the prediction unit or the loss.
