Causal-JEPA Nam et al., 2026 infers masked object-level latents from surrounding objects to encourage relational prediction.
V-JEPA 2.1 Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 adds a dense context-token loss and multi-level supervision for stronger local structure.
blocks.zh:
后期被动模型预测出视频衍生的特征而无动作,通常作为后期过渡模型的预训.
V-JEPA(美国) Bardes等,2024年通过预测被遮掩的视频区域的特点来学习,而V-JEPA 2 Assran等的预训阶段,2025年将这一目标比起图像和视频来进行衡量.
由于被蒙蔽的区域可以从两边的帧来预测,所以这个目标不是因果预测;未来的预测需要单独的因果协议.
我们把这些模型保存在分类学中,因为它们的预测器提供了功能空间和初始化的有作用条件的潜在细胞;它们本身是过渡模型的预训,而不是完整的世界模型。
后来的变体会改变预测单位或损失.
原因-JEPA Nam等人,2026年推断出周围物体所隐蔽的物体级潜伏物,以鼓励关系预测.
V-JEPA(美国) 2.1 Mur-Labadia等人,2026年增加了密集的上下文损失和多层次监督,以加强地方结构。

blocks.en: 8.1.5 Latent-State Action-Conditioned Prediction
blocks.zh: 8.1.5 晚期国家行动纲领

blocks.en:
Adding actions keeps a feature-space target but conditions its evolution on controls.
V-JEPA 2-AC Assran et al., 2025 post-trains a predictor on robot trajectories, DINO-WM Zhou et al., 2025a learns how frozen DINOv2 features evolve under actions, and LeWorldModel Maes et al., 2026a instead learns the encoder and predictor jointly from pixels with latent regularization.
V-JEPA 2.1 also trains a diffusion predictor over its features for navigation Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 .
blocks.zh:
添加动作会保持一个特征-空间目标,但会给它的发展带来控制条件.
V-JEPA 2-AC Assran等,2025年 机器人轨迹后预测器,DINO-WM Zhou等,2025a 学习了冰冻的DINov2特征如何在动作下演化,而LeWorldModel Maes等,2026a 则通过潜伏正态化的像素共同学习了编码器和预测器.
V-JEPA 2.1还为Mur-Labadia等人在2026年的航行中对其特征进行扩散预测。

blocks.en:
Such models can roll a candidate action sequence forward and compare the result with a goal representation without rendering a single frame.
LaDi-WM Huang et al., 2025b predicts geometric and semantic features for a manipulation policy, and MoWM Yu et al., 2025c combines motion-aware latent prediction with pixel-space signals.
The JEPA-WM design study Terver et al., 2026 compares encoders, proprioception, context, multi-step losses, and planning optimizers in one recipe and finds that the best combination depends on the task.
blocks.zh:
这种模式可以向前推出一个候选行动序列,并将结果与目标表述进行比较,而不会产生单一的框架。
拉迪-温姆 Huang等,2025b 预测了操纵策略的几何和语义特征,而MoWM Yu等,2025c 结合了运动-意识潜伏预测和像素-空间信号.
JEPA-WM设计研究 Terver等,2026年比较了编码器,自带,上下文,多步损失,以及在一个食谱中规划优化器,并发现最好的组合取决于任务.

blocks.en: 8.1.6 Latent-State Interactive World Models
blocks.zh: 8.1.6 晚期国家互动世界模式

blocks.en:
An interactive latent system closes the loop with model predictive control (MPC): the planner chooses an action prefix, executes it, encodes the new observation, and plans again.
V-JEPA 2-AC Assran et al., 2025 and DINO-WM Zhou et al., 2025a use this loop, and V-JEPA 2.1 Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 applies it to reaching, grasping, and pick-and-place on a real robot arm.
H-JEPA Zhang et al., 2026j stacks latent spaces at coarser timescales so that upper levels supply subgoals to lower-level planning.
Latent rollout spends no capacity on texture and scores candidates without a decoder, but latent distance can omit task-relevant details.
Because corrective replanning can hide poor scores, scorer-level audits complement closed-loop success (Section 8.4 ).
blocks.zh:
一个交互式潜入系统用模型预测控制(MPC)关闭了循环:计划者选择了动作前缀,执行它,编码了新的观察,并再次计划.
V-JEPA 2-AC Assran等,2025年和DINO-WM Zhou等,2025a使用此回路;V-JEPA 2.1 Mur-Labadia等,2026年将其应用于伸展,抓取并放置于真正的机器人臂上.
H-JEPA (美国) 张等,"2026j"将潜伏空间堆放于相近时间尺度上,使上层向下层规划提供子目标.
Latett rolled在纹理上没有花费能力,没有解码器的考生得分,但潜在的距离可以省略与任务相关的细节.
由于纠正性的重新规划可能掩盖差分,计分员一级的审计是对结账成功的补充(第8.4节)。

blocks.en:
INSIGHT Rendering, causal rollout, and decision state can be specialized A visual generator can supply appearance and motion priors, an online generator can provide action-conditioned rollout, and a latent predictor can supply compact state for planning.
These components need not share a representation or training stage, but for the same history and action their rendered consequences, retained state, and decision scores must agree.
blocks.zh:
新闻 制作、因果推出和决定状态可以专门化 视觉生成器可以提供外观和运动前兆,在线生成器可以提供有行动条件的推出,而潜在预测器可以提供紧凑状态来进行规划.
这些组成部分不需要共享一个代表阶段或培训阶段,而对于同样的历史和行动,它们产生的后果、保留状态和决定分数必须一致。

blocks.en: INSIGHT Rendering, causal rollout, and decision state can be specialized
blocks.zh: 新闻 制作、因果推出和决定状态可以专门化

blocks.en: 8.2 Core Technical Challenges
blocks.zh: 8.2 核心技术挑战

blocks.en:
Four challenges recur across the grid: control, memory, latency, and physical grounding.
Memory and physical consistency matter in every cell; controlled prediction must also bind each control to its consequence, and interaction must do so within a response budget.
The challenges interact: longer memory raises inference cost, fewer denoising steps change rollout stability, and stronger action constraints can disturb the visual prior inherited from pretraining.
blocks.zh:
四个挑战在全网反复出现:控制、记忆、耐久和地面。
每个单元格的内存和物理一致性都很重要;受控预测还必须将每个控制与其后果挂钩,互动必须在响应预算范围内进行。
挑战相互影响:较长的内存会提高推论成本,更少的去名步骤会改变推出稳定性,更强的动作限制会干扰预训之前继承的视觉.

blocks.en: 8.2.1 Action-Conditioned Controllability
blocks.zh: 8.2.1 有行动条件的控制能力

blocks.en:
Action control poses two problems.
Without action records, a latent-action model must learn a control variable from observed transitions; with supplied controls, conditioning must bind each signal to the right time, view, object, and consequence.
blocks.zh:
动作控制有两个问题。
没有动作记录,潜在动作模型必须从所观察到的过渡中学习出一个控制变量;在提供控制的情况下,条件必须将每个信号绑定在正确的时间、视图、对象和后果上。

blocks.en:
Latent action learning. Latent-action models couple inverse and forward dynamics.
An inverse model infers a variable that explains the change between two nearby frames, and a forward model predicts the later frame from the earlier one and that variable.
A discrete codebook or continuous bottleneck limits how much information the variable carries, which favors a compact control code.
LAPO Schmidt & Jiang, 2024 , LAPA Ye et al., 2025 , and Moto Chen et al., 2025d use discrete latent actions to pretrain policies from unlabeled video, and Genie Bruce et al., 2024 uses them to make platformer videos playable.
LAPA then maps its codes to robot commands with a small labeled set, while Moto treats them as a language of motion tokens.
Continuous latent actions offer more capacity.
AdaWorld Gao et al., 2025 conditions an autoregressive world model on them and adapts to new action spaces with little interaction, while IGOR Chen et al., 2024e encodes initial-to-goal image changes in one space for humans and robots.
blocks.zh:
慢动作学习. 后期动作模型对反向和前向动态.
一个反向模型推断出一个变量来解释相邻两个帧之间的变化,一个前向模型从更早的帧和那个变量中预测出后向帧.
一个离散的代码簿或连续的瓶颈限制了变量所携带的信息量,这有利于一个紧凑的控制代码.
LAPO Schmidt & Jiang, 2024年,洛杉矶 Ye等人,2025年,Moto Chen等人,2025d 使用离散的潜伏动作从无标签的视频中预演政策,而Genie Bruce等人,2024 使用它们使平台视频可以播放.
LAPA随后将其代码映射到机器人指令上,并带有一个小的标签集,而Moto则把它们作为运动符号的一种语言来对待.
持续的潜在行动提供了更大的能力。
AdaWorld Gao等,2025年 以自相矛盾的世界模式为条件,并适应新的动作空间,很少互动,而IGOR Chen等,2024e 编码了人类和机器人在一个空间中初始到目标图像的变化.

blocks.en:
However, a latent action can lock onto the wrong source of change.
LAOM Nikulin et al., 2025 shows that visual distractors lead latent actions to encode background or camera motion, whereas a little action supervision anchors them to the agent.
Latent codes should therefore be tested for decoding into executable actions and for transfer under distractors, not only for reconstruction.
Action Forcing Sundar et al., 2026 avoids an unconstrained code: it recovers signed egomotion axes from principal components of tracked pixel motion and uses them as controls that can be tested for reversal, scaling, and composition.
blocks.zh:
然而,潜在的行动可能锁定错误的变革来源。
劳姆 Nikulin等,2025 显示视觉分光器引导潜在动作来编码背景或相机运动,而有一点动作监督将它们锁定在特质上.
因此,应测试Latent代码,以便解码为可执行的行动,并在分心器下转移,而不仅仅是用于重建。
Action Forcing Sundar等,2026 避免了不受约束的代码:它从有轨像素运动的主要组件中取回所签名的自动机轴并用作可以测试回转,缩放和构成的控制.

blocks.en:
Action conditioning mechanisms. Known actions remove the discovery problem but must still be aligned with the frames they affect.
A single sequence embedding is too coarse when each frame must respond to a different command, so IRASim Zhu et al., 2025 injects actions frame by frame throughout its diffusion Transformer.
Other systems express controls where their effects appear.
EA-WM Yang et al., 2026e projects joint or end-effector kinematics into the camera view as visual action fields, and Aero-World Radi et al., 2026 feeds acceleration and angular velocity as tokens and checks inertial consistency with a frozen latent physics probe.
X-World Zheng et al., 2026 conditions multi-camera driving on ego actions plus optional controls over traffic agents, road elements, and appearance.
Models that predict both states and actions must also stay responsive to actions; FLEX-WAM Khorrambakht et al., 2026 rebalances the two losses and tracks an action-sensitivity proxy for this purpose.
blocks.zh:
行动调节机制。 已知的行为消除了发现问题,但仍必须与它们所影响的框架相配合。
当每个帧必须响应不同的指令时,单个序列嵌入太粗糙了,所以IRASim Zhu等,2025年在其扩散变形器的整个过程中按帧注入了动作帧.
其他系统则表达其效应出现地的控制.
EA-WM Yang等,2026e将相机视野中的联合或末端效应动能作为视觉动作场进行预测,而Aero-World Radi等,2026 Feed加速和角速度作为信号并检查惯性一致性与被冻结的潜伏物理探测器.
X世界组织 Zheng等人,2026年的条件多相机驾驶自负行动,加上对交通代理,道路元素,外观的可选控制.
预测状态和行动的模式也必须对行动作出响应;FLEX-WAM Khorrambakht等人,2026年,重新平衡了这两种损失,并追踪了用于这一目的的对行动敏感的代用.

blocks.en: 8.2.2 Long-Horizon Consistency and Memory
blocks.zh: 8.2.2 长视距一致性和记忆

blocks.en:
Long-horizon failure occurs at two scales.
Locally, small prediction errors return as context and accumulate across frames or chunks; globally, a finite context drops entities, layouts, and events that are no longer visible.
The first calls for aligning training histories with deployment, the second for storing, compressing, or recurrently updating information beyond the active window.
TECO Yan et al., 2023 is an early example, compressing past frames into temporally consistent latent codes to keep long rollouts coherent.
blocks.zh:
长视距故障发生在两个尺度上.
局部而言,小的预测错误作为上下文返回,并跨帧或块累积;全球而言,有限度的上下文会减少不再可见的实体,布局和事件.
第一个方案要求使培训历史与部署相一致,第二个方案要求储存、压缩或定期更新活动窗口之外的信息。
铁克 Yan等,2023年是一个早期的例子,将过去的框架压缩为时间上一致的潜伏代码,以保持长期推出的一致性.

blocks.en:
Training-inference alignment: the forcing family. Under teacher forcing, the model predicts from clean ground-truth history, whereas at deployment it conditions on its own outputs, so a small error in geometry or identity becomes the next input.
Diffusion Forcing Chen et al., 2024 exposes the model to uncertain histories by giving sequence elements independent noise levels; GameNGen similarly perturbs its conditioning frames with noise, and LIVE Huang et al., 2026c adds forward–reverse cycle consistency.
MAGI-1 Teng et al., 2025 denoises chunks block-causally.
Autoregressive diffusion adds a second mismatch, between a many-step bidirectional teacher and a few-step causal student.
CausVid Yin et al., 2025 makes a pretrained video diffusion model causal and distills its sampler through distribution matching, Self-Forcing Huang et al., 2025a trains the student on its own rollouts, and Causal Forcing Zhu et al., 2026a distills from an autoregressive teacher whose sampling path already follows causal inference.
Later variants change the denoising window (Rolling Forcing Liu et al., 2026c ), the prediction horizon (Next Forcing Xu et al., 2026 ), or the distillation objective (One-Forcing Feng et al., 2026 , Delta Forcing Wu et al., 2026c ); Table 17 lists their mechanisms and intended effects.
blocks.zh:
训练-推论对接:强迫家族. 在教师逼迫下,模型从干净的地面真实历史中预测出,而部署时则以自己的输出为条件,因此几何或身份上的小错误会成为下一个输入.
扩散 Chen等,2024年,通过给出序列元素独立噪声水平,使模型暴露于不确定的历史;GameNgen同样用噪声扰动了它的调节框架;LIVE Huang等,2026c增加了前向-逆向循环一致性.
MAGI-1 Teng等人,2025年
自动回放增加了第二个不匹配,一个多步双向的老师和一个多步因果生.
原因维德 Yin 等,2025年制作预受训练的视频传播模型因果,并通过配送匹配来分馏其样本器,Self-Forcing Huang等,2025a自发地对学生进行分解培训,Causal Forcing Zhu等,2026a自自发地教师取出蒸馏器,其采样路径已经遵循了因果推论.
后来的变体会改变去诺化窗口(Rolling Forcing Liu等,2026c),预测地平线(Next Forcing Xu等,2026),或蒸馏目标(One-Forcing Feng等,2026年;Delta Forcing Wu等,2026c;表17列出它们的机理和预期效果.

blocks.en:
Retrieval-augmented and structured memory. Retrieval extends the context with stored observations that are recalled when the camera or agent returns to a relevant region.
WorldMem Xiao et al., 2025a stores frames with pose and time metadata and attends to them to reconstruct earlier scenes; Context-as-Memory Yu et al., 2025a retrieves only scene-relevant past views, and WorldWeaver Liu et al., 2025e builds its memory on predicted depth, which drifts less than RGB.
Spatial Memory Intelligence Yang et al., 2026d uses a multimodal LLM to cluster, sparsify, filter, and retrieve stored views by action, while Keepsake Al et al., 2026 caps the archive by evicting views that others can replace.
Such archives trade growing storage and retrieval cost for detailed evidence that can be revisited.
blocks.zh:
取出有结构的记忆 检索以存储的观测数据扩展上下文,当相机或代理返回相关区域时,这些观测数据会被召回。
WorldMem Xiao等,2025a 存储有姿势和时间元数据的框架,并关注它们来重建更早的场景; Context-as-Memory Yu等,2025a 检索的只是与场景相关的过去观点; WorldWeaver Liu等,2025e 以预测的深度来建立记忆,漂移比RGB还小.
空间记忆情报 Yang et al., 2026d 使用多模式 LLM 来集群, sparersify, s过滤,并通过动作取回所储存的视图,而Keepsake Al et al., 2026 通过驱逐他人可以取而代之的视图来封住归档.
这种档案交易的存储和检索费用不断增加,可重新审查详细证据。

blocks.en:
Geometry makes recall more precise and reduces false matches between similar-looking places.
VMem Li et al., 2025g indexes views by 3D surfels, RELIC Hong et al., 2025 stores compressed history with relative actions and absolute camera poses in its key–value (KV) cache, and AnchorWeave Wang et al., 2026h retrieves local memories around persistent anchors.
Long-term spatial memory Wu et al., 2025c keeps a reconstructed static point map for layout, recent frames for motion, and retrieved past frames for appearance.
Matrix-Game 3.5 Qian et al., 2026 keeps geometrically projected latent patches for the static scene and reference tokens for moving subjects, so that past positions of an object are not mistaken for additional objects.
blocks.zh:
几何使回想更加精确,并减少相近相貌相间的假相.
VMM 主题 Li等, 2025g Index views by 3D surfels, RELIC Hong等, 2025 存储了压缩历史, 其键值-值(KV)缓存中包含相对动作和绝对相机, AnchorWeave Wang等, 2026h 取回了常锚周围的本地记忆.
长期空间记忆 Wu et al.,2025c 保留了被重建的静态点图用于布局,最近的相框用于运动,并取回了过去的相框用于外观.
矩阵-基质3.5 Qian等,2026保持了静态场景的几何投影潜入补丁和移动对象的参考符等,使一个物体过去的位置不被误认为是额外的物体.

blocks.en:
However, remembering what was seen differs from tracking what changes off-screen.
WorldDirector Wang et al., 2026a conditions causal chunks on externally planned object and camera trajectories plus retrieved object crops, so planned objects keep moving while unseen.
LiveWorld Duan et al., 2026 keeps a static background and localized dynamic entities and uses virtual monitors to generate their progress outside the view before projecting it back into the scene; its LiveBench checks this off-screen progression.
blocks.zh:
然而,对所见所闻的记忆不同于追踪屏幕外的变化。
世界主任 Wang et al., 2026a 条件因果块 在外部规划的物体和相机轨迹加上取回的物体收成, 因此计划中的物体在隐蔽的情况下继续移动.
LiveWorld Duan等,2026年保持了静态背景和本地化的动态实体,并使用虚拟显示器在将它投放回现场之前在视图外生成其进展;而它的Live Bench则检查了这种外屏进取.

blocks.en:
Context compression. Compression keeps a bounded working context.
FramePack Zhang et al., 2025c gives older frames smaller representation budgets than recent ones and adds drift prevention to sampling.
blocks.zh:
上下文压缩. 压缩保持有界限的工作环境.
框架软件包 Zhang等人,2025c, 与近期相比,比例预算框架较小,在取样中增加了防漂流。

blocks.en:
Fixed-size state representations. Fixed-size memories keep a constant-size state and pay a compression cost at every update.
Long-context state-space world models Po et al., 2025 pair a block-wise state-space scan with dense local attention, and Echo-Infinity Bian et al., 2026 recurrently updates memory queries as frames leave its local window.
GIM-World Wei et al., 2026c encodes selected past latents into geometry-supervised tokens, and Owl-1 Huang et al., 2024 keeps learned state queries inside a multimodal LLM alongside predicted textual dynamics.
Honeycomb Shi et al., 2026a recurrently writes six fixed-size spatial and spatiotemporal feature planes that cover larger ranges at coarser resolution.
WorldTrace Wu et al., 2026b keeps a fixed-size KV memory of averaged scene summaries and selected landmark keys that later queries can reach beyond the recent window, and evaluates it with its LoopBench revisit test.
Recurrent states can drift, test-time weight updates Dalal et al., 2025 add optimization latency, and compact memories may drop details needed later for rendering.
Retrieval, compression, and fixed state thus trade capacity against latency differently and can be combined (Table 18 ).
blocks.zh:
固定规模的国家代表机构. 固定大小的记忆保持恒定大小状态并支付每次更新的压缩费用.
长文本状态空间世界模型 Po等,2025年对一对有密集局部关注的块形状态-空间扫描,而Echo-Infinity Bian等,2026年在帧离开本地窗口时反复更新内存查询.
GIM - 世界协会 Wei等人, 2026c 将选定的过去潜入到几何学监督的符号中,而Owl-1 Huang等人, 2024 将学到的状态查询与预测的文字动态放在多模式LLM中。
蜂窝 Shi等,2026a相继写出6个固定大小的空间和spatiopal地物平面,以相近分辨率覆盖更大的射程.
世界追踪 Wu et al., 2026b 保留有固定大小的 KV 内存,包含平均场景摘要和选定的地标密钥,以后的查询可以到达最近的窗口之外,并用它的"Loop Bench"再试来评价.
经常状态可以漂移,测试时间重量更新 Dalal等人,2025年 增加了最优化的活性,而紧凑的记忆可能会降低后期渲染所需的细节.
因此,检索、压缩和固定状态的贸易能力不同,可以合并(表18)。

blocks.en: Table 17: Training mechanisms for causal and streaming generation. DMD: distribution-matching distillation.
blocks.zh: 表17:因果生成和流出生成的培训机制。 DMD:分布相配蒸馏.

blocks.en: Table 18: Memory mechanisms for long-horizon video generation and world modeling. Horizon scaling distinguishes active context from the full archive.
blocks.zh: 表18 长视视频生成和世界建模的记忆机制. 地平线缩放区分活性上下文与完整归档.

blocks.en: 8.2.3 Real-Time Responsiveness
blocks.zh: 8.2.3 实时反应

blocks.en:
Responsiveness is the delay between a new action and the first output that reflects it; a slow transition breaks the control loop even when offline throughput is high.
End-to-end cost combines sampling depth, work per step, active history, cache construction, latent decoding, and the rate at which controls enter the rollout.
Recent systems report real-time rates: Vidu S1 Zhang et al., 2026f reaches up to 42 frames per second (FPS) at 540p on consumer GPUs, and Wan-Streamer Huang et al., 2026d reaches 25 FPS.
Display rate can still overstate responsiveness: with temporal compression, several frames are decoded per predicted latent, so actions may enter less often than frames appear.
Waypoint-1.5 Rajpal et al., 2026 , a causal diffusion Transformer with bounded KV caches for keyboard-mouse play on consumer hardware, accordingly reports rendered and latent FPS and control rate separately.
blocks.zh:
响应是新动作和第一个反映它的输出之间的延迟;即使离线吞吐量高,缓慢的过渡也打破了控制循环.
端到端成本结合了采样深度,每步工作,活性历史,缓存构造,潜在解码,以及控制进入推出的速度.
最近的系统报告实时费率: 维都S1 Zhang等,2026f在消费GPU上以540p达到每秒42帧(FPS),而Wan-Streamer Huang等,2026d达到25FPS.
显示率仍然可以超标反应能力:随着时间压缩,每个预测潜伏数个帧被解码,因此动作可能比帧出现次数少.
Waypoint-1.5 Rajpal等, 2026年, 一个因果扩散变形器,

blocks.en:
Few-step distillation and adversarial post-training. Training-based acceleration turns a many-step generator into a causal student with fewer evaluations per frame or chunk, as CausVid, Self-Forcing, and Causal Forcing do while aligning rollouts.
Adversarial post-training goes further: Seaweed-APT Lin et al., 2025c distills a video diffusion model into a one-step generator, AAPT Lin et al., 2025d applies autoregressive adversarial post-training to real-time interactive video, and Causal Forcing++ Zhao et al., 2026a scales few-step autoregressive distillation.
Once sampling depth is reduced, the backbone, active context, and decoder dominate the cost, and the student must also stay stable over long rollouts.
blocks.zh:
很少一步一步地蒸馏和对抗性训练后. 基于培训的加速使一个多步生成器变成一个因果学生,每个帧或块的评价较少,如CausVid,自强和Causal Forcing在调整推出时所做的那样.
横向的后培训更进一步:海藻-APT Lin等,2025c将视频传播模型分馏为一步生成器,APT Lin等,2025d对实时互动视频应用自旋对抗后训练,Causal Forcing++ Zhao等,2026a平分了几步自旋蒸馏.
采样深度降低后,主干,活性上下文,解码器主导成本,学生也必须在长展后保持稳定.

blocks.en:
Training-free acceleration. Training-free methods exploit redundancy at inference.
Sparse attention suits streaming because the current query is short and the history long: Light Forcing Lv et al., 2026 keeps the anchors and recent frames that control the next output.
Caching reuses features that change little across denoising steps, as in TeaCache Liu et al., 2025 and FasterCache Lv et al., 2025 .
WorldCache Feng et al., 2026b adapts caching to world models, where an error in a few control-sensitive action, image, or memory tokens can propagate through the rollout.
TurboDiffusion Zhang et al., 2025b combines both routes, stacking step distillation with low-bit and sparse attention and weight–activation quantization, reporting two orders of magnitude of end-to-end acceleration on a single consumer GPU.
blocks.zh:
免训加速. 在推论中,无培训方法利用冗余。
由于当前查询短而历史悠久, Sparse 关注服会流出: 轻量级 Lv等,2026保持了控制下个输出的锚和最近的帧.
如TeaCache Liu等人,2025年和FracerCache Lv等人,2025年。
WorldCache Feng等,2026b 适应了世界模型的缓存,其中少数控制敏感动作,图像,或内存符号的错误可以通过推出来传播.
涡轮扩散 Zhang等,2025b 结合了两条路线,将阶梯蒸馏与低位和稀释的注意力和重量-活化定量相叠,在单一消费GPU上报告出两等量的端到端加速.

blocks.en: 8.2.4 Physical and Causal Grounding
blocks.zh: 8.2.4 物理和因果地面

blocks.en:
Physical grounding asks whether motion and interaction respect contact, rigidity, gravity, and persistence.
Causal grounding asks how the predicted future changes when an action or initial condition is intervened on, and whether unaffected factors stay fixed.
Current methods offer much machinery for plausible dynamics, whereas intervention-level supervision and evaluation remain less developed.
blocks.zh:
物理地基学问运动和相互作用是否尊重接触、刚性、重力和持久性。
因果关系询问,当某项行动或初始条件受到干预时,预测的未来变化如何,以及未受影响的因素是否保持不变。
现行方法为合理的动态提供了许多机制,而干预一级的监督和评价则仍然不够完善。

blocks.en:
Explicit physics simulation integration. Explicit methods let a simulator produce the dynamics and a generator render them.
PhysGen Liu et al., 2024b and PhysMotion Tan et al., 2026a estimate object shape and material from a single image, simulate the motion, and use it to guide video generation.
PhysGen3D Chen et al., 2025 extends this to interactive 3D scenes with user-set initial conditions, and PhysCtrl Wang et al., 2025 instead replaces the simulator with a generative physics network trained on simulated animations, conditioned on material parameters and forces.
Mass, material, force, or initial velocity thus become editable, but deformable bodies, fluids, fracture, articulated agents, and partly observed contact remain hard to recover from pixels and to simulate.
blocks.zh:
明确物理模拟集成. 明晰的方法让模拟器产生动力,由生成器产生.
PhysGen Liu等,2024b和物理运动 Tan等,2026a从一幅图像中估算出物体形状和材料,模拟运动,并用它来引导视频生成.
物理 Gen3D 函数 Chen等,2025年 将此扩展至具有用户设定初始条件的交互式3D场景,而PhysCtrl Wang等,2025年 将模拟器取而代之,取而代之的是接受模拟动画训练的基因物理网络,以物质参数和力为条件.
质量、物质、力量或初始速度因此变得可以编辑,但可变形的身体、液体、断裂、分解剂和部分观察到的接触仍然难以从像素中恢复并模拟。

blocks.en:
Implicit physics alignment. Implicit approaches keep a learned generator and change what it learns from.
VideoREPA Zhang et al., 2025e distills token-level relations from a self-supervised video encoder, which carries stronger physical structure, into a text-to-video generator.
Phantom Shen et al., 2026a couples visual trajectories with auxiliary physical latents, and RoboScape Shang et al., 2025 trains with depth and temporal structure as additional targets.
PhyGDPO Cai et al., 2026b post-trains on preferences between candidate videos ranked by physical plausibility, and WROP Zhang et al., 2026c supplies procedurally generated Blender data for object permanence and solidity.
Inference-time planning instead adds no physics training: VLIPP Yang et al., 2025d uses a vision-language model to plan coarse physical motion and converts the plan into structured noise for a motion-controllable image-to-video diffusion model.
blocks.zh:
隐性物理对接. 隐性方法保持一个有学问的生成者,并改变它从中吸取的教训.
视频REPA Zhang等,2025e从具有更强物理结构的自控视频编码器中分馏出符号级关系,变成文本到视频生成器.
幽灵 沈等,2026a 配对 视觉轨迹 有辅助物理潜伏,RoboScape Sang等,2025 列车有深度和时间结构作为附加目标.
HYGDPO 维基百科中的相关条目: 维基百科 Cai 等,2026b 后跟踪关于按物理可信度排名的候选视频之间的偏好,而WROP Zhang等,2026c 提供程序生成的Blender数据,用于对象的持久性和固态.
推论时间规划没有增加物理培训:VLIPP Yang等,2025d 使用视觉语言模型来规划粗糙的物理运动并把计划转换为结构化的噪音来进行可运动可控图像到视频传播模型.

blocks.en:
Intervention-level causal evidence. Plausibility objectives do not record which force, action, or initial condition produced a motion.
Causal evidence instead holds the initial state fixed, varies one action or physical parameter, and compares both the affected future and the unchanged state.
PhysEditWorld Hu et al., 2026 supplies such data by replaying identical game episodes under different gravity settings, with synchronized video, action, engine-state, and parameter signals (see also Section 9.2 ).
OneWorld He et al., 2026b requires several action-conditioned futures of one scene to share a latent physical explanation, scored by a mechanism interpreter during flow training and sampling.
Different actions should then change outcomes, not the world’s mechanism.
blocks.zh:
干预层面的因果关系。 透明度目标没有记录哪个力量、行动或初始条件产生动议。
相反,因果关系证据使初始状态保持不变,改变一个动作或物理参数,比较受影响的未来和不变状态。
物理编辑世界 Hu et al., 2026通过在不同重力设置下重放相同的游戏集来提供此类数据,其中包含同步视频,动作,引擎状态,以及参数信号(又见第9.2节.
一个世界 他等,2026b 要求一个场景的几个有行动条件的未来来分享潜在的物理解释,在流动培训和取样时由机制解释者打分.
然后,不同的行动应该改变结果,而不是世界的机制。

blocks.en: 8.3 Applications
blocks.zh: 8.3 申请

blocks.en:
Applications differ in who consumes the prediction.
A world model may produce a dataset, train a policy, evaluate a policy, supply forecasts to a planner, or respond directly to a person.
The first three support decisions before deployment, whereas planning and human simulation consume predictions online.
The same action-conditioned generator can move between these roles as its control fidelity and temporal stability improve.
blocks.zh:
应用在谁消耗预测方面有所不同.
一个世界模型可以生成一个数据集,培训一个政策,评价一个政策,向规划者提供预测,或者直接对一个人做出反应.
前三项支持部署前的决定,而规划和人类模拟则在线消耗预测。
随着控制忠诚度和时间稳定性的提高,同一具有行动条件的生成器可以在这些作用之间移动。

blocks.en: 8.3.1 Data Engines
blocks.zh: 8.3.1 联合国 数据引擎

blocks.en:
As a data engine, a world model turns controllable variation into training examples where real observations are expensive, dangerous, or unevenly distributed.
Each example must include the labels the learner needs, often actions.
In robotics, DreamGen Jang et al., 2025 and GigaWorld-0 Team et al., 2025 synthesize action-labeled trajectories for policy training (Section 6.5 ).
In driving, the action-conditioned generators of Section 8.1.2 , such as GAIA-2 Russell et al., 2025 , Vista Gao et al., 2024a , and Cosmos NVIDIA et al., 2025 , supply unusual layouts and safety-critical cases that fleet logs rarely contain.
blocks.zh:
作为一种数据引擎,世界模型将可控制的变化转化为实际观测费用昂贵、危险或分布不均的培训实例。
每个例子必须包括学习者需要的标签,往往是行动。
在机器人方面,DreamGen Jang等人,2025年和GigaWorld-0 Team等,2025年,综合了政策培训的行动标记轨迹(第6.5节)。
在驾驶方面,第8.1.2节的有行动条件的发电机,例如GAIA-2 Russell等人,2025年,Vista Gao et al., 2024a; Cosmos NVIDIA et al., 2025. 提供不同寻常的布局和船队日志所很少包含的安全临界病例.

blocks.en: 8.3.2 Policy Training in Imagination
blocks.zh: 8.3.2 想象政策培训

blocks.en:
Imagination training keeps the world model inside the optimization loop: a policy acts, the model predicts the next observation or state, and a reward updates the policy.
Unlike a data engine, the generated distribution then follows the current policy, and errors compound along the trajectories it chooses.
Action-conditioned video models such as UniSim Yang et al., 2024 , iVideoGPT Wu et al., 2024b , and Pandora Xiang et al., 2024 can serve as this simulator if their action effects, rewards, and resets are accurate enough.
blocks.zh:
想象训练将世界模型保留在优化循环中:一个政策行为,模型预测下一个观察或状态,奖励更新了政策.
与数据引擎不同,生成的分布随即遵循了当前策略,而误差会沿着它选择的轨迹复合.
有行动条件的视频模型,如UniSim Yang等,2024年,iVideoGPT Wu等,2024b;而Pandora Xiang等,2024如果其动作效果,奖励,和重回等效果足够准确,就可以作为这个模拟器.

blocks.en:
World-VLA-Loop Liu et al., 2026h refines vision-language-action policies by reinforcement learning in a world model that predicts future frames and binary rewards.
It feeds the updated policy’s rollouts back into the model, since a fixed simulator fails most often on states that a changed policy visits.
Dreamer 4 Hafner et al., 2025a trains a Minecraft agent with reinforcement learning inside a video world model learned largely from offline video and action data.
Because each step of a diffusion world model may need many denoising evaluations, Horizon Imagination Cohen et al., 2026 denoises several future observations in parallel and decouples the denoising budget from the rollout horizon, making longer on-policy rollouts affordable.
blocks.zh:
世界志愿行动联盟 刘等,"2026h"通过在预测未来框架和二进制奖励的世界模型中强化学习,完善了视觉语言行动政策.
它将更新后的政策推广反馈到模式中,因为一个固定的模拟器经常在政策访问改变时出现故障。
Dreamer 4 Hafner等,2025年a 培训了一名Minecraft代理,在一个视频世界模型内进行强化学习,主要学习自离线视频和动作数据.
由于传播世界模式的每个步骤都可能需要许多去名评价,Horizon Imagination Cohen等人,2026年同时发表若干未来观察意见,并将去名预算与去名预算与去名预算脱钩,使较长的政策推广费用可以承受。

blocks.en: 8.3.3 Policy Evaluation Environments
blocks.zh: 8.3.3 政策评价环境

blocks.en:
For policy evaluation, a world model replaces repeated deployment with reproducible generated trials.
WorldGym Quevedo et al., 2026 rolls out robot policies in an action-conditioned video model and scores them with a vision-language model, while WorldEval Li et al., 2025i encodes policy behavior with Policy2Vec to drive its simulation.
Both are validated by whether generated success rates preserve real-world policy rankings.
Such agreement depends on the policies tested, since a simulator tuned on familiar checkpoints may misrank a controller that visits new states or exploits a modeling artifact.
blocks.zh:
就政策评价而言,世界模式用可复制产生的试验取代重复部署。
WorldGym Quevedo等,2026年 以有动作条件的视频模型推出机器人政策并用视觉语言模型评分,而WorldEval Li等,2025i将政策行为与Policy2Vec编码来推动其模拟.
两者都通过所生成的成功率是否保持现实世界的政策排名来验证。
这种协议取决于所测试的政策,因为一个以熟悉的检查站为主的模拟器可能会对访问新州或利用模范文物的管制员造成错误排名。

blocks.en:
Later systems add multi-view, memory-supported rollouts (Ctrl-World Guo et al., 2026a ) or task-progress and success judges (GE-Sim 2.0 Qiu et al., 2026 ), and generalist robot (DreamDojo Gao et al., 2026b ) and driving (GAIA-3 Wayve, 2025 ) world models list policy evaluation among their uses.
OmniDreams Basant et al., 2026 takes a hybrid route in driving, generating sensor observations online inside the AlpaSim simulator, whose own services handle traffic and physics.
blocks.zh:
后期系统会添加多视图,内存支持的推出(Ctrl-World Guo等,2026a)或任务进度和成功评委(GE-Sim 2.0 Quu等,2026),通俗主义机器人(DreamDojo Gao等,2026b)和驱动(GAIA-3 Wayve,2025)世界模型在其用途中列出政策评价.
OmniDreams Basant等,2026年 驾驶时采用混合路线,在AlpaSim模拟器内部在线生成传感器观测,后者自己的服务处理交通和物理.

blocks.en: 8.3.4 Predict-then-Act Planning
blocks.zh: 8.3.4 预先规划

blocks.en:
Predict-then-act methods use a forecast as evidence for the next decision and differ in how much of the future they decode.
At the pixel end, UniPi Du et al., 2023 and AVDC Ko et al., 2024 generate a video plan and recover actions with an inverse-dynamics model or dense correspondences (Section 6.5 ).
Such plans are easy to inspect but add generation cost and another source of error.
Navigation World Models Bar et al., 2025 instead predict egocentric observations under candidate navigation actions with a conditional diffusion Transformer and plan by checking which simulated trajectory reaches the goal.
VPP Hu et al., 2025 instead conditions an inverse-dynamics policy on future-aware features from a fine-tuned video diffusion model.
LaDi-WM Huang et al., 2025b and MoWM Yu et al., 2025c combine latent prediction with feature or pixel signals, and LaWAM Chen et al., 2026b predicts latent visual subgoals without reconstructing video.
At the latent end, V-JEPA 2-AC and DINO-WM score candidate actions without decoding pixels, which cuts prediction cost but makes their forecasts harder to inspect.
blocks.zh:
预测当时的行为方法使用预测作为下个决定的证据,并且在未来的解码量上有所不同.
在像素端,UniPi Du等,2023年和AVDC Ko等,2024年生成一个视频计划并用反向动力模型或密集相干来回收动作(第6.5节).
这种计划很容易检查,但增加了发电成本和另一个出错来源。
世界导航模式 Bar等,2025年,在可选导航行动下,用有条件的扩散变形器预测以自我为中心的观测,并通过检查哪些模拟轨迹达到目标来规划。
虚拟伙伴关系 Hu 等,2025年相反,通过微调的视频传播模型,为未来意识特征设定了反向动力学政策.
拉迪-温姆 Huang等,2025年b和妇女事务部 Yu等人,2025c 将潜在预测与地物或像素信号结合,以及LaWAM Chen等,2026b 预测潜在的视觉分目标而不重建视频.
在潜在的一端,V-JEPA 2-AC和DINO-WM在不解码像素的情况下评分候选行为,这削减了预测成本,但使其预测更难检查.

blocks.en:
Prediction can also serve only as training supervision.
WLA-0 Yang et al., 2026c trains shared representations with a future-frame World Expert and an Action Expert, so the World Expert can be dropped at test time or re-enabled to select among sampled action chunks.
blocks.zh:
预测也只能作为培训监督。
WLA-0 Yang等,2026c列车与未来框架世界专家与行动专家共享陈述,因此世界专家可在测试时间被丢弃,或被重新启用,在被采样的动作块中选择.

blocks.en: 8.3.5 Interactive Simulation for Humans
blocks.zh: 8.3.5 人类互动模拟

blocks.en:
In human-interactive simulation, world prediction is the application: a person supplies actions, and the model produces the evolving observation stream.
Among playable systems, Genie made unlabeled video playable and Genie 3 Parker-Holder & Fruchter, 2025 opens text-prompted worlds to real-time exploration, GameNGen simulates an existing game in real time, and Oasis Decart et al., 2024 and Matrix-Game 2.0 He et al., 2025a target real-time open deployment.
Yume Mao et al., 2026 and RELIC Hong et al., 2025 extend exploration to real-world scenes, with RELIC adding long-horizon memory for revisits.
Voice-controlled streaming characters such as Vidu S1 and Wan-Streamer (Section 8.2.3 ) extend the input from game actions to speech, so response timing and turn-level coherence matter alongside visual continuity.
In driving, GAIA-2, Vista, and Cosmos-Drive-Dreams Ren et al., 2025 let users set trajectories, actions, or scene conditions and inspect the resulting futures.
With a fixed-control model, the user edits conditions between rollouts, whereas an interactive system accepts input within the stream.
blocks.zh:
在人-交互模拟中,世界预测是应用:一个人提供动作,而模型产生演化中的观测流.
在可玩的系统中,Genie使无标签视频可玩和Genie 3 Parker-Holder & Fruchter,2025打开了文本提示的世界进行实时探索,GameNgen实时模拟了一款已存在的游戏,Oasis Decart等,2024年和Matrix-Game 2. He等,2025a目标实时公开部署.
Yume Mao等,2026年和RELIC Hong等,2025年将探索扩展到了现实世界的场景,RELIC增加了长相记忆来进行再探.
Vidu S1和Wan-Streamer(第8.2.3节)等语音控制流体字符将输入从游戏动作扩展至语音,因此响应时间和转会级别一致性与视觉连续性相并列.
在驾驶中,GAIA-2,Vista,和Cosmos-Drive-Dreams Ren等,2025,让用户设定出轨迹,动作,或场景条件并检查由此而来的未来.
使用固定控制模型,用户会在推出之间编辑条件,而交互式系统则接受流内输入.

blocks.en: 8.4 Benchmarks and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 8.4 基准和评价

blocks.en:
World-model evaluation follows the role of the prediction.
A rendered future needs visual and motion quality, and an interactive simulator adds action fidelity, persistent state, and bounded response time.
Planning, policy training, and policy evaluation further require the prediction to improve or faithfully estimate a downstream decision.
These requirements form the Interacting row of the evidence ladder in Table 2 , from visual plausibility through controllable rollout to decision utility Yu et al., 2026a .
Table 19 indexes current benchmarks by the claim they test and the main limits on comparing their scores.
blocks.zh:
世界模型评价遵循预测的作用.
A 使未来需要视觉和运动质量,一个交互式模拟器会增加动作忠贞性、持续状态和有限度的反应时间。
规划、政策培训和政策评价还需要预测,以改进或忠实地估计下游的决定。
这些要求构成表2中证据阶梯的交互行,从可视性到可控推出到决定效用Yu等人,2026a。
表19按它们测试的索赔和比较其分数的主要限度来索引当前的基准。

blocks.en: Table 19: World-model benchmarks and protocols by target, with limits on interpreting and comparing scores.
blocks.zh: 表19 按目标划分的世界模型基准和协议,对分数的解释和比较有限制.

blocks.en: 8.4.1 Challenge-Aligned Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 8.4.1 调整挑战基准

blocks.en:
Action following and controllability. Action benchmarks test whether changing a control changes the predicted future as intended.
ACT-Bench Arai et al., 2024 measures instruction–execution consistency and trajectory error for driving maneuvers, and iWorld-Bench Fang et al., 2026 separates trajectory following from visual quality and memory through a unified action layer.
In robotics, MiraBench Yang et al., 2026b tests action following, physical adherence, and optimism under actions that should fail, which matters because a simulator that turns failed actions into plausible successes misleads both policy training and evaluation.
Since a game key, a camera pose, a robot action chunk, and an ego trajectory need different error measures, reports should state the native action space, horizon, intervention frequency, and source of trajectory estimates.
blocks.zh:
行动跟踪和可控性。 行动基准测试改变控制是否如预期的那样改变预测的未来。
ACT-Bench Arai等人, 2024 年测量指令 - 执行一致性和驾驶操作的轨迹误差, iWorld-Bench Fang等人, 2026 年通过统一的动作层,将跟随视觉质量和记忆的轨迹分开.
在机器人学方面,Mira Bench Yang等人在2026年b测试之后的行动、实际的遵守和在应该失败的行动下的乐观,这很重要,因为一个模拟器将失败的行动转变为可能的成功会误导政策培训和评价。
由于游戏键、相机、机器人动作块和自负轨迹需要不同的出错度量,报告应说明原生动作空间、地平线、干预频率和轨迹估计的来源。

blocks.en:
Long-horizon consistency and memory. Consistency asks how identity, geometry, and appearance degrade with duration even when content stays visible.
Measuring this degradation requires scores stratified by video length.
Memory tests instead remove content from view and check it later.
Revisit benchmarks such as LoopBench Wu et al., 2026b test static recall, comparing returns with the model’s own first visit.
blocks.zh:
长相相相与相忆. 一致性询问身份、几何和外观如何随着持续时间而退化,即使内容仍然可见。
测量这种退化需要按视频长度分出分数。
取而代之的是内存测试将内容从视图中去除并稍后检查.
重访LoopBench 等基准 Wu等,2026b测试静态召回,与模型自己的首次访问相比回报.

blocks.en:
However, a static cache passes revisit tests even when the world should have changed.
MBench Zhang et al., 2026i separates entity, environment, and causal memory under occlusion and off-screen evolution, STEVO-Bench Ma et al., 2026b hides an ongoing process and checks whether it advanced, and MemoBench Chen et al., 2026a requires an object that changed out of view to return in its updated state.
MIND Ye et al., 2026 and WorldRoamBench Xu et al., 2026b test memory during closed-loop or open-world interaction, the latter scoring memory separately from action following, visual drift, and controllability-gated physics.
Memory Maze Pasukonis et al., 2023 poses the same retention question for navigation agents.
These protocols score decoded video; latent-state models lack matching probes of drift and goal reachability.
blocks.zh:
然而,即使世界应该改变,静态缓存也会通过重新审查测试。
MBench Zhang等,2026i在封存和外屏演化下分离出实体,环境,和因果记忆,STEVO-Bench Ma等,2026b隐藏了持续过程并检查其是否被推进,而Memo Bench Chen等,2026a要求一个因视线变化而改变的物体返回更新状态.
思维 Ye等,2026年和WorldRoam Bench Xu等,2026b在闭路或开通世界互动时测试记忆,后一分记忆与后一动作,视觉漂移,可控性相接物理学相分离.
Memory Maze Pasukonis等,2023年对导航剂提出了相同的保留问题.
这些协议得分解码视频;潜在状态模型缺乏相匹配的漂移探测器和可达目标.

blocks.en:
Real-time response. Latency is reported per system, usually as FPS or time to first response, and mixes model forward time with denoising steps, decoding, cache construction, input rate, and hardware.
A matched protocol would measure the delay from an action’s arrival to the first affected frame, sustained throughput, and latency variance over long sessions, at stated resolution, precision, hardware, and action frequency.
blocks.zh:
实时响应. 每个系统都报告延迟,通常作为FPS或时间进行第一次响应,并将模型前期时间与去诺化步骤,解码,缓存构造,输入率,和硬件相混合.
匹配的协议将测量从行动到达第一个受影响的框架、持续吞吐量和长期会议间差异的延迟,按明确分辨率、精确度、硬件和行动频率计算。

blocks.en:
Physical, temporal, and causal validity. Physical evaluation ranges from prompt-based plausibility to comparison with recorded outcomes.
Prompt-based suites such as VideoPhy and VideoPhy-2 Bansal et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2026 are described in Section 6.1.2 .
PhyGenBench Meng et al., 2025 organizes prompts by physical principle, and WorldModelBench Li et al., 2025b combines instruction following with checks for violations such as broken conservation.
Physics-IQ Motamed et al., 2026 instead compares continuations of a real initial segment with recorded outcomes, and PhyWorldBench Gu et al., 2026a adds anti-physics prompts that test whether a model can follow instructions that deliberately violate physics while staying logically consistent.
Other suites probe specific factors.
WorldBench Upadhyay et al., 2026 separates intuitive principles from quantities such as friction and viscosity, and CRONOS Begiristain et al., 2026 varies viewpoint, scene, appearance, and category within controlled events.
What-If World Cai et al., 2026 pairs prompts that change one physical detail and scores both the outcome difference and the preservation of the environment.
ChronoMagic-Bench Yuan et al., 2024 tests temporal direction through metamorphic and time-lapse processes such as growth or construction.
Prompt-level and rendered contrasts cover only part of the intervention protocol of Section 8.2.4 , which ultimately needs logged actions and real outcomes.
blocks.zh:
物理、时间和因果关系。 实际评价的范围从迅速的可信度到与记录结果的比较不等。
2025年的VideoPhy和VideoPhy-2 Bansal等快速套房;2026年的Bansal等在6.1.2.节中描述.
宾克 Meng等人,2025年按物理原理组织提示,WorldModel Bench Li等,2025b 将指令与对破坏保护等违法行为的检查结合起来。
物理学-智商 Motamed等,2026年取而代之的是将真初段的续作与所记录的结果相提并论,而PhyWorld Bench Gu等,2026a又增加了反物理学提示,测试一个模型能否遵循故意违反物理的指令而保持逻辑一致性.
其他套房探究具体因素.
World Bench Upadhyay等,2026年 将直观原理与摩擦和粘度等数量区分开来,而CRONOS Begiristain等,2026年 不同观点,场景,外观,以及受控事件中的类别.
如果说世界 Cai等人, 2026对 提示改变一个物理细节, 评分结果差异和环境保护。
ChronoMagic-Bench Yuan等,2024年,通过生长或构造等变相和时滞过程来测试时间方向.
速成和形成对比只涵盖第8.2.4节干预协议的部分内容,最终需要记录行动和实际结果。

blocks.en:
Calibration of predicted futures. Stochastic world models should also produce the right spread of futures.
PAWBench Pu et al., 2026 and CaliBench Sadeghi et al., 2026 sample repeated futures from a fixed input and compare the outcome distribution with reference probabilities or sets of valid outcomes, reporting separately how often outcomes can be scored.
C 3 Mei et al., 2025 calibrates confidence rather than outcome frequencies: it trains a probe that predicts whether a latent prediction is accurate and evaluates it against accuracy labels.
blocks.zh:
校正预测后期. 斯多克的世界模型也应该产生正确的未来分布.
PAWBench Pu等人,2026年和Cali Bench Sadeghi等人,2026年样本从固定输入中重复了期货,并比较了结果分布与参考概率或成套有效结果,分别报告结果可以打出多少分.
C级 3 Mei等,2025 校正了信心而不是结果频率:它训练出一个探测器,预测潜在预测是否准确,并对照准确的标签来评价.

blocks.en: 8.4.2 Application-Aligned Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 8.4.2 应用统一基准

blocks.en:
Application-aligned benchmarks measure a prediction’s effect after another component consumes it, through policy-ranking agreement, optimization gains, planning success, executable action success, or data efficiency.
For policy evaluation, WorldGym Quevedo et al., 2026 and WorldEval Li et al., 2025i compare model-based success rates or rankings with real robot trials.
WMBench, introduced with GigaWorld-1 GigaWorld Team et al., 2026 , studies evaluator design with an ordinal score that separates correct from incorrect task outcomes and high from low visual fidelity.
For planning, WorldPrediction Chen et al., 2025a tests high-level state transitions and procedural ordering, using counterfactual distractors that remove low-level continuity shortcuts.
World-in-World Zhang et al., 2026d places heterogeneous models behind a shared action interface and measures closed-loop task success.
blocks.zh:
应用组合基准通过政策级协议、优化收益、规划成功、可执行行动成功或数据效率,衡量预测在另一组成部分消耗后的效果。
关于政策评价, WorldGym Quevedo等人,2026年和WorldEval Li等,2025i 将基于模型的成功率或排名与真正的机器人试验进行比较.
WMBennch,由GigaWorld-1 GigaWorld介绍 Team等,2026年,研究评价员设计,其正数分数与不正确的任务结果和高视忠度相分.
规划,世界预测 Chen等,2025a测试高水平状态过渡和程序订单,使用反事实分流器去除低水平接续捷径.
世界间 Zhang等人, 2026d 将多种模式置于共享行动界面的背后,并衡量闭路任务的成功。

blocks.en:
Embodied benchmarks make predictions executable or check them against task requirements.
RoboWM-Bench Jiang et al., 2026 converts generated manipulation videos into actions and executes them in a physics simulator, so visually plausible but unexecutable motion earns little credit.
EWMBench Yue et al., 2025 separates scene consistency, motion correctness, and semantic alignment, showing that visually stable output can miss the task motion.
WorldLens Liang et al., 2026 and DrivingGen Zhou et al., 2026b evaluate driving models, from generation and reconstruction to action following, trajectory plausibility, and downstream tasks.
WorldArena Shang et al., 2026 places perceptual quality alongside data-engine, policy-evaluation, and planning utility and finds that the two rankings need not agree.
blocks.zh:
健全的基准使预测可以执行或根据任务要求加以检查。
RoboWM-Bench Jiang等, 2026年将生成的操控视频转换为动作并用物理模拟器执行,
EWMBENCH 语言 Yue等,2025 分离出场景一致性,运动正确性,语义对齐性,显示视觉稳定的输出会错过任务运动.
WorldLens Liang等人,2026年和驾驶Gen Zhou等,2026b 评估驱动模式,从世代相继,再重建到行动,轨迹可信,下游任务.
世界地图 Shang等,2026年将知觉质量与数据引擎,政策评价,规划效用等放在一起,并发现这两个排名没有必要达成一致.

blocks.en:
Latent-state models need their own audits.
ARC-Bench Zhang & Li, 2026 tests whether frozen latent-distance objectives rank candidate actions by their executed outcome costs, reporting rank agreement and regret while varying the replanning frequency, since frequent replanning can mask poor scoring.
PokeWorld Tan et al., 2026 pushes visually identical objects with different mass, drag, and stiffness to ask whether these parameters can be decoded from the latent state and whether predicted action effects depend on them correctly.
blocks.zh:
后期状态模型需要自己的审计.
ARC-Bench Zhang & Li, 2026 测试被冻结的潜在距离目标是否根据其执行结果成本对候选人的行动进行排序,报告排名协议并后悔,同时改变重新规划的频率,因为频繁重新规划可能掩盖差分.
泡泡世界协会 Tan et al., 2026 推出具有不同质量,拖曳和僵硬的视同物体来询问这些参数是否可以从潜在状态解码,预测的动作效果是否依赖于它们正确.

blocks.en: 8.4.3 Foundational and Comprehensive Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 8.4.3 基本和全面的基准

blocks.en:
Foundational video benchmarks set the visual and temporal quality floor on which control, memory, and utility tests build.
They include the generation suites VBench and VBench-2.0 Huang et al., 2024a ; Zheng et al., 2025 (Section 6.1.2 ) and VBench++ Huang et al., 2026f , which adds image-conditioned generation and trustworthiness.
blocks.zh:
基本视频基准设定了控制、内存和公用事业测试所依据的视觉和时间质量底线。
其中包括:V Bench和V Bench-2.0 Huang等人,2024a;Zheng等人,2025年(第6.1.2节)和V Bench++。 Huang等,2026f.),增加了以图像为条件的生成和可信赖性.

blocks.en:
Comprehensive world-model suites differ mainly in protocol.
WorldScore Duan et al., 2025 asks models to generate successive scenes along given camera trajectories and scores controllability, quality, and dynamics.
WorldSimBench Qin et al., 2025 pairs human-aligned perceptual assessment with a manipulation test that turns generated video into control signals.
WorldMark Xu et al., 2026c and WBench Ying et al., 2026 evaluate interactive generation through standardized action sequences and multi-turn episodes, respectively.
WorldOlympiad Zhao et al., 2026c scores physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity across games, robotics, and open-domain video.
Shared tooling helps hold data and controllers fixed across comparisons: the stable-worldmodel platform Maes et al., 2026 provides common data interfaces, baselines, planners, and environments with controllable visual, geometric, and physical factors.
blocks.zh:
综合性的世界型套房主要在协议上有所不同.
WorldScore Duan et al., 2025 要求模型按照给定的相机轨迹和分数可控性,质量和动态来生成相继的场景.
世界新宾克 秦等,"2025"将人相通的知觉评估与操控测试相配,将生成的视频转化为控制信号.
世界市场 徐等,2026c和W Bench Ying等,2026分别通过标准化动作序列和多回转相来评价交互生成.
世界奥林匹克运动会 Zhao等,2026c评出物理忠诚度,几何一致性,以及互动忠诚度跨游戏,机器人,和开放域视频.
共享工具有助于通过比较固定数据和控制器:稳定-世界模型平台 Maes等,2026年提供常见的数据接口,基线,规划者,以及具有可控可视,几何,物理等因素的环境.

blocks.en:
INSIGHT From predictive state to intervention and utility Evidence for a world model should match its transition protocol (Table 2 ).
Passive models show predictive structure, and controlled models must also change the world where an action acts and keep what it leaves untouched.
Interactive systems must preserve those consequences under feedback, and decision applications must turn them into better choices.
blocks.zh:
新闻 从预测状态到干预和有用性,世界模型的证据应当与其过渡协议相匹配(表2)。
被动模型显示出预测性结构,被控制的模型也必须改变一个动作作用的世界,并保持它留下的东西不受影响.
互动系统必须在反馈下保留这些后果,决策应用必须将其转化为更好的选择。

blocks.en: INSIGHT From predictive state to intervention and utility
blocks.zh: 新闻 从预测状态到干预和效用

blocks.en: 9 Open Challenges and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 9 公开挑战和未来方向

blocks.en: Seven open problems span reading, writing, sharing, and interacting; each needs new methods and better tests.
blocks.zh: 七个公开的问题涉及阅读、写作、分享和互动;每个问题都需要新的方法和更好的测试。

blocks.en:
Current models share recurring limits: encoders rarely maintain a predictive state, generators lose identity and physical constraints over time, unified models have yet to show controlled synergy, and interactive systems degrade as generated history accumulates.
These limits, together with gaps in evaluation, action supervision, generalization, and uncertainty, define seven challenges: long-horizon consistency, physical and causal grounding, measurable synergy, standardized evaluation, control from unlabeled video, generalization across scenes and embodiments, and stochastic worlds with rare events.
blocks.zh:
目前的模型共享了重复性限制:编码器很少保持预测状态,发电机失去特性并随着时间的推移受到物理限制,统一的模型尚未显示出可控制的协同效应,而交互式系统随着生成历史的积累而退化.
这些限制,加上评价、行动监督、概括和不确定性方面的差距,界定了七项挑战:长期一致性、物理和因果基础、可衡量的协同作用、标准化评价、对无标签视频的控制、跨场景和表现的概括,以及具有罕见事件的花样世界。

blocks.en: 9.1 Long-Horizon World Consistency
blocks.zh: 9.1 长视世界一致性

blocks.en:
Long-horizon consistency requires a model to retrieve distant evidence, preserve state that is no longer visible, and render that state consistently in later predictions.
Long-video understanding benchmarks Wu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Zhou et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2026 mainly test the first of these (Section 5.1 ).
Autoregressive generation and interaction add a further difficulty: generated errors enter the history that later predictions depend on.
Current methods balance recent and distant context Lu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025c , store retrievable observations Xiao et al., 2025a ; Hong et al., 2025 , or compress history into recurrent or fixed-size memory Bian et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026c (Section 8.2.2 ).
However, most of them store what was visible, whereas a predictive state must also track what changed off-screen; only a few systems model such change explicitly Wang et al., 2026a ; Duan et al., 2026 .
For example, a hidden ice cube keeps its identity as it melts (Figure 11 ).
Replaying the stored observation returns a stale cube Chen et al., 2026a .
blocks.zh:
长视一致性需要一种模型来取出遥远的证据,保存已经不可见的状态,并在后期预测中使这种状态一致.
长视频理解基准 Wu等,2024;Wang等,2025c;Zhou等,2025b;He等,2026主要测试其中第一个(第5.1节.
自动回转生成和相互作用又增加了一个困难:产生的出错输入后期预测所依赖的历史.
当前方法平衡近期和遥远的背景 Lu等, 2024; Zhang等, 2025c, 存储可检索观测 Xiao等,2025a;Hong等,2025;或将历史压缩为经常性或固定大小的内存 Bian等,2026;Wei等,2026c(第8.2.2.节)。
然而,大多数系统都存储可见的,而预测状态也必须跟踪屏幕外的变化;只有少数系统明确模拟这种变化。 Wang等,2026a; Duan等,2026.
例如,隐藏的冰立方体在融化时保持其特性(图11.
重放存储的观测结果返回一个 stale 立方体 陈等, 2026a.

blocks.en: Figure 11: Hidden state evolves during occlusion; replaying an old observation can miss that change.
blocks.zh: 图11:隐藏状态在被封禁期间会演化;重放一回旧的观察可以错过这一变化.

blocks.en:
One method direction is memory that updates a hidden state during occlusion, trained to predict how unseen entities evolve, instead of replaying stored frames.
Such memory complements rollout training: LIVE Huang et al., 2026c targets error growth through forward–reverse cycle consistency without any external memory, so the two address different failures and can be combined.
Memory must also fit an interactive budget: uncapped archives grow with the rollout, and retention budgets Al et al., 2026 turn this growth into eviction decisions, so learning what to keep is itself a research problem.
blocks.zh:
一个方法方向是存储器在被隐蔽时更新隐藏状态,经过训练可以预测隐形实体是如何进化的,而不是重放被存储帧.
这种记忆补充了推出培训: 活着 Huang等,2026c通过前向-逆向循环一致性,没有任何外在内存来瞄准出错增长,因此两者处理不同的出错,可以合并.
记忆还必须符合互动预算:未封装档案随着推出而增加,保留预算 Al等,2026年将这种增长转化为驱逐决定,因此学习什么保存本身就是一个研究问题.

blocks.en:
Memory benchmarks Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026i ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Xu et al., 2026b now test revisits, occlusion, and off-screen change (Section 8.4 ).
The next step is to vary rollout length and revisit distance separately and report degradation curves instead of one terminal score, so that rendering drift and state loss can be told apart.
Latent-state models have no frames to score, so they need probes of goal reachability, feature stability, and decision quality as the horizon grows.
Consistency results should also report memory size, end-to-end latency, and action-update rate.
blocks.zh:
内存基准 Ye等,2026;张等,2026i; Chen等,2026a;徐等,2026b 现为测试再审,隔离和外屏变化(第8.4节).
下一步是改变推出长度,分别重访距离,报告降解曲线而不是一个终端分数,以便分辨出漂移和状态损失。
Latent-state型号无帧可分,因此它们需要探测可达目标,特征稳定性,以及随着地平线的扩大决定质量.
一致性结果还应报告内存大小、端到端的延迟和动作更新率。

blocks.en: 9.2 Physical and Causal Grounding
blocks.zh: 9.2 物理地基和因果地基

blocks.en: Figure 12: Changing gravity alters the trajectory while unrelated scene properties remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 图 12:改变地心引力改变轨迹,而无关场景特性保持不变.

blocks.en:
Physical grounding can be tested at three increasingly demanding levels.
Reading benchmarks Riochet et al., 2022 ; Bear et al., 2021 ; Yi et al., 2020 test whether a model recognizes persistence, stability, contact, and counterfactual outcomes in observed events.
Generation benchmarks Bansal et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Gu et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2024 ask whether a synthesized outcome follows physical commonsense, a named law, or the direction of an irreversible process (Section 6.1.2 ).
Action- and parameter-conditioned models face a stronger test: changing an action or physical parameter should change the affected outcome and leave unrelated state intact.
For example, a ball released with the same velocity under two gravity settings should follow different trajectories while the camera and background stay fixed (Figure 12 ).
A realistic continuation can still respond wrongly to gravity or alter unrelated state, so realism is not enough Hu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025b .
blocks.zh:
物理地基的试验可以在三个要求越来越高的水平上进行。
阅读基准 Riochet等人,2022年;Bear等人,2021年;Yi等人,2020年测试一个模型是否承认所观测到的事件中的持久性、稳定性、接触和反事实结果。
世代基准 Bansal等,2025年;Bansal等,2026年;Meng等,2025年;Li等,2025年b;Gu等,2026年a;Yuan等,2024年;询问综合结果是遵循物理常识、定名法,还是遵循不可逆转过程的方向(第6.1.2节)。
动作和参数条件模型面临更强的考验:改变一个动作或物理参数应改变受影响的结果并保持无关状态完整.
例如,在两个重力设置下释放出同样速度的球,在相机和背景保持固定时,应当遵循不同的轨迹(图12.
现实的延续仍然可以错误地应对重力或改变无关的状态,所以现实主义不足以满足胡等,2026;李等,2025b.

blocks.en:
Current methods add physics at different stages (Section 8.2.4 ): they align generator features with a video encoder Zhang et al., 2025e , simulate dynamics before rendering Liu et al., 2024b , condition generation on a planned motion Yang et al., 2025d , reward geometric consistency Wang et al., 2026d , or retrieve videos of similar phenomena Cheng et al., 2026a .
Each depends on an outside source: the teacher’s coverage, the recovered state and material parameters, the generator’s ability to follow the plan, or the quality of the feedback and retrieved evidence.
Paired rollouts that change one physical parameter Hu et al., 2026 , production data with recorded branches Cai et al., 2026a , and coupled action-conditioned futures He et al., 2026b provide the missing contrast between a change and its effect.
One direction combines these physics priors with intervention-paired data, with objectives that reward the intended change and penalize drift elsewhere.
blocks.zh:
目前的方法在不同阶段添加了物理(第8.2.4节):它们使生成器的特性与视频编码器一致 Zhang等,2025e, 渲染前模拟动态 刘等,2024b.,按计划动议进行条件生成. Yang等,2025d,奖励几何一致性 Wang等,2026d,或检索到类似现象的视频. Cheng等, 2026a. (中文(简体) ).
每一个都取决于外部来源:教师的覆盖范围、恢复状态和物质参数、发电机遵循计划的能力,或反馈和检索证据的质量。
改变一个物理参数的 Paired 推出 Hu等,2026年,有记录分行Cai等的生产数据,2026a,并结合行动条件期货 他等,2026b提供了变化与其效果之间的缺失对比.
一个方向是将这些物理学前科和干预数据结合起来,目标是奖励预期的变化并惩罚其他地方的漂移。

blocks.en:
Evaluation should also diagnose failures: an arrow-of-time error, a contact violation, and a wrong response to an action all make a clip implausible, but they implicate different model components and training signals.
Recent intervention benchmarks Upadhyay et al., 2026 ; Begiristain et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 point toward a common protocol: hold the initial state fixed, change one action or physical parameter, and test the changed outcome, the invariance of unrelated state, the first violated constraint, and when it appears.
Applying the same interventions to reading questions, generated continuations, and closed-loop rollouts would make transfer across operations measurable.
blocks.zh:
评价还应诊断失败:时空箭头出错、接触违规和对某一行动作出错误反应都使剪辑不可信,但它们涉及不同的模型组件和培训信号。
最近干预基准 Upadhyay等, 2026; Begiristain等, 2026; Cai等, 2026 指向一个共同协议: 固定初始状态, 改变一个动作或物理参数, 测试改变的结果, 不相关的状态的不常, 第一个违反的制约, 当它出现时.
对阅读问题采用同样的干预措施、产生续作和封闭式推出将使跨业务转移成为可计量的。

blocks.en: 9.3 Measurable Synergy in Unified Video Models
blocks.zh: 9.3 统一视频模型中的可计量协同

blocks.en:
Unified video models span discrete-token, continuous, and modular designs Wang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2026k ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026e ; Zhang et al., 2026a , and some route information from generation to understanding, from reasoning to generation, or into planning Qin et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 (Sections 7.1 and 7.2.4 ).
The open question is causal: how much of the gain comes from shared representations or information flow, and how much from additional data, parameters, or supervision?
Video evidence of transfer is so far partial or one-directional: video-diffusion features support recognition and geometry King et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c , an MLLM’s reasoning trace raises generation scores Pan et al., 2026 , mixing data helps both tasks Fu et al., 2026a , a frozen vision-language critic improves editing Liu et al., 2025d , and predicted features affect actions Wang et al., 2026b (Section 7.2 ).
Breadth suites Wei et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026h catch regressions but not transfer, and image-domain synergy tests Shi et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026a miss what video adds: transferred information must preserve temporal order, motion, identity, and evolving state.
blocks.zh:
统一视频模型涵盖离散式、连续式和模块式设计 王等编. 2024b;Liu等,2026k;Wei等,2026e;Wang等,2026e;Zhang等,2026a;以及一些从一代到理解,从推理到一代,或进入规划秦等,2026;Pan等,2026;Lu等,2025(第7.1和7.2.4节).
尚未解决的问题是因果:分享表述或信息流动能带来多少收益,以及额外数据、参数或监督能产生多少收益?
转让的视频证据到目前为止是部分的或单向的:视频传播功能支持识别和几何 King等, 2026; Wang等, 2026c, MLLM的推理追踪可以提高生成分数 Pan等人, 2026, 混合数据帮助两个任务 Fu et al., 2026a.,一名被冻结的视觉语言评论家改进了编辑Liu et al., 2025d., 预测特征影响行动 Wang et al., 2026b.(第7.2节.
面包套间 Wei等, 2026b;Li等, 2026h 捕捉回向但未转移, 和图像域协同测试 施相等,("史记"作相等. 2026b; Yang等, 2026a miss what video address: 转移信息必须保持时间顺序, 运动, 身份, 以及不断发展的状态。

blocks.en: Figure 13: Two systems with matched resources differ only in whether information passes between understanding and generation.
blocks.zh: 图13:两个资源匹配的系统仅在信息是否在理解和生成之间传递方面有所不同。

blocks.en:
On the method side, each transfer path can be built as a separate component that can be switched off, such as a temporal-analysis loss on the generator or generated intermediate states passed to a temporal reasoner.
Round-trip consistency between inferred trajectories and rendered video can then serve as a training signal as well as a test.
blocks.zh:
在方法方面,每个传输路径都可以被构建成一个单独的可以被关闭的组件,例如发生器上的时间分析损失或生成的中间状态传递到时间解释器上.
由此推断出轨迹与制作的视频之间的圆通一致性,既可作为训练信号,也可用作测试.

blocks.en:
The test itself compares two systems with the same tasks, data, capacity, and compute that differ only in whether the cross-direction path is enabled (Figure 13 ).
Temporal analysis should then improve event order, motion, identity, or physical dynamics in generation, and generated intermediate states should improve temporal inference or planning under the same observation and parameter budget.
Round trips render an inferred trajectory or event graph and read it back, or analyze, revise, and regenerate a rollout.
Each task must define its invariants, because one description can match several valid videos, and the intermediate representation must not carry the answer verbatim Niu et al., 2025a .
blocks.zh:
测试本身对两个系统进行比较,它们的任务,数据,容量相同,计算结果仅在交叉方向路径是否启用方面有所不同(图13.
然后,时间分析应改善生成中的事件顺序、运动、身份或物理动态,生成的中间状态应在同样的观察和参数预算下改进时间推论或规划。
圆行会使所推断出的一个轨迹或事件图被读回,或分析、修改并重新生成一个推出图。
每个任务必须定义其变化因素,因为一个描述可以匹配几个有效的视频,中间代表决不能携带解答逐字记录Niu等人,2025a.

blocks.en: 9.4 Standardized Evaluation of World Properties
blocks.zh: 9.4 世界财产标准化评价

blocks.en: Figure 14: Video and feature predictions need different probes, but both face the same decision test.
blocks.zh: 图14:视频和地物预测需要不同的探测器,但两者面临相同的决定测试.

blocks.en:
World-model evaluation now covers control, memory, physical validity, and decision utility as well as visual realism, but the resulting numbers are rarely comparable.
Suites for generated video, action response, and broader world properties Huang et al., 2024a ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Arai et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Duan et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Zhao et al., 2026c differ in prompts, control spaces, horizons, and judges (Section 8.4 ), so scores do not transfer across suites.
For example, two predictors guiding the same robot may return video and features, respectively (Figure 14 ).
Video allows visual and trajectory checks while features need state probes, and both need a decision test, because either can score well on its native metric yet fail at control Yu et al., 2026a ; Zhang & Li, 2026 .
blocks.zh:
世界模式评价现在涵盖控制、内存、物理有效性、决策效用以及视觉现实主义,但由此产生的数字很少具有可比性。
适用于生成的视频、行动反应和更广泛的世界属性 Huang等,2024a;Zheng等,2025;Arai等,2024;Fang等,2026;Duan等,2025;Xu等,2026c;Ying等,2026;Liang等,2026;Xu等,2026b;Zhao等,2026c在出错率,控制空间,地平线和裁判方面有差异(第8.4节),因此分数不跨套间调用.
例如,指导同一机器人的两个预测器可能分别返回视频和特性(图14.
视频允许视觉和轨迹检查,而特性需要状态探测器,两者都需要一个决定测试,因为任意一种都可以在原生的度量上得分良好,但在控制上却失败了 于等, 2026a; 张等, 2026.

blocks.en:
A reporting standard should first match the protocol to the model’s prediction space and transition interface (Section 4.4 ).
Interactive models need mid-rollout interventions and latency tests, action-conditioned models need faithful responses to fixed controls, and passive predictors need held-out transition tests.
Each result should state the horizon, action frequency, conditioning, and judge model, and claims should rise from visual to controllable-rollout to decision-utility evidence Yu et al., 2026a (Table 2 ).
Real-time claims need control-to-display latency, sustained throughput, and latency variance, reported with hardware, resolution, denoising steps, and active context, because frames per second alone is ambiguous.
blocks.zh:
报告标准应首先使协议与模型的预测空间和过渡界面相匹配(第4.4节)。
互动模型需要中途推出的干预和耐久性测试,有动作条件的模型需要对固定控制作出忠实的反应,而被动预测器则需要被搁置的过渡测试.
每项结果应说明前景、行动频率、条件和判断模式,索赔应从可视化到可控滚动到决策效用证据 Yu等,2026a(表2.).
实时索赔需要控制到披露的延迟性,持续的吞吐量和延迟性差异,用硬件,解析度,去诺步骤和活性上下文来报告,因为单是帧每秒就模糊了.

blocks.en:
Shared infrastructure Maes et al., 2026 standardizes data readers, planning solvers, and environment variations.
Fixed-candidate action ranking should accompany closed-loop success, because frequent replanning can hide a poor scorer Zhang & Li, 2026 .
Integrity needs held-out environments and leakage-controlled synthetic tasks, because web-scale and synthetic training data make overlap hard to detect.
On the method side, two tools need development in their own right: learned judges, which can inherit their source models’ blind spots and need validation against human ratings, and standard probes that read latent predictions without a pixel decoder.
blocks.zh:
共有基础设施 Maes等,2026年将数据读取器,计划解析器和环境变异标准化.
固定的candidate动作排名应该伴随着闭路跑的成功,因为频繁的再规划可以隐藏一个差分得分者Zhang & Li, 2026.
完整性需要保持环境和受渗漏控制的合成任务,因为网络规模和合成培训数据很难发现重叠。
在方法方面,两个工具本身需要开发:有学问的法官,他们可以继承其源模型的盲点,需要对照人类的评级进行验证;以及没有像素解码器而读取潜在预测的标准探测器。

blocks.en: 9.5 Scaling Control from Unlabeled Video
blocks.zh: 9.5 从无标签视频缩放控制

blocks.en: Figure 15: Action effects mix with camera and background motion.
blocks.zh: 图15:动作效果与相机和背景运动相混合.

blocks.en:
Internet video covers objects, agents, and dynamics but usually lacks the action behind each transition.
Latent-action methods Schmidt & Jiang, 2024 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025d infer actions as a learned variable (Section 8.2.1 ), enabling the use of far more video than labeled datasets, but scale alone does not specify what the variable represents.
For example, a gripper may push a block while the camera pans and a windmill turns (Figure 15 ).
Only the push is the agent’s action, yet a latent code trained for reconstruction can absorb the camera and background motion while reproducing the clip.
Distractor experiments confirm this and show that limited action supervision can substantially improve the recovered factors Nikulin et al., 2025 .
blocks.zh:
互联网视频覆盖对象,代理和动态,但通常缺乏每次过渡背后的动作.
(原始内容存档于2013-10-12) (英语). Lententent-Action methods Schmidt & Jiang,. 2024; Bruce等, 2024; Ye等, 2025; Chen等, 2025d 推论动作作为已学习到的变量(第8.2.1节), 使得视频比被标记的数据集使用量大得多,但单是尺度并不能说明变量代表什么.
例如,在相机平板机和风车转向时,抓取器可能会推出一个块(图15.
只有推力是代理的动作,然而为重建而训练的潜在代码可以在复制剪辑的同时吸收相机和背景运动.
灾难实验证实了这一点,并表明有限的行动监督能够大大地改善回收系数Nikulin等人,2025年。

blocks.en:
Reconstruction accuracy and codebook usage are thus weak evidence of control: a useful latent action should predict controllable effects, stay stable under camera and background changes, and transfer through a simple mapping.
Several weak signals can push latent actions toward these properties.
A small labeled set can anchor latent dimensions to real controls, multi-view invariance can separate camera motion from scene change, temporal bottlenecks can discard details irrelevant to control, and paired interventions can mark which changes belong to the agent.
Continuous latent actions Gao et al., 2025 , human–robot shared representations Chen et al., 2024e , and egomotion controls from tracked pixel motion Sundar et al., 2026 move in this direction, while state-annotated data Li et al., 2026j ; Cai et al., 2026a give stronger but narrower supervision.
blocks.zh:
因此,重建精确度和编码本的使用是控制方面的薄弱证据:一个有用的潜在行动应预测可控制的影响,在相机和背景变化下保持稳定,并通过简单的绘图进行传输。
一些微弱的信号可以把潜在的行动推向这些属性.
一个被贴上标签的小集可以将潜伏的维度固定在真实的控制上,多视图偏移可以将相机运动从场景变化中分离出来,时间瓶颈可以丢弃与控制无关的细节,配对的干预可以标记哪些变化属于代理.
持续的潜在行动 Gao等人,2025年,人类-机器人共同陈述 Chen等,2024e,和从履带像素运动Sundar等的自负控制,2026年朝这个方向走去,而州有说明的数据Li等,2026j;Cai等,2026a提供了更强而更窄的监督.

blocks.en:
Pseudo-action generation offers another source of training pairs: a video model produces a trajectory and an inverse or latent-action model labels its controls.
Such data helps only when the inferred action has the intended effect in a controlled environment or real system; otherwise the generator and the labeller reinforce each other’s shortcuts.
Evaluation should keep a labeled subset with interventions and measure transfer under unseen cameras, backgrounds, scenes, and embodiments.
blocks.zh:
Pseudo-Action 一代提供了另一个培训对等的来源:视频模型产生出一个轨迹,反向或潜入的动作模型会标出它的控制.
只有当推断出的行动在受控制的环境或实际系统中产生预期效果时,这些数据才有帮助;否则,生成器和标签器将相互强化捷径。
评价应保留一个带有标签的子集,包括干预措施和在看不见的相机、背景、场景和表现下衡量转移。

blocks.en: 9.6 Generalization across Scenes and Embodiments
blocks.zh: 9.6 整个场景和浮雕的概括

blocks.en: Figure 16: A held-out scene–body pair tests whether familiar factors compose while preserving action effects.
blocks.zh: 图16:一个被搁置的场景 - 双人测试熟悉的因素是否在保留动作效果的同时构成.

blocks.en:
Scene generalization changes appearance, layout, objects, or local dynamics for the same body, as when a robot enters a new room.
Embodiment generalization changes the body, sensors, action frequency, degrees of freedom, or physical meaning of an action, as when skills move from human hands to a robot arm.
blocks.zh:
场景通化会改变外观,布局,物体,或同一身体的局部动态,就像机器人进入新房间时一样.
活化通化会改变一个动作的身体,传感器,动作频率,自由度,或物理意义,就像技能从人手移动到机器人手臂一样.

blocks.en:
Zero-shot claims therefore depend on which factor is held out.
V-JEPA 2-AC Assran et al., 2025 transfers to new scenes without target data, but on a robot type seen in post-training, not an unseen embodiment.
Other methods adapt latent actions with limited interaction Gao et al., 2025 , generate target-domain experience Jang et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 , or broaden the pretraining prior Yu et al., 2025b .
For example, training may cover a human hand in a lab and a kitchen but a robot only in the lab (Figure 16 ).
Deploying the robot in the kitchen tests an unseen scene–body pair, where the representation and control mapping must still move the block to the target.
blocks.zh:
因此,零射出的索赔要求取决于采用何种因素。
V-JEPA 2-AC Assran等,2025年 在没有目标数据的情况下转移到了新场景,但在后训练中看到的机器人类型上,并不是一个看不见的化身.
其他方法在互动有限的情况下调整潜在行动 Gao等人,2025年,生成目标领域经验,Jang等人,2025年;Team等人,2025年,或扩大前期培训。 Yu等, 2025b. (中文(简体) ).
例如,培训可能涵盖实验室和厨房中的人手,但只涵盖实验室中的机器人(图16)。
在厨房里部署机器人测试一个看不见的场景 — — 人对子, 在那里, 表现和控制映射仍然必须移动到目标。

blocks.en:
Cross-embodiment transfer adds an alignment problem: the same semantic action may need different joints and timing on different bodies, while similar-looking motion can have different contact consequences.
Current methods connect human and robot behavior through shared image-goal units Chen et al., 2024e or map latent actions to robot commands with a small labeled set Ye et al., 2025 .
A method direction is to train such mappings to preserve effects, with objectives defined on outcomes such as object displacement, contact, and task completion instead of raw control values or token similarity.
Evaluation should cross scenes, embodiments, sensors, and action spaces and test effect equivalence, controllability, and safety after transfer.
Reports should state whether results are zero-shot, calibrated, or fully fine-tuned, and how much target data they used.
blocks.zh:
交叉活化转移又增加了一个对接问题:同一种语义动作可能需要不同的关节和不同体上的时间,而相类似相看的运动则可能产生不同的接触后果.
目前的方法通过共享图像-目标单位连接人类和机器人的行为 Chen等人, 2024e 或将潜在动作映射到带有小标签的机器人指令集 Ye等人, 2025年. (中文(简体) ).
一个方法方向是培训这种绘图以保存效果,其目标确定在诸如物体转移、接触和任务完成等结果上,而不是原始控制值或象征性的相似性。
评价应跨越场景、浮雕、传感器、动作空间和测试效果等同性、可控性以及转让后的安全性。
报告应说明结果是否为零射出、校准或完全微调,以及使用了多少目标数据。

blocks.en: 9.7 Stochastic Worlds and Rare Events
blocks.zh: 9.7 扭曲的世界和稀有事件

blocks.en:
One history can admit several valid futures, because other agents may act differently and relevant physical state may be hidden.
A deterministic predictor cannot express these alternatives, and squared-error training can favor an average of incompatible outcomes.
Latent-variable predictors Babaeizadeh et al., 2018 ; Lee et al., 2018 sample multiple futures, and controllable generators and data engines Russell et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2024a ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Jang et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 can synthesize rare scenarios for training (Section 8 ).
However, synthesis does not say how likely each outcome is: a prompted collision supplies a training case, whereas a calibrated collision risk supports a decision under uncertainty.
For example, given a fixed driving history and ego actions, a pedestrian may wait, cross after the car passes, or step into its path (Figure 17 ).
A generator can render the rare crossing without assigning it a reliable probability.
blocks.zh:
一个历史可以承认几个有效的未来,因为其他代理人可能行为不同,相关的物理状态也可能被隐藏.
确定性的预测器无法表达这些替代品,平方-偏差培训可以倾向于平均不相容的结果。
可变预测器 Babaeizadeh等,2018年;Lee等,2018年 采样多期货,可控发电机和数据引擎 Russell等,2025年;Gao等,2024年a;NVIDIA等,2025年;Jang等,2025年;Team等,2025年能合成难得的培训情景(第8节.
然而,综合并不说明每一种结果的可能性:所引发的相撞提供了训练案例,而经过校准的相撞风险则支持在不确定的情况下作出决定。
例如,鉴于一个固定的驾驶历史和自负行为,行人可以等待,在行车过后交叉,或者走入行道(图17.
发电机可以使难得的过道不给它一个可靠的概率。

blocks.en: Figure 17: Valid futures differ in frequency, and invalid and unreadable samples must be counted separately.
blocks.zh: 图17 有效期货的频率不同,无效和不可读取的样品必须分别计算.

blocks.en:
One direction is to develop generators that assign calibrated outcome probabilities rather than merely produce diverse samples, using empirical event rates or justified simulator priors.
Generated rare cases must be checked for physical feasibility, causal relevance, and downstream utility before entering training data, since prompting fixes which failures appear but not their frequencies.
blocks.zh:
一个方向是利用经验事件率或合理的模拟前作,开发能分配校正结果概率的发电机,而不只是生产出不同的样本.
在输入培训数据之前,必须检查所生成的罕见案例的物理可行性、因果相关性和下游用途,因为要纠正出现故障但频率不高的情况。

blocks.en:
For a fixed history and action sequence, distributional evaluation assesses whether samples cover distinct valid outcomes, exclude invalid ones, and match observed or simulated outcome frequencies.
Diversity alone rewards arbitrary variation, and best-of-many scoring hides misplaced probability mass.
Reports should therefore use proper scoring rules, calibration curves, and mode coverage at a fixed sample budget, distinguish unreadable from invalid samples, and use sample sizes appropriate to event rarity.
Repeated-sampling benchmarks Pu et al., 2026 ; Sadeghi et al., 2026 and confidence calibration Mei et al., 2025 are a start (Section 8.4 ), but extending outcome-frequency tests from endpoints in limited scenarios to long, action-conditioned trajectories is open.
blocks.zh:
对于固定的历史和行动序列,分布式评价评估样本是否涵盖不同的有效结果,排除无效结果,并匹配观察到或模拟的结果频率。
多样性本身就奖励了任意的变异,而最佳的分数掩盖了错误的概率质量。
因此,报告应使用适当的评分规则、校正曲线和固定样本预算模式覆盖,区分无法读取的样本和无效样本,并使用适合事件罕见的样本大小。
重复抽样基准 Pu等人,2026年;Sadeghi等人,2026年和信心校正Mei等人,2025年是一个起步(第8.4节),但将结果频率测试从有限情景中的终点扩展到长而有行动条件的轨迹是开放的.

blocks.en:
INSIGHT Scaling world models needs interventions, not just more clips Passive video expands coverage but leaves hidden state, physical causes, cross-direction transfer, action semantics, and outcome probabilities underdetermined.
Most of these challenges need data and protocols with interventions (known hidden changes, paired physical edits, matched ablations, labeled actions, held-out scene–body pairs, and observed event rates).
Observational scale shows what co-occurs; interventions show what changes what.
blocks.zh:
新闻 扩展世界模型需要干预,不仅需要更多的剪辑,被动视频会扩大覆盖面,而且还会留下隐藏状态、物理原因、交叉方向转移、动作语义和结果概率的确定不足。
这些挑战大多需要数据和协议,并配有干预措施(已知的隐藏变化、对齐的物理编辑、相匹配的擦伤、贴上标签的动作、被搁置的场景-身体对和被观察到的事件率)。
观测尺度显示什么是同化物;干预措施显示什么是变化。

blocks.en: INSIGHT Scaling world models needs interventions, not just more clips
blocks.zh: 新闻 扩大世界模式需要干预,而不仅仅是更多的短片

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10 结论

blocks.en:
This survey has treated video as an observed trace of a latent temporal world and used reading , writing , sharing , and interacting to organize how foundation models connect observations to represented state.
Comprehension recovers what a trace reveals; generation constructs traces from conditions; unification shares information and machinery between the two; and world modeling asks how represented state changes under conditions or actions.
Within this framing, a video world model is defined by the transition it learns, which predicts future video or video-derived features and runs passively, under a fixed action sequence, or interactively (Section 4.4 ).
The distinction between temporal coherence and world consistency (Definition ) separates the quality of rendered video from evidence that a model tracks the world state behind it.
The next phase demands stronger evidence (Table 2 ).
Beyond perceptual fidelity and local coherence, claims about the world require state that survives occlusion, revisits, and long horizons; controllable action effects; valid responses to interventions; and, for closed-loop use, latency within the control budget.
Stochastic futures also require coverage and calibration, unified models require matched evidence that information transfers between reading and writing, and systems built for training, planning, or evaluation must improve decisions in controlled environments or real tasks.
Meeting these requirements would move the field from rendering convincing video to modeling how the world changes.
blocks.zh:
并使用阅读、写作、分享和互动来组织基础模型如何将观测与代表状态联系起来。
理解恢复了痕量所揭示的;世代从条件中构建出痕量;两者的统一共享信息和机制;世界模型化询问在条件或行动下如何体现国家变化。
在这个框架范围内,一个视频世界模型由它所学习的过渡来定义,它预测未来视频或视频衍生的特性,并被动地运行,在固定的动作序列下,或交互地运行(第4.4节.
时间一致性和世界一致性(定义)的区别将制作的视频质量与一个模型跟踪其背后的世界状态的证据区分开来.
下一阶段需要更有力的证据(表2)。
除了观念上的忠诚和本地的一致性之外,对世界的诉求还需要在隔离、重新审视和长期存在的情况下生存下来的状态;可控制的行动效果;对干预的有效反应;以及,对于封闭式使用而言,控制预算内的长期性。
Stochastic期货还需要覆盖和校正,统一模型需要匹配的证据,说明阅读和写作之间的信息转移,为培训、规划或评价而建立的系统必须改善受控制环境或实际任务中的决策。
满足这些要求将使现场从提供令人信服的视频转向模拟世界的变化。
